name: Amber Long
bio: From the bustling streets of Toronto, Amber Long makes waves with her signature sound. Supported by top-tier artists and blessed with a voice that soothes souls near and far, she has charmed audiences across countries such as Australia, the USA, the UK, the Netherlands, Greece, Spain, Qatar, Mexico, Argentina, Jamaica, and her throughout her homeland, Canada. She’s smashed through the glass ceiling with her music and collaborations, which have been signed to multiple prestigious labels.

Amber’s passion for spinning is not limited just there; not only does she travel everywhere but also runs an independent label Modern Agenda – an independent label home to producers who are being championed for their work in Progressive House and Melodic Techno, primarily.

Amber launched the LIA Series in 2021, a series of guest mixes highlighting up-and-coming female and female-representing artists from around the globe. Amber has also been hosting Frisky Radio’s Rogue Radio Show since 2017 and has been involved with The Canadian Juno Awards for many years now.
With music coursing through every vein of hers, it’s easy to see why Amber believes in its power to heal us all.

name: DJ Recon
bio: Eric Dookie, aka Recon, is more than just a Canadian-born DJ and musician—he’s a sonic sorcerer with a track record that spans two electrifying decades. But let’s rewind to where it all began: the humble dance floors of Kitchener, Waterloo, and Guelph. Picture it: neon lights, bass vibrations, and a young Recon spinning vinyl like a turntable wizard.

Recon’s rhythm résumé reads like a mixtape of musical adventures. His diverse background—a fusion of beats, genres, and vibes—has turned him into a national treasure for audiences across the Great White North. From the Rockies to the Maritimes, he’s got crowds grooving, swaying, and fist-pumping like it’s their personal anthem. And let’s talk about those notable gigs! Imagine Recon setting the stage for Shaggy, where even Mr. “It Wasn’t Me” couldn’t resist a little shoulder shimmy. Then there’s Tamia, who belted out ballads while Recon spun beats that made hearts skip a collective BPM. And who could forget Charlie Murphy, laughing in the spotlight as Recon dropped sick remixes?

But wait, there’s more! Recon’s got Redbull wings, and he’s flown into the Thre3style Competition, where turntables battle like gladiators armed with vinyl swords. The crowd holds its breath, and Recon scratches, blends, and drops the beat like a musical ninja.

So whether you’re dancing in a dimly lit club or vibing in your living room, remember this: DJ Recon isn’t just spinning tunes; he’s weaving memories. And when the bass drops, it’s not just a beat—it’s a heartbeat shared by every soul on the dance floor.

And let’s not forget his 7-year reign on Much Music—where he spun magic on shows like Winterlude, CP24, OMNI, and Rogers TV.
So buckle up, folks! The Trevor Show isn’t just entertainment; it’s a full-throttle joyride through the glittering galaxy of applause and laughter.

name: DJ Vibe
bio: Daryl Pooran, aka DJ Vibe, has established himself as one of the most prominent DJ’s in the Kitchener Waterloo and surrounding areas.

Daryl consistently creates an astounding level of energy and engagement on dance floors. He has the unsurpassed ability to read and respond to a crowd of any size. Through his efforts to advance the urban genre, DJ Vibe has secured a solid network of industry professionals. Among this impressive network, he’s proven himself to be professional, reliable, and ambitious.

Daryl was introduced early to the music industry through the work of his Father and Aunt, who are both successful recording artists. As a result, even as a young child, DJ Vibe had an appreciation for the up and coming urban artists beyond those heard in the ʻmainstreamʼ. Visits with family in New York introduced DJ Vibe to cutting edge inner-city life, including underground urban music via mix tapes.

The young DJ Vibe was truly inspired by the mixes on the tapes he acquired in New York, and began to follow suit. Vibe found his own style through model DJs doing it real big at the time, such as Chinese Laundry, FPM (First Priority Music), Funkmaster Flex, and Kid Capri, just to name a few. Vibeʼs other musical influences included Notorious B.I.G, Bob Marley, Bounty Killer, Beenie Man, and Group Home. Outside the urban genre, Vibe also caught himself listening to Madonna, AC/DC, the Eagles, Josh Winx, Armand Van Helden, and Carl Cox.
No matter what type of crowd you are anticipating, DJ Vibe is certain to get them on the dance floor and keep them there until last call!!

name: DJ JustGeorge
bio: JustGeorge is a dynamic and versatile open format DJ hailing from the vibrant music scene of London, UK. With an impressive tenure of over 15 years entrenched in the music realm, George embarked on his journey on British airwaves, spinning a diverse array of tunes that captivated audiences far and wide.

As his prowess behind the decks burgeoned, George seamlessly transitioned into electrifying venues and events across the UK, making indelible marks on prestigious platforms like London Fashion Week and Film Festivals. His musical odyssey didn’t stop there; it expanded across continents, with Europe and Africa imprinting their rich cultural influences on his evolving sonic palette.

Today, George’s signature sound resonates with a fusion of genres ranging from the soulful rhythms of RnB to the infectious beats of Dance, from the pulsating energy of Chart hits to the infectious vibes of Afrobeats, and much more. It’s a melodic journey that reflects his eclectic tastes and global experiences.

In 2018, George embarked on a transatlantic endeavor, splitting his time between the UK and the vibrant music hub of Canada. Since then, he has carved out a niche for himself within the Canadian music landscape, establishing his presence through coveted residencies, electrifying gigs, and fruitful collaborations. His contributions have graced esteemed platforms such as the Toronto International Film Festival, The Drake Properties, Soho House, and beyond.

Even amidst his meteoric rise in Canada, George remains committed to bridging the musical gap between his native UK and his newfound home. With each performance, he strives to unite audiences through the universal language of music, weaving together diverse sounds and cultures into an unforgettable tapestry of sonic delight. JustGeorge isn’t just a name; it’s a testament to the boundless passion and dedication that drives this visionary artist forward, captivating audiences on both sides of the Atlantic and beyond.

name: The Café Ole
bio: The Café Ole’s original flamenco-jazz debut recording Cuanto Tardaré is an organic mix of Spanish, Latin American, and jazz, fueled with hot rhythms, sultry vocals, and fiery solos. Cuanto Tardaré recently won Best Latin-Jazz Album and Best Latin-Jazz Song (Café Ole) in the 2007 Toronto Exclusive Music Awards.

The band also won 2 prestigious songwriting awards; “Cuanto Tardaré” won the 2007 Luis Advis International Songwriting Competition in Chile, and “Mujer de Ojos Color Triste” won the Song-of-the-year award from SongOfTheYear.com (best jazz/instrumental song). The album was nominated for Best Jazz Album at the 2007 Toronto Independent Music Awards and the 2007 Ontario Independent Music Awards.
The Café Ole forge passion and energy for a superbly sensuous session.

name: Dan Kozar
bio: Indulge in the melodic world of jazz with the multifaceted talent of guitarist Dan Kozar. A seasoned musician with a wealth of experience, Dan has graced the stage with a diverse array of musical ensembles, showcasing his remarkable versatility and artistry.

Indulge in the melodic world of jazz with the multifaceted talent of guitarist Dan Kozar. A seasoned musician with a wealth of experience, Dan has graced the stage with a diverse array of musical ensembles, showcasing his remarkable versatility and artistry.

From the grandeur of 18-piece big bands to the intimacy of quartets, trios, duos, and the solitary elegance of a soloist, Dan’s musical journey reflects a rich tapestry of experiences. Yet, it is in the more intimate settings that Dan’s artistry truly shines. Whether he’s part of a quartet, weaving intricate harmonies, or collaborating within the rhythmic synergy of a trio, Dan’s musical expression takes on new dimensions.

Standards come alive under Dan’s fingers as he explores the jazz tradition, offering enchanting renditions in various settings. Performing with a trio or duo, he effortlessly breathes new life into timeless classics, infusing each note with his unique interpretation. Moreover, his mastery of finger-style guitar adds an extra layer of nuance and sophistication to his performances, creating an immersive and emotive experience for his listeners.
Scott Yanow, writer for Cadence Magazine says: “Dan Kozar is an excellent solo guitarist whose technique is conventional; much closer to Joe Pass and Charlie Byrd.”

H. Allen Williams, writer for Jazzreview says: “Dan’s ability to create fluid transition between the bass lines and the voiced harmonic treatments create a beautifully executed historical interpretation.”
Adam Greenberg, writer for AMG says: “Kozar shows off a nice array of skills on the solo guitar, particularly his finger style specialty.”

name: Dually Noted
bio: Dually Noted is a jazz duo/trio based in the Southern Ontario Golden Horseshoe, servicing the Niagara, Hamilton, Burlington, and Oakville area. They feature a number of top, experienced musicians – vocalists Katie Ross and Meagan Luchko, guitarists Nick Serbina, Thom Mason, Julien Bradley-Combs, Andrew Marzotto, and Dan Willer, and Jim Slominski on double bass. While primarily a jazz band that is continually adding more and more songs to their jazz repertoire, they also play a rich mixture of standard and contemporary pop, folk, and blues – to offer a full top to bottom one-stop group to play just about any type of event.

They offer three configurations – Instrumental Duo (guitar and upright bass), Instrumental Trio (sax, guitar, and upright bass), and Vocal Trio (Female vocals, guitar, and upright bass). Perfect to fit in with the ambiance you want to create or your budget. Popular packages include ceremonies, cocktails, and dinners for weddings, private house or office parties, and corporate events. Their specialty is performing for small, intimate weddings. Being experienced and trained musicians, and very quick studies, Dually Noted can adapt and learn songs for any type of themed event. They can make your wedding, private party, or corporate event unique and styled just the way you like it.

name: Emily Misura
bio: Emily Misura (also known as Stringing Him Along) is Toronto’s luxury violinist. Though she did the whole classical musician thing and got a degree in violin performance, she has extensively collaborated with bands, DJs, rappers and singer-songwriters. She has shared the stage with famous names such as The Who, The Eagles, Weird Al Yankovic, Drake, ELO, Chris Carrabba, Michael Bolton and Machine Gun Kelly; all those names are great, but why not add yourself to the list? She won’t discriminate, nor will she bite (even though she is the human version of a Pomeranian – compact but ironically feisty.) No venue is too small or too large. She has performed at some of the most well-known venues in North America including Carnegie Hall in New York City (when she was only eighteen) as well as in your mom’s backyard. (Your mom has some beautiful rose bushes.) She has performed with ensembles of all sizes, from Mannheim Steamroller and Rocktopia to just you… maybe it’s only in your mind right now, kind of like a Christopher Nolan movie, but not. You could incept yourself and make it a reality today by booking her! Take that, Hollywood. One of Emily’s favourite places is in the studio. She records regularly and has been credited on numerous albums in a variety of genres. You can hear her on albums by MAE, Surferblood, Tides of Man, Goodnight Neverland and The Holy Gasp. She recorded her own musical comedy album because surprise! She also got a Bachelors degree in music technology. We weren’t kidding when we said she is all over the place – but in a cool, hip way rather than a you-have-no-direction-when-will-you-get-a-real-job kind of way. She also can play by ear and improvise, meaning her song catalogue is next to infinite. She alternates between electric and acoustic violins from a collection that is ever-growing. Want to hear “Méditation from Thaïs” and Rihanna in the same performance? You’ve found your violinist. Want to hear “Concerning Hobbits” and the solo in Freebird? (Who wouldn’t want to hear that, tbh) – WELL NOW YOU CAN.

name: Hannah Barstow
bio: Hannah Barstow is a pianist, vocalist and composer in the Toronto jazz scene. As a performer, she is firmly rooted in the tradition of jazz, and is strongly influenced by the music of Shirley Horn, Ahmad Jamal and Blossom Dearie. As a composer, her motivic melodies, intricate harmonies and intimate lyrics are reminiscent of Jobim compositions, among other jazz standards, but with a modern perspective. Hannah’s unique technique of intertwining the piano and her voice, both in the performance of melodies and in improvisation, is a fresh sound that adds depth to her music.

Originally from Napanee, Ontario, Hannah studied classical piano and theory from the age of four. She began performing professionally at the age of twelve as a solo jazz pianist and vocalist, and subsequently in jazz and rock groups. She received an ARCT in piano performance from the Royal Conservatory of Music (2012), a Bachelor of Music in Jazz Performance (2016) and Master of Music in Jazz Performance (2020) on piano from the University of Toronto.

Hannah has performed with a number of renowned jazz artists, including Emilie Claire Barlow, Mike Murley, Kris Davis, Jim Vivian, Steve Wallace, Pat Collins, the Brian Barlow Big Band, and the Greg Runions Big Band with the Kingston Symphony. In 2016, she was featured as the Rising Young Star at the Prince Edward County Jazz Festival, and in 2018, she toured Chile with saxophonist Mike Murley. Hannah’s original song “Where Will I Be?” was recorded and released by Emilie Claire Barlow on her album Spark Bird (2023).

Hannah is an instructor at the University of Toronto Jazz Studies Program and York University Department of Music. She has released three EPs: her debut, Hannah Barstow Trio (2017), followed by Christmas for Two with vocalist Kalya Ramu (2017), and Snow with Kalya Ramu (2020). She also has two full length albums: Beneath (2021) which features Mike Murley on saxophones, Reknee Irene Harrett on bass, and Keith Barstow on drums, and In a Summer Dream (2022), which is co-lead by Mike Murley and features bassist Jim Vivian.

name: Jennifer Perez
bio: With a classical foundation in piano and voice, Jennifer Perez is a singer and pianist based in Southern Ontario, known for her warm vocals, expressive piano style, and heartfelt songwriting. She features a versatile repertoire that blends pop and folk favourites, upbeat Motown and rock classics that often get audiences dancing, select French and Italian songs, and heartfelt ballads. For occasions that call for a touch of elegance, she may also include classical piano selections.

Jennifer performs as a solo artist and also collaborates with other musicians in intimate duet settings, bringing versatility, sincerity, and emotional depth to every performance. Her music blends soulful melodies with honest storytelling, creating a sound that feels both personal and inviting.
In 2014, Jennifer won the SLAM on Air contest, Supporting Local Airdrie Musicians, with her original song “Our Love,” a milestone that highlighted her talent as both a vocalist and songwriter.

Drawing on years of musical training and live performance experience, Jennifer creates a warm and engaging atmosphere for audiences of all ages. Whether performing on her own or alongside other artists, she brings a genuine connection to the stage, sharing songs that resonate through musicianship, heart, and authenticity.

name: Just Us Jazz Band
bio: Servicing Toronto and the GTA, Just Us Jazz Band brings the timeless charm of live jazz to every occasion — from intimate gatherings and weddings to corporate galas and community events. With a seamless blend of instrumentals and vocals, the band tailors its performance to suit every mood, taste, and setting.

A proud recipient of Top Performer of the Month for an incredible 11 consecutive months on the GigSalad agency, Just Us Jazz Band has become one of the most in-demand groups in the region. Their passion for music, professionalism, and versatility make every performance an unforgettable experience.
The members include:

Bruce is a dynamic saxophonist and flautist who has shared the stage with some of the most respected names in jazz, including Boss Brass’s Eugene Amaro and Woody Herman’s Pat LaBarbera. A former Juno Awards judge, Bruce has been invited to perform for dignitaries and major celebrities — including the Prime Minister of Canada. His career has taken him across Europe and North America, playing renowned festivals such as Festijazz Rimouski and Toronto Beaches Jazz Festival. His expressive tone and soulful phrasing make him a cornerstone of the Just Us sound.

Duncan is a world-class bassist recognized internationally for his artistry and precision. He has performed and recorded with jazz icons like Diana Krall, Boss Brass, and Robert Farnon, and has graced legendary venues including Carnegie Hall. With over 40 album credits and countless appearances on CBC, BBC, and NPR, Duncan brings a depth of musical experience that anchors the band’s groove and sophistication.

A Juno Award nominee and seasoned performer, Gord has served as a house drummer for CBC and CTV, contributing to numerous recordings and film soundtracks. His technical mastery, rhythmic creativity, and unwavering dedication to musical excellence have made him a sought-after collaborator in the Canadian jazz scene. Beyond performance, Gord’s passion for sound engineering and production enhances every Just Us performance with clarity and energy.

Dean is an accomplished drummer celebrated for his versatility and dynamic presence. He has performed with Canadian jazz greats including Dave Young of the Oscar Peterson Trio and Don Thompson, and spent years touring with pianist John Arpin. A familiar face in the Toronto jazz circuit, Dean’s intuitive rhythm and refined style make him a perfect fit for the Just Us Jazz Band’s diverse repertoire.

John is an accomplished composer, arranger, and pianist whose music education includes studies with noted mentors Gord Delamont, Johnny Burt, and Pat Riccio. Holding an ARCT in Piano from the University of Toronto and a B.Ed. Specialist in Music, John has produced over 400 professional recordings, including TV commercials and film scores. His broad musical knowledge and artistic sensitivity bring sophistication and polish to every Just Us performance.

From smooth jazz classics to lively swing and soulful ballads, Just Us Jazz Band offers a musical experience that connects, uplifts, and inspires. Whether you’re planning a gala, wedding, private party, or corporate function, their sound is the perfect complement to any celebration.

name: Nadya Poklad
bio: Elegant Live Music for Unforgettable Moments

Nadya Poklad brings elegance, warmth, and sophistication to every occasion through beautifully performed live music. Blending classical artistry with a contemporary touch, her performances feature a captivating repertoire of classical and Romantic masterpieces, graceful melodies, popular favourites, and jazz standards.

With her expressive approach to the piano and refined musical style, Nadya creates an inviting atmosphere that enhances every moment. Whether providing elegant background music or a captivating featured performance, her music adds a memorable touch to any event.

Offering a variety of musical experiences, Nadya is available as a solo pianist , in a piano and saxophone duo , a piano and vocal duo , or as a trio featuring piano, saxophone, and voice . Each combination brings its own unique character, from the romantic elegance of solo piano to the rich, soulful sound of saxophone and the expressive beauty of live vocals.

With a versatile repertoire and flexible performance options, Nadya tailors each musical experience to suit the setting and audience. Her performances are ideal for concerts, weddings, cocktail receptions, corporate functions, private celebrations, fine dining, upscale events, and retirement residences .

Whether creating a sophisticated backdrop for an intimate gathering or delivering an engaging concert experience, Nadya and her fellow musicians bring artistry, charm, and a personal touch to every performance.
Nadya Poklad – Beautiful Music. Elegant Atmosphere. Lasting Impressions.

name: Sharon Musgrave
bio: Born in England of Dominican parents but raised in Canada, where she currently resides, Singer/Songwriter Sharon Musgrave shot to prominence in 1991 whilst collaborating with William Orbit on the Bass-O-Matic project. They achieved international status with the hit Fascinating Rhythm (Virgin), which Sharon co-wrote. An album soon followed, cementing the groups worldwide status as a credible dance act and Sharon’s ability as a writer.

A world tour established Bass-O-Matic as an act that could cut it live, due in large part to Sharon’s stage presence. In a recent interview with the UK’s Record Mirror, William Orbit, (Grammy for Madonna’s “Ray of Light”), throws accolades Sharon’s way saying, “I don’t have to worry about playing live when I’ve got Sharon on stage with me, because she’s a consummate singer.” William adds “No worries, she’s done it all. The studios my home, the stage is hers!”

In 1992 Sharon was invited by WEA to work with jazz pianist Julian Joseph. She collaborated on the ‘Language of Truth’ album singing the Curtis Mayfield song ‘The Other Side of Town’. This track was eventually used as the single from the album. The video for this track inspired a Teachers Whisky commercial, in which Sharon appeared, playing a blues singer in a 60’s bar scene, singing the classic ‘No Greater Love’. Sharon traveled with Julian promoting the Language of Truth album and touring with such jazz greats as Herbie Hancock.

Sharon’s studio work in England, both as a writer and session singer, led her to work with many notable performers, including Courtney Pine, Maxi Priest, and writers/producers, Terry Briton, Henry Priestman, Jimmy Haynes, Steve Harvey, Phil Chill and Adrian Wyatt.

Her final collaboration in the UK before returning to Canada was in 1998 on the ‘Get in the Swing’ compilation album with Steve Alpert. Since returning to Canada Sharon has enjoyed a successful solo career both live and on record. Her most recent Canadian solo release in 2002, ‘Selah’ (Zosar Records) earned her two nominations, Best Songwriter and Best Spoken Word, at the prestigious Urban Music Association of Canada award show, held that year in Toronto. Jude Kelly, VP of UMAC claims “the title track Selah is especially brilliant”. The video for this track achieved top twenty status on the Bravo video chart.

Her latest international release ‘Nobody’ is a track included on the groundbreaking CD ‘Soulfragettes’, (Recoup/Timewarp). This is a unique compilation of powerful R&B female singers. Sharon’s track, co-written with Adrian Wyatt, has been singled out for special attention, and is to be included on a number of other compilations around the world.

Sharon is now hard at work ready to release a whole new set of inspired songs on her second CD. She juggles shows including work at the Fallsview Casino Niagara and jingle commercials like the one just completed for Calla Lilly Fine Lingerie being played currently on WAVE 94.7 FM.

So, whether you’re in the heart of Toronto or the bustling streets of New York, let Diamond Dancers take you on a journey through time with the Gatsby Show. Join them in reliving the splendour of the Roaring Twenties, where the fantastic dancers turn every event into an extraordinary celebration that echoes the grandeur of the past.

Welcome to the graceful world of Diamond Dancers, where the artistry of ballet takes centre stage in our exquisite “Ballet Show.” For over a decade, since their inception, they have been dedicated to the pursuit of perfection in both wedding and corporate entertainment. With a wealth of experience, having graced the stages of hundreds of events, Diamond Dancers stand as a testament to expertise, professionalism, and the seamless execution of performances that leave a lasting impression.

In the realm of weddings and corporate events, where every detail matters, Diamond Dancers have earned a reputation for delivering ballet performances that transcend expectations. Their Ballet Show is a delicate fusion of poise, precision, and storytelling, creating a captivating experience for audiences of all kinds.

As the curtain rises, the talented dancers transport you into a world of elegance and beauty. Every movement is a brushstroke in a visual masterpiece, and each performance is tailored to evoke emotion and captivate the senses. From classical compositions to contemporary choreography, the Ballet Show is a celebration of the timeless art form, ensuring that every guest is immersed in the enchantment of the dance.

Their expertise in wedding and corporate entertainment extends beyond the stage. They understand the importance of seamless execution, and with Diamond Dancers, you can trust that every detail will be meticulously planned and flawlessly executed. Whether it’s an intimate wedding or a grand corporate affair, the Ballet Show adapts to the unique ambiance of your event, creating an atmosphere of sophistication and charm.

Having performed at countless weddings and corporate events, they recognize the significance of these occasions in people’s lives. The Diamond Dancers bring not only skillful dance but also a touch of magic, transforming your special day into an unforgettable experience. Our commitment to perfection ensures that you can relax and enjoy the moment, confident that the seasoned performers will execute every move flawlessly.

In the world of wedding and corporate entertainment, Diamond Dancers stand as a symbol of reliability, artistry, and the commitment to making your event truly exceptional. Entrust them with the privilege of bringing the enchantment of ballet to your celebration, and let their Ballet Show be the crowning jewel in the story of your special day or corporate gathering.

Step into the pulsating rhythm of celebration with Diamond Dancers and their scintillating “Samba Show”! Immerse yourself in the infectious energy and vibrant beats of Brazil as the talented performers take you on a journey through the heart of Rio de Janeiro’s carnival spirit.

From the moment the music starts, the stage comes alive with a riot of colors, feathers, and the electrifying movements of the Samba dancers. The Samba Show by Diamond Dancers is a spectacle of joy, blending traditional Samba steps with contemporary flair to create a performance that is both authentic and exhilarating.

The Samba Show is a sensory explosion, capturing the essence of Brazilian carnival with its high-energy choreography, dazzling costumes, and infectious enthusiasm. The rhythm of the drums becomes the heartbeat of the performance, and our dancers, adorned in vibrant costumes adorned with sequins and feathers, move with unparalleled grace and precision.

Audiences are transported to the vibrant streets of Rio, where the carnival never ends and the party is infectious. Diamond Dancers’ Samba Show is not just a performance; it’s a celebration of life, passion, and the unbridled joy of dance. Whether you’re hosting a corporate event, a private celebration, or a themed party, the Samba Show is designed to elevate the atmosphere and create an unforgettable event.

name: DRUMSINU Drum Circle
bio: Get ready to feel the rhythm with DRUMSINU Drum Circle , led by the dynamic Jeff Salem! These interactive percussion sessions bring people together through the universal language of music. Perfect for group events, DRUMSINU combines fun, education, and entertainment into an unforgettable experience where everyone gets to play, connect, and groove.

DRUMSINU isn’t just a performance – it’s a hands-on musical adventure! Under Jeff Salem’s expert guidance, participants of all skill levels play rhythms on a variety of percussion instruments, from drums and shakers to tambourines and more. No experience? No problem! Jeff makes it easy and enjoyable for everyone to join in.

The musical style is a vibrant fusion of samba with influences from salsa, soca, reggae, and funk. This unique blend creates an infectious energy that gets toes tapping and spirits soaring. Whether you’re drumming to a Brazilian beat or swaying to a Caribbean groove, DRUMSINU delivers a sound that’s as diverse as it is exciting.

DRUMSINU Drum Circle is the ultimate addition to your next gathering. Designed for groups of 10 to 130 people, these sessions are ideal for a wide range of occasions. Whether it’s a corporate team-building day, a community festival, or a private celebration, Jeff Salem tailors the experience to suit your event’s vibe and goals.

Every DRUMSINU session is customizable to fit your schedule and preferences. Shows range from 30 to 75 minutes, giving you the flexibility to incorporate the drum circle into your event seamlessly. Want a quick energizer or a full rhythmic journey? Jeff works with you to craft the perfect experience.

Participants don’t just listen—they actively contribute to the music, fostering teamwork, creativity, and connection. It’s a fantastic way to break the ice, boost morale, or simply celebrate life through rhythm.

Absolutely everyone! DRUMSINU welcomes participants of all ages and abilities. Whether you’re a seasoned drummer or picking up a percussion instrument for the first time, Jeff’s infectious enthusiasm and clear instruction ensure a rewarding experience for all. Kids, teens, adults, and seniors alike will love the chance to make music together.
Ready to bring the power of percussion to your next event? Contact Continental to reserve your DRUMSINU Drum Circle session.

name: Enviro Drum
bio: On the surface Enviro Drum is a percussion group comprised of professional musicians who have a passion for music and an eye for engaging performance. Things get interesting when the group takes their love of music and couples it with a passion for preserving the environment.
The founder of the group, Jeff Salem, is a professional percussionist from Toronto, Canada.

Jeff yearned to spread environmental awareness in his community and felt strongly that if he appealed to the young generation he could start a grassroots movement. His way of spreading that awareness was simple: percussion.

Each Enviro Drum show has many interactive and entertaining moments wherein the group performs different styles of music while delivering environmental statistics in a way that is easy to understand. Enviro Drum uses strictly recyclable products as percussion instruments. These include: plastic, metal, glass, wood and paper products.
To compliment their rhythm section keyboards and vocals were added to create the best performance possible.
Enviro Drum was formed in 2009 and has performed in over 300 schools, festivals, and at private shows for corporate companies for audiences of ALL ages.
There are currently two divisions of Enviro Drum: Enviro Drum Toronto (Canada) and Enviro Drum Maryland (USA).

name: Extraordinary Acts Entertainment
bio: Extraordinary Acts is designed to do more than fill a room — it creates an experience. From striking visual acts to interactive performers, each concept is built to engage guests, complement the event, and become part of the atmosphere.

Strolling Tables combine theatrical costuming with functional service, offering champagne, cocktails, hors d’oeuvres, desserts, giveaways, and more. Living Statues and Character Statues create dramatic visual moments, while Florets in Motion and Red Carpet Arrivals add movement, elegance, and instant impact.

Children’s entertainment ranges from superheroes, mascots, clowns, balloon artists, and circus performers to magic, puppetry, science shows, animal presentations, and interactive specialty acts. Holiday entertainment includes professional Santa and Mrs. Claus appearances, seasonal characters, photo experiences, story time, sing-alongs, comedy, and customized corporate holiday presentations.

Every act can be matched to the style, theme, and audience of the event. Existing concepts can be adapted, or entirely new ideas can be created for galas, receptions, fundraisers, product launches, weddings, corporate events, private celebrations, family events, and seasonal productions.
The focus is always on memorable entertainment that looks exceptional, engages guests, and gives people something to talk about long after the event is over.

Strolling Tables bring instant visual impact and interactive entertainment to any event. Equal parts performance and function, these extravagantly costumed characters circulate among guests while serving hors d’oeuvres, cocktails, champagne, desserts, badges, awards, casino chips, giveaways, and more. Heat-resistant tabletops can accommodate both hot and cold offerings, making each presentation as practical as it is unforgettable.

Every Strolling Table is performed by a trained theatrical professional who knows how to engage, entertain, and interact with guests. A wide variety of themes is available, with concepts, costumes, and designs created in-house. Custom themes can also be developed to match a specific event, brand, or creative vision.

Perfect for galas, receptions, fundraisers, golf tournaments, product launches, weddings, private celebrations, and corporate events, Strolling Tables can be tailored to suit virtually any occasion. Multiple characters and themes are available, creating a memorable way to serve, surprise, and entertain guests throughout the event.

Living Statues, Character Statues, Florets in Motion, and Red Carpet Arrivals create a striking sense of theatre from the moment guests arrive. New concepts are continually developed, with custom designs available to bring a specific theme, brand, or creative vision to life.

These lifelike statues have appeared at conferences, galas, receptions, garden parties, themed celebrations, private events, and red carpet arrivals. Signature pedestal presentations are available with risers and platforms, along with a wide range of finishes and colors, from smooth stone and cracked marble to elegant burnished metal.
When presented without a pedestal, performers can relocate throughout the event space, creating unexpected moments of movement and interaction.
Living Statues deliver the memorable “WOW Factor” that transforms an event into an experience.

A complete range of children’s entertainment is available, from classic favorites to unique specialty acts. Options include strolling characters, superheroes, children’s shows, balloon artists, clowns, circus performers, and other interactive entertainers designed to keep young guests engaged and entertained. Entertainment choices also include musical performances, magic shows, pirate adventures, juggling, unicycling, puppetry, ventriloquism, mascots, fairytale characters, and much more. Programs can be tailored to suit different age groups, event styles, and indoor or outdoor settings. For something a little different, specialty shows can feature trained dogs, reptiles, birds, furry animals, science demonstrations, bubble performances, and other educational or interactive experiences. New concepts are always being added, making it easy to find the right entertainment for any children’s event.

Santa appearances bring holiday magic to events of every size, indoors or outdoors. Appearances are perfect for office parties, private celebrations, corporate holiday events for families and adults, charities, Christmas markets, Santa Claus parades, Pictures with Santa, seasonal trade shows, promotions, and more. Santa performers are also available for select radio, commercial, and voice-over opportunities. Each Santa has a distinctive personality, style, and special talents that make every visit unique. Performers are carefully selected to suit the occasion and can be incorporated into specially designed corporate holiday packages. Guests enjoy a memorable holiday experience filled with warmth, laughter, and interaction. Santa’s engaging personality brings out the magic of the season in children and adults alike. Capture the moment with your own photographer, request professional photography, or simply take selfies. Santa visits can be customized for public, private, and corporate events. Mrs. Claus is also available to accompany Santa or make special appearances of her own. She is a wonderful goodwill ambassador for charities, promotions, photo opportunities, parades, malls, and seasonal events. Additional entertainment can include comedy, sing-and-dance-alongs, story time, face painting, baked treats, singing telegrams, and more.

name: Comedy Hypnotist Fernandez
bio: Welcome to the world of Comedy Hypnotist Fernandez, where entertainment takes center stage in a one-of-a-kind production show that goes beyond the ordinary. Imagine a performance that seamlessly blends the art of hypnotism with cutting-edge multimedia, special effects, and a dash of humor to create an unforgettable experience.

Comedy Hypnotist Fernandez isn’t just a performer; he’s a maestro orchestrating a symphony of laughter and amazement. The integration of multimedia and special effects elevates the show to new heights, transforming it into a visual and auditory feast. From the moment the curtains rise, the audience is immersed in a world where video, music, lighting, and pyrotechnics harmonize to create an atmosphere of excitement and wonder.

The show features 25 custom-made videos, each adding a unique flavor to the performance. These videos aren’t just a backdrop; they are an integral part of the comedic journey, enhancing the hypnotic experience and contributing to the overall spectacle. Comedy Hypnotist Fernandez takes pride in the meticulous craftsmanship of these videos, ensuring that each one contributes to the humor and entertainment quotient of the show.

And let’s not forget the Smoking Guitars – a pyrotechnic touch that adds an extra layer of thrill to the performance (where approved, of course). The Smoking Guitars are a visual spectacle, capturing the audience’s attention and creating moments of surprise and delight.

What sets this production apart is not just the technical wizardry but the sheer joy it brings to the audience. Comedy Hypnotist Fernandez has mastered the art of blending laughter with the mystique of hypnotism, creating an atmosphere where every spectator is an active participant in the comedic journey.

Whether you’re organizing a corporate event, private party, or special celebration, Comedy Hypnotist Fernandez’s production show is designed to leave a lasting impression. It’s not just great; it’s an experience that will be talked about long after the curtains close.

So, step into a world where laughter knows no bounds, where multimedia and special effects converge to create magic, and where Comedy Hypnotist Fernandez takes you on a comedic rollercoaster like no other. Get ready for an evening of entertainment that transcends expectations and guarantees smiles, laughter, and memories that linger. Comedy Hypnotist Fernandez – where comedy meets spectacle, and the audience becomes part of the show!

name: Jeff West Comedy Stage Hypnotist

photo.alt: Jeff West world famous Canadian comedy stage hypnotist

bio: An accredited clinical hypnotist with a certificate from the National Guild of Hypnotists with a Master of Hypnosis accreditation. Jeff is a Stage Hypnosis Master Instructor in Toronto Canada. Jeff is being sought after as one of the most ethical stage hypnosis trainers in Canada for corporate stage hypnosis and motivational presentations including television appearances on the “Discovery Channel”, and NBC.

Jeff has honed his professional stage skills, and always performs in good taste with the utmost respect for the audience and his volunteers. Audiences as large as 4,200 people or as small as 30, inside venues, or outside arenas, are all stages that Jeff manages to turn into exciting, energizing gatherings of fun and laughter. Years of stage experience have allowed Jeff to evaluate the audience and the volunteers easily and successfully. This makes him one of the most experienced, lively and versatile hypnotists entertaining today.

Over 70 shows annually for large and small corporate clients around the world. More than 20 years stage experience as a musician, sound and lighting expert and Stage Hypnotist means that Jeff understands the business of the entertainment business better than most: to deliver the funniest, well produced and directed show, which always leaves the audience laughing and wanting more.

It’s mile-o-minute fun from beginning to end as master comedy hypnotist Jeff West pulls out all the stops in the most uproarious audience participation comedy performance you have ever witnessed. Great music and dynamic props set the stage for the most exciting and relentlessly funny one-hour adventure your funny bone can handle.

Jeff presents a triumph of imagination, suspense, science and cinematic artistry that demonstrates why this stage hypnotist is fast becoming the most sought after corporate entertainer in the world today. He is always injecting new ideas into his routines creating a breathtaking comedy adventure you’ll want to experience again and again… on or off the stage.

name: John Park
bio: John Park’s wide-ranging career has taken him from Hollywood, where he appeared on HBO’s award-winning “Larry Sanders Show” starring Garry Shandling, to Las Vegas, where he performed in “Splash” at the Riviera Hotel and Casino on the Strip. At the invitation of the late Bill Graham, John opened for Huey Lewis and the News, The Grateful Dead, and the Jerry Garcia Band.

He’s performed on Persian rugs in Saudi Arabia for ex-pat oil workers, and even taken his act to sea, where he’s played for the passengers of the SS Azure Seas as well as Senator Dianne Feinstein on a historic schooner, the Dolph Remp.

John’s engaging performances have won over audiences like top executives at Microsoft and IBM, for whom he’s put together corporate shows, Ontario television viewers who were lucky enough to catch John on CityTV’s Breakfast Television, and festival-goers around the world, including attendees at the New Zealand Festival of the Arts, the legendary Edinburgh Fringe Festival, and the Moers Comedy Festival in Germany, where John wowed the audience for eight straight hours as the festival’s emcee.

name: Silver Elvis
bio: Peter Jarvis is a highly creative and dynamic performer based in Toronto, with a career in entertainment spanning over four decades.

His diverse skills in mime, dance, clowning, mask work, and music have enabled him to contribute significantly to film, theater, and television. He has been a writer and performer in notable productions such as Sesame Street, Cirque du Soleil, the Cannes Award-winning Vid Kids, and Mission Reading.

Jarvis continues to delight audiences worldwide with his stage performances and street festivals, having performed in countries like the USA, England, Australia, New Zealand, Malaysia, Poland, and Turkey.

name: The Amazing Bubbleman

photo.alt: The Amazing Bubbleman Jugglers Magicians Entertainers Hypnotists

bio: Even Mark Twain once said: “A soap bubble is the most beautiful thing, and the most exquisite in nature…”

Bubbles appeal to all ages from 1-101! The colours and fabulous shapes of these larger-than-life liquids grabs everyone’s attention! No one can resist their wonder and beauty. Sometimes the bubble will last a few seconds as if reflects all the colours of the rainbow. Other bubbles can perform “miracles” for minutes as they magically transform form geometric shapes to insects, carnival rides or even a floating capsule.
THE BUBBLEMAN is able to mesmerize and take you to the world of bubbles by astounding crowds with his special tricks.
“How is it done?” you ask. You’ll have to come see for yourself. Come and be part of the show: IT WILL BE AN UNFORGETTABLE AND MESMERIZING MOMENT!”

name: The Ben Show

photo.alt: The Ben Show Jugglers Magicians Entertainers Hypnotists

bio: Welcome to the dynamic world of Ben, a rising star and one of Canada’s most sought-after variety entertainers. With a performance style that is rapidly gaining acclaim, Ben’s show is an exhilarating blend of high-energy antics, rapid-paced stunts, and side-splitting comedy that leaves audiences thoroughly entertained.

Ben’s show is a whirlwind of excitement, seamlessly fusing awesome stunts with uproarious comedy, creating an experience that is both unforgettable and utterly enjoyable. Whether he’s dazzling the crowd with jaw-dropping juggling displays, skillfully navigating a unicycle with finesse, or showcasing incredible feats of balance, Ben’s performance is a spectacle that captivates from start to finish.

Audiences can’t get enough of Ben’s infectious energy and charisma. His ability to seamlessly transition between awe-inspiring stunts and laugh-out-loud comedy is a testament to his versatility as an entertainer. Ben’s show isn’t just an event; it’s an immersive journey into a world where the boundaries between skill and humor blur, leaving spectators on the edge of their seats, eagerly anticipating the next surprising twist.

Whether he’s featured as the main performer or assumes the role of a charismatic host, Ben brings an undeniable wow factor to any event. The crowd’s enthusiastic response is a testament to the universal appeal of his act – a perfect fusion of astonishing physical feats and razor-sharp wit.

If you’re seeking entertainment that goes beyond the ordinary, Ben is the performer who delivers. His show is not just a performance; it’s an experience that leaves a lasting impression. From corporate events to private parties, Ben’s show promises an evening of non-stop excitement, laughter, and entertainment that will be the talk of the town.

So, buckle up for a rollercoaster ride of stunts and humor that will leave you breathless and thoroughly entertained. Ben is not just a variety entertainer; he’s a maestro of laughter and amazement, ready to turn your event into a spectacular showcase of skill and comedy. Experience the magic of Ben’s show, where each moment is a testament to the extraordinary blend of talent, energy, and entertainment that he brings to the stage.

name: The Cowguys

photo.alt: The Cowguys Jugglers Magicians Entertainers Hypnotists

bio: The Cowguys Good Clean Holstein Family Fun!

The Cowguys are an Ottawa based performing duo who have been delighting audiences worldwide since 1990. In their award winning show titled “100 % Canadian Ground Beef” they expertly blend circus, western and magic skills with dexterity, wit, danger, and stupidity. A comic explosion waiting to happen, the Cowguys are “Guaranteed Fresh” and will make your sides hurt from laughing too much. If causing excessive laughter was a crime they’d be illegal.

The show features a barrage of tricks laced with continuous patter between themselves and the audience. They create a non-stop roller-coaster ride of a show by expertly meshing a high level of technical skill with hilarious banter. Also avid ad-libbers, The Cowguys love to interact with the crowd and find humour amongst their spectators. Their best shows are those in which the crowd “creates” its own material. Aside from keeping shows interesting for themselves, these ad-libbed bits are what keep crowds coming back to see The Cowguys’ show again and again. This improvisory element makes their show an ideal choice for corporate events and trade shows, as they can easily work in information, a sales message or customized jokes.

name: The Tiroler Brass
bio: The Tiroler Brass band has graced stages across North America, bringing their lively performances to a variety of events and festivals. From the vibrant Oktoberfest celebrations of Kitchener-Waterloo to the spirited atmosphere of the Calgary Stampede, and even as far east as St. John’s, Newfoundland, their music has captivated audiences far and wide.

Their journey has taken them to iconic venues and events such as the Quebec Winter Carnival, the New York State Fair, and the Bavarian Festival in Frankenmuth, Michigan. They’ve also delighted crowds at the Erie County Fair, Marineland in Niagara Falls, and everywhere in between, from Timmins in the north to Windsor in the south.

For over 35 years, they’ve been a staple at the Kitchener-Waterloo Oktoberfest, showcasing their talent and spreading joy with their performances. While this list only scratches the surface of their extensive travels and performances, one thing is certain: The Tiroler Brass knows how to make their music heard wherever they go.

name: Dorota
bio: Dorota is a Toronto based freelance makeup artist/instructor, visual artist and body painter. Her extensive background and training in makeup artistry and art, along with her dynamic personality provides her clients with a dependable, detail-oriented, fun and multi-faceted professional to add to the success of the creative team and any project, regardless of the nature or location.

Dorota has over 11 years of experience in all aspects of the makeup industry including fashion shows, body painting/airbrushing, editorials, private and corporate events, special effects, workshop facilitation and much more… She shapes and transforms faces and bodies into flawless works of art, teaching the art of makeup design and application to hundreds of personal clients and students. Her passion and affinity for makeup artistry has allowed her to use this gift to become an inspiration to many people.

Dorota always stands out as a focused professional. She has earned a reputation both nationally and internationally for being a very creative and innovative force – a leading expert in bringing aesthetic visions to life. Her passion for her work continues to unfold and take new forms in all her endeavours.

name: Toronto Mobile Makeup Artist
bio: Each of our Master Artists are professionally trained, licensed and certified and have years of experience behind them. We are dedicated to staying on the cutting edge of fashion and top beauty trends, and continually are educated on a regular basis.

Mobile Makeup was founded in 1999 in Toronto Ontario, Canada by Owner and Professional Celebrity Makeup Artist Staceylee Estabrooks. Through the years Mobile Makeup Artistry Group has prepared more than 2000 brides and has a impressive list of Celebrity clientele.
We continually work for the Entertainment Dept. for musical guests and stage theatre at the Fallsview Casino.

Staceylee Estabrooks Celebrity Makeup Artist Staceylee has been a Professional Makeup Artist for more than 16 years and has been in the beauty industry for over 22 years.Trained by North America’s top private educators Kyrolan, SOMA Complections Int. and Graftobain for all areas of makeup application, beauty, fashion, televison/film, special fx, latex prosthesis, wig making, mask making earning honours in all. She is also a Certified Esthetician a MAC SR.Pro Artist and continually trains with Smashbox. Her ongoing work with various media, music, television celebrities has created a fabulous clientele. You may have seen her work on Rich Bride Poor Bride, City TV, FT, BT, PBS, numerous commercials, music videos and newscasts.

Nadia Salem Makeup Artist Assistant A graduate from George Brown and Sheridan College as a Makeup Artist in 2006 has brought Nadia to The Mobile Makeup team to Assist for Staceylee in 2008. Her experiences so far in theatre, runway/fashion, weddings, photography, consultations, and retail are just the tip of the iceberg for Nadia as she embarks on her new career. Nadia is currently training with Smashbox. Life is about hurdling one bump after another, you may as well look your best along the way.

Christina Dvorak Hairstylist Christina has a passion and love for hair since she was playing with barbies…her love expanded after taking cosmetology at Stamford Collegiate encouraging her to attend Niagara College receiving her Hairstylist Certificate. Perusing her dream…Christina Dvorak is now a salon owner, hairstylist and young entrepreneur, at the age of 22 she will be celebrating her second anniversary of her business Salon Tranquility.

Joe Poenessa Hairstylist Over the last 28 years… Joe’s experience as a Hairstylist has taken him along a long curvy path. From owning salons in Niagara On The Lake to Madison Avenue in New York City…Joe has become a master and specializing in hair extensions. He is now back to Niagara On The Lake working with The Shaw Festival Theatre as Supervisor of Wigs Department and The Mobile Makeup team is happy to have Joe behind the styling chair but this time making it all special for those special days.

name: Lazo and the Radikals
bio: Juno Award Winner Lazo , was born in Castle Bruce on the beautiful island of Dominica in the Caribbean. He began his career at an early age with a band called Black Blood (their very first album charted number two in Dominica and received extensive air play in the Caribbean). Soon after immigrating to Ottawa, Canada, Lazo formed his own band, Unity, to start performing his original compositions.
Lazo has since toured extensively in the United States, Canada, and t he Caribbean sharing the stage with artist such as Maxi Priest, Burning Spear, Third World, and the Wailers, to name a few.

Relocating to Toronto he created the Lazo Band , releasing the well received EP, Satisfaction Guaranteed. The following year Lazo was awarded the Top Reggae Performer of the Year, at the internationally recognized Canadian Reggae Music Awards. Lazo subsequently produced four CDs: Impetus (which received the honor of being the first independent album to chart on Vancouver’s Z95.3 TOP 30) for the Washington D.C. based RAS records, becoming the first Canadian artist to be signed by the label, Something Real (nominated for a Juno Award in 1995), Heart and Soul, winner of the 2000 Juno Award for Best Reggae Recording, Love is on Your Sid e (the hit single),also nominated for a Juno Award, and Children of the Palm Race.

Lazo’s music video, Crucial, produced by Video Fact and RAS Records reached number three on the charts in Guyana, South America, and received extensive play on CSN (Caribbean Satellite Network), as well rotating on America’s BET (Black Entertainment Television).
Discography

Children of the Palm Race ( Y.T. Records) 2002 Love is on Your Side (Y.T. Records) 2001 Heart and Soul ( Y.T. Records/ Factor ) 1998 Something Real (RAS) 1995 Impetus ( RAS ) 1993 Satisfaction Guaranteed (independent) 1990

We will surely be hearing a lot more about this consummate performer and charismatic artist who, against all odds left his small, beautiful island of Dominica , on a hot day in December 1979, only to arrive in Ottawa , Canada on a cold snow-storm night and made a name for himself in the world. It is worth noting that Lazo also holds a degree in Political Science from the University of Toronto, Canada. This shaker and mover plans to make a difference in the world, musically and politically.
Contact us for the special EXODUS show “tribute to Bob Marley” featuring Lazo & the Radikals.

name: Melanie Durrant
bio: Melanie Durrant is a singer-songwriter who embodies real artistry through her very unique, edgy and soulful music style.

Born and raised in Toronto, Melanie attended the Earl Haig School of the Arts. She trained at the Royal Conservatory of Music and worked on an eclectic array of projects before she became an “alternative hip-hop soul” artist. Citing influences that range from the soulful swoon of Minne Ripperton to the hard-knock of Aerosmith to the “mercy me” melodies of Marvin Gaye, the radiant singer/songwriter has no problems crashing through the wall of sound.

She has received multiple accolades though out her career including a Much Music Video Award nom for her single “Where I’m Going” and Stylus Awards winner for Single Of The Year for her song “Bang Bang” ft Kardinal Offishall. In 2013, Melanie Durrant’s reggae influenced lovers rock single Made For Love was nominated for Reggae Recording of Year for the 2013 Juno Awards. She then continued with a second consecutive nom at the 2014 Juno Awards for R&B Recording of the Year for her single “Gone”.

This multi-talented artist was also a featured performer in the Canadian production of Rent. Being a regular in the ensemble allowed her to work with her good friend/cast mate Jill Scott (Hidden Beach/ Epic Records).

In addition to performing her own shows for audiences across Canada and the U.S., Melanie Durrant has shared the stage alongside Jay Z, 50 Cent, Jill Scott, Common, Sean Paul, Cissy Houston, Kardinal Offishall as well as many of Canada’s top artists. She has graced such magazines as Honey and Coco. Melanie has performed and done interviews with MuchMusic Canada, MTV Canada, Star Daily, CTV Network to name a few. She has had a variety of video production releases under her belt aired nationally on MuchMusic Canada. Her songs have been in high rotation on Toronto radio including Flow 93.5 and G987, as well as other radio stations across Canada. Melanie Durrant’s music has been featured on numerous compilation releases and DJ mixtapes around the world.

Melanie Durrant has recently completed the material for her sophomore album “Anticipation”. Full of melodic surprises heavenly harmonies and bold direction, Melanie Durrant embodies the voice, attitude and sound that have blessed Canada and the whole world has been waiting for.

name: One Ugly Cowboy
bio: One Ugly Cowboy (OUC) is a Toronto-based country/rock band led by the dynamic vocalist ‘Hurricane Jane’ Sowerby. Blending gritty country with high-energy rock, OUC delivers heartfelt, humorous, and original tunes that captivate audiences.

Formed by Jane Sowerby and guitarist Richard Zwic, OUC combines decades of musical expertise. Jane, an award-winning actress with over 100 film/TV credits, has fronted bands like a Janis Joplin tribute and worked with industry legends in Los Angeles. Richard, a seasoned producer and songwriter, has collaborated with JUNO winners and opened for icons like Bryan Adams and Steppenwolf. Joined by bassist Rick Ottenbrite and drummer Mike Mann in 2015, OUC was born in a home studio when Jane and Richard decided to bring their songs to life.

OUC’s debut EP Get Yer Ugly On (2015) kicked off their journey, followed by their 2020 album Ride with the Wind , which produced six Top 5 singles on the Canadian Indie Country Countdown Chart, three hitting #1. Their 2022 singles I Love Whatcha Do and a cover of Johnny Cash’s Ring of Fire both reached #1, with Ring of Fire named the Country Music Association of Ontario’s ‘Video Pick of the Month’ (Oct 2022). In 2023, I’m Owning My Crazy also hit #1, setting a record for the most #1 singles by an artist on the CICC chart.

Known for their electrifying live shows, OUC has performed at major festivals like Havelock Country Jamboree, Boothill Country Jamboree, and the Canadian National Exhibition (four years running). They’ve shared stages with artists like Lee Brice, Honeymoon Suite, and The Washboard Union, delivering a mix of original songs and reimagined classics with their signature ‘ugly cowboy spin.’
With their infectious energy and seasoned artistry, One Ugly Cowboy leaves audiences uplifted and inspired, creating unforgettable moments at every show.

name: See Spot Run
bio: See Spot Run released their fourth CD “Gonna Getcha” early in 2008. The album is a result of collaboration between See Spot Run and producer Ed Krautner (Sum 41) and featured on the album is drummer Josh Trager (Sam Roberts). The title track from “Gonna Getcha” was immediately picked up by the hit TV series DeGrassi: The Next Generation. The episode featuring the song was aired on the N Network in the USA in February 2008 and on the CTV Network in Canada in March 2008.

Their third album “Weightless” made Canadian recording history. The album’s title track was certified by BDS as being “the highest charted independent song on the rock chart since the inception of BDS”.

The “Weightless” single reached number 9 on the rock chart, number 6 on the Top 40 Chart, number 5 on the all Canadian chart, and number 1 in Quebec for the French translation “Décoller”. The follow-up single “Terrified/Terrifié” also climbed the Canadian CHR charts in both languages.
The Canadian Association of Broadcasters gave See Spot Run the “Breakout Single of The Year Award” and the band was awarded the “Concert of the Year Award” by Wired Magazine shortly thereafter.

Since releasing their second album “TEN STORIES HIGH”, See Spot Run has had 5 charting singles, 5 videos played on MuchMusic, done 7 cross Canada tours, appeared on a multitude of Canadian and international television shows, and done hundreds of interviews.

See Spot Run was the first band to launch an album at Toronto’s Air Canada Centre. The band has also sung the national anthems for the Toronto Raptors and performed at an NFL tailgate party for the Buffalo Bills.
See Spot Run was formed in Montreal by Chris Brodbeck and Randy Bowen and is based in Toronto today. Also in the band are hot young Toronto musicians Fudge (drummer) and Aaron Little (guitar).
“Weightless” and “Ten Stories High” were recorded in Montreal and produced by Gary Moffet (Sass Jordan, April Wine).

name: Teaze
bio: Any trivia buff can tell you that Windsor, Ontario, sits directly south of Detroit. That proximity is the DNA of Teaze . Breathing in the grit of the Motor City and rocking to its relentless beat, Teaze emerged not just as a Canadian band, but as a high-octane crossover of American power rock, R&B, and pure stage pizzazz.

Influenced by the raw energy of the Bob Seger System, MC5, The Stooges, and Grand Funk Railroad , Teaze stood out in the Canadian circuit like a bolt of lightning. There was an almost evangelical fervor to their performances, a brand of “un-Canadian” intensity that the world wasn’t quite ready for in the mid-70s.

After a debut in 1976 that became a cult hit in Sweden, the band signed with Aquarius Records and relocated to Montreal. Their 1977 follow-up, On the Loose , produced the massive hit “Sweet Misery.” While the track’s country-tinged success introduced them to the masses, the “real” Teaze remained a powerhouse rock act at heart.

Their legendary status was cemented internationally with the release of Tour of Japan, their first show outside of Canada and their definitive live statement. By the time they released One Night Stands , produced by April Wine’s Myles Goodwyn , they had perfected their sound. With anthems like “Heartless World” and “Young and Reckless,” the album remains a masterclass in passionate, powerful classic rock.

Though the band fragmented in the early 80s, the flame never went out. If anything, Teaze has gained a prestigious “cult classic” status over the decades. Today, they are remembered not just for their five iconic albums, but for a legacy of brash, unapologetic rock and roll that was truly ahead of its time.
Teaze is back to prove that while you might have had to be there to witness the original explosion, the music is louder and more relevant than ever.

name: Ester Finocchiaro & Rudy Mayes
bio: Meet 2B1 , a remarkable duo with over 20 years of experience delivering engaging, high-quality live music. Their unique format features a skilled piano performer supported by expertly produced accompaniment tracks, creating a rich, full sound comparable to that of a larger ensemble—while maintaining an elegant, unobtrusive setup ideal for any venue.

2B1’s versatility allows them to tailor their performance to the needs of your space and atmosphere. They can also perform as a duo with premium backing tracks, offering the same level of artistry and energy with an even more streamlined footprint.
Ester and Rudy bring professionalism, musicality, and a dynamic presence that enhances guest experience and elevates the ambience of any event or venue

Rudy Mayes is the youngest of eleven children. His influences were everything from gospel to jazz to country music. Rudy started singing at the tender age of ten and soon gave way to a unique personality with his heart-felt performances. Known as the man with the “million dollar” smile and blessed with a resonating baritone voice, Rudy has developed a unique crooner style reminiscent of the past yet has stayed true to his own natural talent. Rudy headlined his own show entitled “Unforgettable Brothers of Song”. He also performed in “The Kings of Swing and the Fabulous Crooners”. He also stars in the Black Gold show. The real magic can be seen and heard when Rudy pairs up with his singing partner of twenty years, the multitalented

Ester Finocchiaro is the youngest of three children. At the age of four Ester’s family moved to Toronto, Canada from Italy. With two older brothers that played guitar, music never lacked in their household. From the Beatles to Black Sabbath to Nat King Cole and Ella Fitzgerald. The unique combination of Rudy’s deep sexy voice and Ester’s sweet high voice is a real treat which melts the hearts of everyone who experiences their wonderful chemistry. Their contagious style has won the hearts of many Torontonians that follow them wherever they perform.

As 2B1 Ester and Rudy can be found nostalgically singing for any occasion. Their repertoire consists of over 500 songs consisting of jazz, R&B, pop/adult contemporary and rock’n’roll and have performed in theatres, corporate shows, weddings, private parties and restaurants. The dynamic duo has performed at the upscale Monte Cristo Restaurant (downtown Toronto), Ristorante 101 (Yonge and Lawrence) and 1505 North (Burlington) to name a few, occasionally accompanied by renowned jazz musician Joe Sealy.

By partnering with 2B1, you create a warm, sophisticated, and intimate ambiance. Their smooth harmonies, refined musical style, and engaging presence elevate the entire experience, transforming any gathering into something memorable and deeply felt. 2B1 brings a level of artistry and professionalism that resonates with audiences of all ages.

With their unique ability to connect with listeners, 2B1 sets a tone that is both elegant and inviting, leaving your guests with an emotional and lasting impression. Their performances enrich the atmosphere, turning ordinary moments into extraordinary ones and ensuring your event remains unforgettable long after the final note fades.

name: 7 Day Weekend
bio: Bringing you all the hits from every generation, 7 Day Weekend is truly unique in their brand of fun, diversity and variety. Current Top 40 hits from, Beyonce, Taylor Swift, The Weeknd and Harry Styles are just some of the artists showcased on the always evolving set list. If it’s rock anthems you like, 7 Day Weekend will have you singing your lungs out to favorites by Def Leppard, Journey, Bon Jovi up through Third Eye Blind, Sublime, Blink 182 and Fall Out Boy. And when you’re ready for some guilty pleasures, 7 Day Weekend has you covered on all bases. Whether it’s a medley of country classics, a mix of 90’s hip hop, or some classic Michael Jackson, Isley Brothers, Grease, or even a surprise or two, you are guaranteed to be on your feet, out of breath, begging for more.
7 Day Weekend has the ability to play intimate venues, large nightclubs, private events, black-tie affairs, weddings (large and small), outdoor festivals and everything in between.
If you’re game to sing until you lose your voice, don’t mind getting sweaty, dance up a storm, party like a rockstar, and make some new best friends in the process, come party with 7 Day Weekend!

name: Ascension Groove Motown

photo.alt: Ascension Groove Motown, R&B, Soul Funk, Jazz and Rock

bio: Ascension Groove has delighted Toronto and the GTA with top-tier music for over a decade. They have recently entertained at corporate events, weddings, bar/bat mitzvahs, and various special occasions. With performances spanning the globe, from Europe, Asia, and the Middle East to the Caribbean, Mediterranean, and Alaska Panhandle, Ascension Groove has also graced the stages of local dance clubs, casinos, and high-profile Toronto venues like the Cricket Club, Granite Club, Jockey Club, and Royal Canadian Yacht Club.

Featuring a core rhythm section of keys, bass, and drums, Ascension Groove boasts two dynamic female singers who also play percussion, guitar, and saxophone. The band’s diverse repertoire encompasses a wide range of styles and eras, from current dance and top 40 to 50’s and 60’s classics, jazz, rock, country, and even world music in languages like Spanish, Italian, Arabic, Portuguese, and French.

Adapting to any event, Ascension Groove offers musical services from a solo pianist to an eight-piece band, providing a seamless transition from intimate ceremonies to lively receptions. Their high-energy performances create unforgettable experiences that keep audiences engaged and entertained.

name: AudioworX
bio: AudioworX is a dynamic 4-piece party and dance band based in Southern Ontario, delivering an electrifying mix of hits spanning rock, pop, hip-hop, country, and dance. Known for their high-energy performances, the band has been a staple in the regional music scene, captivating audiences with their versatile setlists and infectious stage presence. From intimate bar gigs to large-scale festivals, AudioworX brings an unparalleled party atmosphere, ensuring every event is a memorable celebration. With a reputation for getting crowds on their feet, they are a go-to act for anyone looking to dance and enjoy a night of diverse, crowd-pleasing music.

The band consists of four seasoned musicians—Jim Holiko (lead vocals/guitar), Angelo Cimino (lead guitar/vocals), Randy Bourque (bass/vocals), and Stephan Przybysz (drums/vocals)—who collectively bring over 25 years of experience performing together and in various other projects. Their chemistry, honed through decades of collaboration, shines in their tight arrangements and seamless harmonies, making each performance a polished yet spontaneous experience. Regulars at prestigious venues like Fallsview Casino in Niagara Falls, AudioworX also commands the bar and pub circuit from Niagara to the Greater Toronto Area (GTA). Their extensive experience extends to corporate events, private functions, and festivals, where they tailor their sets to suit diverse audiences, from classic rock anthems to modern pop bangers and everything in between.

AudioworX’s ability to connect with audiences stems from their passion for music and commitment to delivering a good time. Each member’s vocal and instrumental versatility allows the band to cover iconic artists like The Rolling Stones, Rod Stewart, Luke Bryan, and Loverboy with authenticity and flair. Fan engagement on platforms like Facebook highlights their reputation for leaving audiences energized, with testimonials praising their ability to “keep the dance floor packed all night.” Whether performing at a local pub, a corporate gala, or a summer festival, AudioworX consistently delivers a high-octane show that blends nostalgia with contemporary hits, ensuring an unforgettable experience for music lovers of all ages.

name: Avenue Inn
bio: Avenue Inn’s journey through the Canadian music scene has been nothing short of a remarkable odyssey since their inception in 2012. Hailing from Niagara Falls, this alternative rock band has seamlessly blended their regional roots with a sonic concoction that captures the essence of their diverse musical influences.

With an impressive repertoire of shows spanning across the picturesque landscapes of southern Ontario, Avenue Inn has become a fixture in the local music circuit. The band’s dynamic stage presence and electrifying performances have not only garnered a devoted local fan base but have also earned them coveted opportunities to share the stage with acclaimed artists, including the likes of Coleman Hell and Young Empires.

Drawing inspiration from the amplified and impassioned sounds of iconic bands such as the Arctic Monkeys, Kings of Leon, and the Arkells, Avenue Inn has forged a distinctive sonic identity that marries the raw energy of indie rock with anthemic choruses. Their music is a testament to the eclectic blend of influences that have shaped their musical journey, resulting in a sound that is both familiar and refreshingly original.

In an era where music is both an art form and a cultural statement, Avenue Inn stands out as a beacon of authenticity. With their roots firmly planted in the rich musical soil of Niagara Falls and their sights set on the broader horizons of the Canadian music scene, Avenue Inn is poised to leave an indelible mark with their unique brand of alternative rock. As they continue to captivate audiences with their infectious melodies and compelling lyrics, Avenue Inn remains a band to watch, destined to carve an enduring legacy in the tapestry of Canadian music.

name: Back Swing
bio: Kingston’s Back Swing is a high energy party band playing rock and country, blues and originals. The band boasts two outstanding lead and harmony vocalists: Jim Patterson (vocals, guitar, keys) and Rick Storms (vocals, bass, guitar), both formerly of the Jim Patterson Band. Their originals gained momentum on Canadian country music charts in the early 2000s.

In addition to country and blues, Jim and Rick have extensive “rock” backgrounds. In Back Swing, Rick and Jim are joined by Laura Anderson-Brick (vocals, electric accordion-synthesizer)—who adds a whole array of orchestral sounds including piano, organ, strings, horns, and synth—John Gamache (lead guitar), and Ron Reedy (drums). Back Swing chooses their sets based on venue and audience demographics, which is why they are able to play a wide variety of festivals, and venues. The band is fully light and sound equipped.

name: Backstage Pass Band
bio: Backstage Pass Band, hailing from Whitby, Ontario, is a seasoned cover band with over three decades of experience, renowned for delivering electrifying performances across the Durham Region and Greater Toronto Area. Their infectious energy and polished stagecraft have made them a staple at venues ranging from intimate local clubs to sprawling outdoor festivals and high-profile corporate events. Specializing in a vibrant mix of R&B, Motown, classic rock, and pop, the band tailors their extensive setlist to suit any audience, ensuring every event is a hit. Their commitment to professionalism, paired with a genuine passion for music, creates an unforgettable experience that keeps crowds dancing and singing along, whether it’s a nostalgic hit from the ‘70s or a chart-topping anthem from today.

The five-member ensemble brings a wealth of talent and charisma to every performance. Raffaele Marchione, the band’s lead guitarist and vocalist, channels his love for music into soulful vocals and intricate guitar work, setting the tone for their dynamic sound. Jamie Allain, a versatile musician on keys, guitar, and vocals, infuses the band with his rich musical background, having returned to performing after a successful corporate career. Drummer Ken Robinson provides a rock-solid backbone with his precise rhythms, while bassist Brad Walker lays down grooves that keep the dance floor moving. Frontwoman Rachel Brunet captivates with her powerhouse vocals and magnetic stage presence, making Backstage Pass Band a must-see act for any occasion, from casual pub nights to grand celebrations.

name: BreakFree
bio: BreakFree is a female-fronted band covering hits from the 70s to today, spanning dance, pop, disco, rock, and modern anthems. Their shows are built for packed dance floors and singalongs, connecting with every generation. From Madonna to Dua Lipa, Miley Cyrus to Shania Twain, BreakFree balances nostalgia with relevance.

Fueled by a love for dance floor energy and sing‑at‑the‑top‑of‑your‑lungs anthems, lifelong friends Dana and Gus created BreakFree, a one-of-a-kind lineup of Canadian, Filipino, and Peruvian musicians. With crafted attention to each song and carefully designed setlists that keep crowds moving from start to finish, their performances deliver an elevated experience with a polished, elegant presence.

Since launching in March 2024, BreakFree has been lighting up events across the GTA, and with nearly two years of shows behind them, they are ready to bring this refined and electrifying experience to more venues, stages, and celebrations.
Masters at keeping crowds moving and engaged, they are the ideal choice for live entertainment-focused venues, festivals, corporate, and private events with diverse audiences.

name: The Classic Crooners Show
bio: Get ready for a musical experience like no other as Charles Di Ray and his extraordinary band transport you through a magical journey of timeless classics. Immerse yourself in the soulful melodies and captivating performances that pay homage to legendary artists such as Frank Sinatra, Dean Martin, Tony Bennett, Nat King Cole, and many more.

Charles Di Ray is a seasoned and charismatic music artist known for his soul-stirring vocals and magnetic stage presence.
