name: Emily Misura
bio: Emily Misura (also known as Stringing Him Along) is Toronto’s luxury violinist. Though she did the whole classical musician thing and got a degree in violin performance, she has extensively collaborated with bands, DJs, rappers and singer-songwriters. She has shared the stage with famous names such as The Who, The Eagles, Weird Al Yankovic, Drake, ELO, Chris Carrabba, Michael Bolton and Machine Gun Kelly ; all those names are great, but why not add yourself to the list? She won’t discriminate, nor will she bite (even though she is the human version of a Pomeranian – compact but ironically feisty.) No venue is too small or too large. She has performed at some of the most well-known venues in North America including Carnegie Hall in New York City (when she was only eighteen) as well as in your mom’s backyard. (Your mom has some beautiful rose bushes.) She has performed with ensembles of all sizes, from Mannheim Steamroller and Rocktopia to just you… maybe it’s only in your mind right now, kind of like a Christopher Nolan movie, but not. You could incept yourself and make it a reality today by booking her! Take that, Hollywood. One of Emily’s favourite places is in the studio. She records regularly and has been credited on numerous albums in a variety of genres. You can hear her on albums by MAE, Surferblood, Tides of Man, Goodnight Neverland and The Holy Gasp. She recorded her own musical comedy album because surprise! She also got a Bachelors degree in music technology. We weren’t kidding when we said she is all over the place – but in a cool, hip way rather than a you-have-no-direction-when-will-you-get-a-real-job kind of way. She also can play by ear and improvise, meaning her song catalogue is next to infinite. She alternates between electric and acoustic violins from a collection that is ever-growing. Want to hear “Méditation from Thaïs” and Rihanna in the same performance? You’ve found your violinist. Want to hear “Concerning Hobbits” and the solo in Freebird? (Who wouldn’t want to hear that, tbh) – WELL NOW YOU CAN.

name: Freedom Train
bio: Freedom Train brings the greatest songs of all time to life with an authentic respect to the essence and intensity of the original classics!
Freedom Train is dedicated to keeping the best classic songs alive by keeping it live: no backing tracks, no autotune, just pure music played with faithful precision – LIVE!

Performing over 150 shows annually (over a 1500 shows since 2010), Freedom Train has played Massey Hall, MGM Grand in Vegas, festivals, theatres, clubs, casinos, private parties and corporate events across Canada and the US.
Freedom Train continues to entertains audiences with their spin on the best of rock, R&B, funk, country and reggae.
This power-trio features the four octave vocal range of vocalist / bassist Carl Jennings, the inventive drumming of Tim Jennings and the creative guitar stylings of Matt Tennison.
Whether it’s bringing back memories of amazing musical eras or turning new listeners on to timeless songs, Freedom Train loves bringing people together to celebrate the best of times through music!

name: Heart + Soul
bio: Heart + Soul’s music draws influences from various genres, including, rock, country and blues. The band’s sound is characterized by powerful vocals, driving rhythms, and soulful guitar solos. Their main focus is to bring light and energy to their audience.

Heart + Soul is lead by the amazing lead singer, Bonnie Rabson. For as long as she could speak, Bonn knew her life would revolve around music. Though her plight began with classical/opera training, a thirst for variety soon took hold.

She entered into the world of EDM with “Dreaming”, her song that garnered millions of spins and a #1 hit for 6 straight weeks in the European radio circuit. The buzz from this tune supported a 4-week independent tour across Hungary and Serbia.

In 2017, Bonnie’s desire to explore new genres took her on a path down to Miami, FL – to develop the Country/Rock alias Bonn E Maiy. Hyper-focused at honing her craft, she released two independent LPs, toured across the USA, performed with Johnny Depp & Joe Perry, and was endorsed by Grace Slick and the estates of Janis Joplin and The Doors.

After 4 straight years away from home & family, Bonnie returned to her native land in 2021 with the desire to be part of a collaborative musical project – one where every member had a passion for music above all else.

name: Jonesy
bio: March 17th, 2004: St. Patrick’s Day. It was on this day that Jonesy played their first show together as a band. Once the first note was played, the band and the crowd both knew that something special was taking place. This was no ordinary band. From that first show to every single one since, one thing has remained constant: Jonesy are not just a part of the party… they ARE the party.

“Jonesy” is made up of 5 unique personalities from the Niagara Region. Each member has been involved with various musical projects throughout their lives, some starting at a very young age. The name “Jonesy” was guitarist Paul Lalama’s idea, respectively. No one really knows the true meaning of the name. Paul himself might not even know!

…and these boys have CRED. Scott Neilson, the powerhouse singer who many have compared to U2’s Bono, has shared the stage with big-name acts like Bryan Adams!! What does Jonesy sound like?? Take “The Killers”, throw in a dash of Coldplay, and top it off with a mix of U2 and Franz Ferdinand and you get the idea. “JONESY”, in a relatively short time, has already become a “buzz” word across Ontario. 2004 proved to be an amazing first year, and 2005 even better- as the band played it’s biggest gig yet- rocking for 50,000 people on New Years Eve in Niagara Falls.

Individual Jonesy members have won many radio station home-grown contests including Mix.99.9 and 97.7 htz fm. Keep your ears and eyes on these boys. They have already worked with some of the industries best- including David Kahne (Paul McCartney, Sublime), Arnold Lanni (Simple Plan, Our Lady Peace), and David Tyson (Celine Dion, Alanah Myles), who co-wrote and produced Jonesy’s “Undone”. The future looks very bright for Jonesy.

name: JR Hardy
bio: JR Hardy is a Canadian, multi-instrumentalist, performer and songwriter with a versatile vocal style ranging from soulful to modern pop & R&B. With deep roots in blues rock and funk, soul and hip-hop influences, his music is described as “tasty, rhythm & soul to make people move.”

With touring and studio experience, JR has performed for audiences across the country including shows in the US. When not writing and recording, he’s performing music by the artists who influenced him most—Stevie Wonder, Prince, Earth, Wind & Fire, Bruno Mars, Jamiroquai and more.

The JR HARDY Band are professional artists & performers—lifetime musicians with live, touring and studio experience. photo.alt: The Kitchen Staff Band / The Rolling Stronz

bio: The Kitchen Staff Band, also known as the Rolling Stronz, consists of four seasoned professional musicians/singers with decades of experience in entertaining.

The musical equipment is all made from parts of old junked Kitchen parts and equipment which furthers the story that the band is from the kitchen. Despite what the equipment looks like, the equipment is all pro gear made to look like junk. What also makes this band unique is that all equipment and microphones are wireless allowing the act to move freely throughout the guests in order to provide a truly unique entertainment experience.

Once the band starts the guests are sure to have a great time dancing and singing to their all time favourites ranging from the Beatles to Bruno Mars. One of the highlights of the show is during a segment where guests are invited to join the band and are also given their own instruments also made from junked kitchen parts.

No two shows are ever the same. They have several routines and are always revamping their shows. They are always pushing the boundaries of technology and entertainment. They are innovative and engaging!

The Kitchen Staff Band is a truly a unique and entertaining act, and guarantee that your guests will be talking about this truly memorable evening for many years to come. So If you’re looking for something different/out of the ordinary to entertain your crowd, then you’ve come to the right place.

name: Neon Nostalgic
bio: Brace yourself for an unparalleled experience, a high-energy rock show that takes the form of a LIVE BAND VIDEO DANCE PARTY. It’s not just a concert; it’s a journey through the heart and soul of the most iconic music of two unforgettable decades.

Picture this: your favorite hits brought to life by professional, internationally renowned musicians who not only play the tunes but synchronize them seamlessly with the actual original music videos. It’s a sensory explosion that combines the auditory thrill of a live band with the visual spectacle of the era’s legendary music videos.

Neon Nostalgic isn’t just a show; it’s an invitation to dance, sing, and relive the magic of the past. So, dust off your neon attire, lace-up those high-tops, and join us for a night where the music of the 1980s and 1990s comes alive in a way you’ve never experienced before. Get ready to be swept away by the beats, mesmerized by the visuals, and lost in the Neon Nostalgic groove.

name: Old School Rewind
bio: Founded in October 2024 through a network of friends and a shared love of live music, Old School Rewind is a five-piece band built around one simple goal: play great songs, play them well, and make sure everyone in the room has a memorable time.

Old School Rewind brings together decades of music in a high-energy set that has something for just about everyone. Their repertoire reaches back to select favourites from the ’60s and ’70s, moves through the unforgettable pop and rock of the ’80s, dives into the classic and alternative rock that defined the ’90s, and carries right into the 2000s with crowd-pleasing rock, pop, and dance-floor favourites.

Rather than being tied to one particular era or style, Old School Rewind is about the songs people remember, the ones that make you turn your head when you hear the opening riff, sing along with the chorus, or get up and hit the dance floor. Rock, alternative, pop, classic rock and everything in between all have a place in the show.

With a set list designed to keep the energy moving, Old School Rewind aims to make every performance feel like a trip through some of the best music of the last several decades. Whether they’re playing a bar, festival, party, private event, or community celebration, the goal is the same: bring people together, keep the crowd involved, and make the night one worth remembering.
Old songs. New favourites. Great memories. Old School Rewind

name: One Ugly Cowboy
bio: ONE UGLY COWBOY (OUC) is a high-energy Toronto-based country/rock band fronted by powerhouse vocalist Hurricane Jane . Blending gritty country vibes with edgy rock, OUC delivers heartfelt, often humorous original tunes—and a bold twist on classics.

Founded by vocalist Jane Sowerby and guitarist/producer Richard Zwic, the duo brings decades of experience. Jane, a former L.A.-based performer managed by industry heavyweights, has over 100 film/TV credits. Richard has played alongside Canadian rock legends and worked with JUNO winners.

Joined by Rick Ottenbrite (bass) and Mike Mann (drums), OUC released their debut EP Get Yer Ugly On in 2015 and full-length album Ride With The Wind in 2020—landing six Top 5 singles on the Canadian Indie Country Countdown, including multiple #1s.

Recent hits like I’m Owning My Crazy and their fiery cover of Ring of Fire have earned chart-topping success, video accolades, and multiple award nominations—including at the Josie Music Awards and Texas Sounds International Music Awards.
With performances at major festivals and support slots for artists like Lee Brice and Honeymoon Suite, OUC is known for shows that are unforgettable, uplifting, and uniquely “ugly.”

name: Orangeman
bio: Florida is famous for its oranges, and some of the best oranges come from Lakeland in Polk County, Florida. Situated in the center of a triangle bounded by Walt Disney World, Cypress Gardens and Busch Gardens, Lakeland is also a hotbed for the growth of exceptional entertainers and musicians. Let us introduce you to ORANGEMAN.

This is a band that is all about orange. From its four members Sonny D, OJ, Vitamin C and Tang, to its clothing and stage, it’s all orange, orange, orange! ORANGEMAN brings a dose of Florida sunshine and spirit wherever they go. Putting on a non-stop show featuring top party songs from every era, ORANGEMAN’s music is played to perfection. Their strong vocals are only matched by their fun and outgoing personalities. Fronted by drummer “Tang” the stage is immediately different. Put on your best beach gear and sandals. Get out your straw hat and shades cause the sun will be shining when ORANGEMAN comes to town.

The band’s unique sound and energy have made them a favorite at various venues across Southern Ontario, where they regularly perform at clubs, bars, and festivals. Otis Wonder & The Hustle’ promises an unforgettable musical journey every time they take the stage.

name: Revolver and Friends
bio: The band was initially founded as “Revolver” in 1981. The band was the opening act at the Lulu’s Roadhouse 20th anniversary British Invasion Show in 1984, sharing the stage with Gerry and The Pacemakers and Herman’s Hermits. In addition, the band performed with The Troggs, Billy J. Kramer, Badfinger, and Chuck Mangione, as well as numerous times at Toronto’s CNE and Ontario Place Forum.

The current version of the band is called “Revolver and Friends”, and performs a first-rate musical tribute to The Beatles, as well as the hits of other bands from the 60’s, 70’s and 80’s. They pride themselves in their vocal harmonies and professional stage presentation.
All of the members of Revolver and Friends are seasoned, professional musicians, with countless years of stage experience.

name: Rudy and Saddle Up
bio: Eastern Ontario’s ROCKIN’ PARTY band, the band that ROCKS the stage with their high energy blend of HOT new country and southern rock. Enjoy the ride!

Rudy has been heating up the stage with his live performances since 2000. His passion for singing was evident to his audiences when he began competing in numerous singing competitions including the 2006 and 2007 Kingston Fall Fair Country Singing Showdown and the 2007 city-division finals of the Colgate Singing Competition. In all three competitions, he competed in as one of the top ten finalists. Through the many wins in local competitions, Rudy has developed a large fan base that is still growing.

Rudy’s popularity as a performer grew between 2003 and 2007 through his solo performances at area jamborees, charity fundraisers and local clubs. His popularity continued to climb through his various guest singing appearances with some of Eastern Ontario’s top performing and recording bands. It was through these performances that Rudy & Saddle Up was born and all are enjoying the ride!

Since the band’s conception in 2007, Rudy and Saddle Up has opened for George Canyon (twice), Chad Brownlee, Bobby Wills, The Road Hammers, Tim Hicks, David Wilcox, Honeymoon Suite and many more! They have performed at The Havelock Jamboree, The Tweed Stampede and numerous fairs in Eastern Ontario.
If you are looking for a high energy entertaining band for your event… Rudy and Saddle Up IS the right choice!

name: Runaway Dixie
bio: Runaway Dixie is a dynamic new country band bringing fresh energy, powerhouse vocals, and a whole lot of heart to the stage.

Fronted by a powerful lead vocalist, Runaway Dixie delivers an exciting mix of today’s hottest country hits, classic country favourites, and crowd-pleasing anthems with a touch of southern rock and crossover favourites.

From boot-stomping party songs and dance floor favourites to heartfelt ballads and singalong classics, Runaway Dixie knows how to keep audiences entertained. With a sound that blends modern country attitude, a little grit, and plenty of soul, the band brings something for everyone to enjoy.
Whether it’s a country bar, festival, fair, or special event, Runaway Dixie is ready to turn up the energy, fill the dance floor, and keep the good times rolling.

name: Stone House Road
bio: Stone House Road are a seasoned five-piece pop-rock cover band based in the Niagara region, dedicated to delivering high-energy performances that connect with audiences of all kinds. Their repertoire spans decades of iconic hits alongside today’s most recognizable tracks, carefully curated to keep the dance floor full and the atmosphere electric. With tight musicianship, rich vocal harmonies, and a natural chemistry that comes from years of experience, they bring a polished, professional sound to every stage they step on.

Whether it’s a corporate event, festival, private function, or an intimate night at a bar or pub, they adapt to the room and elevate the experience. From the first note to the final encore, their focus is simple: create a show that feels effortless, engaging, and memorable. Stone House Road isn’t just about playing songs, it’s about delivering moments your guests will talk about long after the night ends.

Michelle Hedley brings powerful lead vocals, rhythm guitar, and a songwriter’s sensibility shaped by a decade of rapid growth in the local music scene. Stu Hendrie is a versatile guitarist and producer with deep roots in 80s and 90s rock and pop, backed by extensive studio and touring experience. Shawn Hall adds texture and soul, blending a background in punk and industrial with a present-day focus on roots and country influences. Dave Green lays down the foundation with groove-driven bass, drawing from over 30 years of experience across genres from metal to alternative. Michael Scott anchors the band on drums, a highly respected and in-demand musician known for his adaptability, professionalism, and decades of performance and studio work.

Join them as they bring the timeless and the trending together, creating musical moments that resonate across generations and venues.

name: Sugarboom
bio: With roots firmly planted in the vibrant musical landscape of Sudbury, Ontario, Sugarboom embarked on their sonic journey back in 2003. Since then, they have become synonymous with electrifying performances that captivate audiences of all ages throughout the North. Renowned for their infectious energy and versatile repertoire, Sugarboom stands as one of the most sought-after dance bands in the region.

Comprised of seasoned musicians whose passion for music knows no bounds, Sugarboom delivers unforgettable performances that transcend boundaries and ignite the dance floor. From intimate weddings to pulsating dance clubs, from corporate galas to lively festivals, Sugarboom infuses every occasion with an undeniable groove and an irresistible charm.

With a diverse repertoire spanning genres and eras, Sugarboom guarantees a musical experience that caters to every taste. Whether it’s classic hits that evoke nostalgia, contemporary chart-toppers that keep the party alive, or soul-stirring ballads that tug at the heartstrings, Sugarboom delivers with finesse and flair.

Available as small as a 4-piece band, or as large as a 9-piece band, SWITSwitchbeat CHBEAT offers a lineup to suit your needs and budget.

Since the band’s inception in 2014, Switchbeat has received outstanding reviews from performances at corporate events, weddings, festivals, casinos, nightclubs, and private functions. Passionate, talented, energetic and professional, Switchbeat promises to be a memorable addition to your event. Serving Toronto and most of Ontario.

name: The Audio Saints
bio: Get Ready to Rock with The Audio Saints!

Get ready to turn up the volume with The Audio Saints , southern Ontario’s premier live music sensation! This high-energy cover band brings a powerhouse mix of classic rock, modern hits, dance favorites, and country anthems to every stage they play. Known for their electrifying performances, tight musicianship, and dynamic stage presence, The Audio Saints deliver a show that keeps audiences singing, dancing, and wanting more.
Fronted by some of Canada’s most respected performers, The Audio Saints combine decades of professional experience into one unforgettable act.

The band features legendary guitarist and songwriter Gary Borden, whose credits include iconic Canadian acts such as April Wine, The Guess Who, Helix, Sass Jordan, Toronto, Gowan, and Blood of Van Gogh. His fiery solos and undeniable stage charisma set the tone for an incredible musical experience.

Holding down the rhythm section is bassist Doug Evans (Blood of Van Gogh, Shindig, Renegade) and drummer Rob Wells (Tim Hicks Band, Ice Nine, Planet Groove, Pink Floyd Niagara). Together, they create a groove so solid it shakes the room.

Rounding out the lineup is powerhouse vocalist Rob Cave, known for his soulful, commanding presence as frontman of the award-winning Niagara band Vinyl Flux. His dynamic voice and charisma bring every song—old or new—to life.

From classic Motown grooves and vintage rock anthems to today’s biggest hits, The Audio Saints’ setlist crosses genres and generations. Whether performing at festivals, casinos, corporate events, or private parties, this versatile band delivers a concert-style experience that energizes every crowd.

Their passion for live music, connection with the audience, and professional polish make The Audio Saints one of Ontario’s top event bands and a must-see act for anyone who loves great live entertainment.

name: The Campfire Poets
bio: If variety is the spice of life, The Campfire Poets are loaded with flavour.

Hailing from Dufferin County, Ontario, ‘The Poets’ have played every occasion possible and are always a huge success. Specializing in Parties, Weddings and Corporate Functions, The Campfire Poets have the experience to entertain and involve any crowd.

Great parties need great music and this band delivers 5 decades of classics from several genres. Jason Mraz to Lynard Skynard, The Eagles to Great Big Sea, Bob Marley to Johnny Cash. Rock to blues to reggae to country to Celtic, all cooked up by a dynamic, high energy band
So who are The Campfire Poets?

The band starts with it’s founding members, Geoff Canlett and Ryan Hancock, also known as “RnG” Playing together for over a decade, this duo has developed a chemistry that is seldom matched. The RnG duo can fill a room with as much sound as most bands, and incorporate the audience like no other. With a songlist of over 200 songs, they can please any audience!

name: The Doubts
bio: The Doubts comprise a seasoned ensemble of musicians with a knack for igniting the dance floor. Versatility is their forte as they effortlessly traverse through an eclectic array of musical styles, ranging from the timeless classics of Aerosmith and ZZ Top to the latest chart-toppers from artists like the Killers, Pink, and Rihanna.

What sets The Doubts apart is their exceptional vocal prowess, delivered by a dynamic trio of lead singers: Erin Benoit, Eric Lam, and Neil Teixeira. Their ability to tackle any genre, regardless of the artist’s gender, is matched by their seamless harmonies, often featuring intricate three or four-part arrangements. Witnessing their performances, women are compelled to rise to their feet, men are left in awe, and everyone departs with a sense of exhilaration.
The Doubts are primed to electrify nightclubs, corporate gatherings, and any venue where the desire to groove is palpable. Prepare to shake it like never before with The Doubts at the helm.

name: The Mad Hatters
bio: For over 15 years, The Madhatters have been igniting stages and captivating audiences with their electrifying performances. From the pulsating energy of corporate functions to the romantic ambiance of weddings and the intimate vibe of bar shows, this band has traversed every musical terrain with unwavering enthusiasm, pride, and an undeniable swell of talent.

Formed with a shared passion for music and a commitment to delivering unforgettable experiences, The Madhatters have become synonymous with dynamic live performances. With a repertoire that spans genres, from classic rock anthems to soulful ballads, ensuring there’s something for everyone in their diverse setlists.

With each member bringing their unique flair and expertise to the stage, The Madhatters create an irresistible fusion of sound that resonates with audiences of all ages. Their seamless blend of musicianship, showmanship, and infectious energy has earned them a devoted following and a reputation as one of the most sought-after live acts on the circuit.

bio: High-Energy Rock, Pop, Country, and Dance Hits—A Show You’ll Never Forget!

Fronted by the charismatic and powerhouse vocalist Sandra Hosgood, The Sandra Good Band (SGB) has earned a reputation for delivering high-energy performances that leave audiences on their feet and begging for more. With over 14 years of experience and more than 700 shows under their belt, SGB has captivated fans across Ontario with their eclectic mix of rock, country, dance, and pop music.

This dynamic group of seasoned musicians is more than just a band—they’re a celebration of music, passion, and live performance. Sandra’s commanding stage presence, paired with her driving vocals, ignites every stage she steps on. The band’s chemistry is undeniable, having honed their craft together over a decade of non-stop performances. From intimate venues to massive festival stages, SGB brings unmatched energy and an electric atmosphere wherever they perform.
SGB’s impressive resume includes sold-out venues and massive crowds at some of Ontario’s most iconic locations and events, such as:

Whether it’s a festival, corporate function, or club circuit, SGB brings the same level of excitement, professionalism, and fun to every performance. Their adaptability and wide-ranging setlist have made them a go-to band for any occasion.

Above all, SGB loves what they do. Their passion for music is reflected in every note they play and every moment they spend on stage. When you book The Sandra Good Band, you’re not just getting a performance—you’re getting an experience.

With an extensive repertoire of songs, spanning various genres and eras, Three for the Show guarantees to entertain and delight audiences of all tastes and ages.

name: Tin Roof
bio: Tin Roof isn’t just a music duo; it’s a heartfelt journey through the soulful melodies, all woven together by the harmonious voices of husband and wife duo, Stacey and Adam Gagliardi. Based in the picturesque Niagara region, Tin Roof is a musical gem that shines bright against the backdrop of rolling vineyards and majestic waterfalls.

With their crisp harmonies and genuine chemistry on stage, Stacey and Adam bring a refreshing authenticity to every performance. Their voices blend seamlessly, creating a rich tapestry of sound that resonates with audiences of all ages. But it’s not just their voices that set Tin Roof apart; it’s their stripped-down approach to music that truly makes them stand out. Armed with little more than their guitars and a passion for storytelling, Stacey and Adam deliver a raw and intimate experience that feels both timeless and contemporary. Their song selection is as diverse as it is eclectic, spanning the breadth of country and rock music with equal parts reverence and innovation.

But beyond their musical talents, what truly sets Tin Roof apart is their unwavering passion for what they do. With each strum of the guitar and each heartfelt lyric, Stacey and Adam pour their hearts and souls into their music, creating an experience that is as authentic as it is unforgettable.

name: UK Calling
bio: UK Calling: The Sound of an Era, Reimagined
UK Calling brings to life the hits that most wouldn’t dare touch—Bronski Beat, The Style Council, The Cure—this is the soundtrack of a generation, performed with intensity, nuance, and flair.

What sets this band apart isn’t just the setlist—it’s the spirit. More than just vintage sunglasses and a synth preset, this seven-piece outfit, complete with a full horn section, delivers a live show that’s electric, authentic, and relentlessly energetic. They don’t coast on nostalgia; they ignite it. From the unmistakable mood of Joy Division to the kinetic punch of Madness and the layered elegance of Tears for Fears, UK Calling doesn’t just play the songs—they inhabit them. And with Peter James Fox at the helm—a frontman whose tenor voice is as commanding as it is captivating—audiences are swept into a full-bodied experience that’s impossible to resist.

Described by fans as “just like the old CFNY,” UK Calling is Canada’s definitive tribute to the golden age of British alternative music. Think New Wave, 2 Tone Ska, and Post-Punk. No power ballads, no pop queens—just the cool, the bold, and the unforgettable.
Since 2018, they’ve been filling venues and keeping dance floors alive across Ontario. If you know the era, you’ll find your favorites here. If you don’t, you’re about to discover why it mattered.

bio: Unforgettable is a vibrant live stage show celebrating the timeless music of some of the world’s most legendary entertainers. At the heart of the production is Rudy Mayes , a charismatic performer with a powerful, polished voice and an engaging stage presence that brings classic songs to life with warmth, style, and personality.

Backed by a talented group of vocalists and a five-piece all-star band, the show moves effortlessly through a wide range of musical styles, from soul and Motown to pop, country, rock, and classic standards. Audiences will hear memorable songs made famous by artists such as Nat King Cole, Louis Armstrong, Ray Charles, Marvin Gaye, Tom Jones, Tina Turner, Kenny Rogers, Whitney Houston, Diana Ross, Glen Campbell, ABBA, and many more.

Packed with familiar favorites, strong musicianship, and plenty of showmanship, Unforgettable is a fast-moving celebration of songs that have stood the test of time. With Rudy Mayes leading the way, the production delivers an entertaining, polished, and nostalgia-filled experience built around the music audiences know and love.

photo.alt: Canadian tribute to Rush Permanent Waves

bio: Permanent Waves is one of the premier, authentic, three-piece tributes to the Canadian progressive rock band, performed by incredibly passionate, and talented musicians. Permanent Waves brings the skill, spirit, and dedication, that it takes to bring Rush’s complex compositions to life, live.
Rush is arguably one of the greatest rock bands of all time, having sold more than 40 million records world wide in a career spanning forty plus years.

Located in Toronto, Canada, these seasoned musicians have been greatly influenced over the years by the music of RUSH, and take pride in recreating, honoring and dedicating themselves to recreating the music of one of their favorite bands, RUSH.

Permanent Waves: “A Show Of Rush” celebrates the music of Rush. Featuring selections from 2112, A Farewell to Kings, Permanent Waves, Moving Pictures, Signals, Hold Your Fire and Grace Under Pressure… Performed by Rush fans, for Rush fans!

page_title: Bill Haley Jr. and The Comets
name: Bill Haley Jr. & The Comets
bio: If only for the impact of “Rock Around the Clock”, Bill Haley would deserve a place in the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame (He was inducted in 1987)! Yet his impact in the early days of Rock and Roll went well beyond that milestone! Two years earlier he’d put out “Crazy, Man, Crazy” an original amalgam of country and R&B that arguably became the first rock and roll record to register on Billboard’s pop chart! For most of the Fifties, Bill Haley was a presence on the record charts, and he appeared in several rock and roll movies aimed at teenagers. It is estimated that Bill Haley and His Comets have sold 60 million records worldwide. How important was “Rock Around the Clock”? “Before it became a hit in summer 1955 – more than a year after it was recorded – Rock ‘n’ Roll was virtually an underground movement, something kids listened to on the sly,” wrote journalist Alex Frazer-Harrison. “This changed after ‘Rock Around the Clock.’ The music was everywhere!” Bill Haley has been called “The Father of Rock and Roll” and “Rock ‘n’ Roll’s first star!” “We premiered it,” he told Rolling Stone in 1967. “We put country & western together with rhythm & blues, and that was rock. The first three years were ours, all ours, till [Elvis] Presley came along.” Bill Haley even helped give Rock and Roll its name! Bill Haley penned a song called “Rock-A-Beatin’ Boogie” – whose chorus went “Rock, rock, rock everybody/Roll, roll, roll everybody” – that was recorded by the Treniers in 1953 and adopted by disc jockey Alan Freed on his Cleveland-based Moondog radio show!
Now his Son, Bill Haley Jr. & The Comets, recapture the heyday of his famous father and The Comets and carry on the tradition his father started!

Re-creating the Music, the Feel, the Excitement, the Authentic Stage Costuming and the Energy, Bill Haley Jr. & The Comets will transport audiences back to the very beginning of Rock & Roll! Audiences will be on their feet, dancing in the aisles and singing along to every song during this incredible, All-Ages, Affordable Show!! Hear All Your Favorite Hits Like… Rock Around The Clock, See Ya Later Alligator, Shake, Rattle & Roll, Razzle Dazzle, Don’t Knock The Rock, Dim, Dim The Lights, Rock-A-Beatin’ Boogie, Rockit 88, Rock This Joint, Skinnie Minnie and many, many more! RE-LIVE ROCK & ROLL HISTORY!

name: Black Gold – Motown’s Greatest Hits

photo.alt: blaclk gold - the music of motown

bio: Black Gold is a powerhouse musical journey through the golden eras of Motown, R&B, Soul, Disco, and Rock ’n’ Roll. This talent-packed revue celebrates the music that changed the world, from the timeless sound of Motown’s early days to the unforgettable hits of modern music legends.

At its heart, Black Gold tells the story of Motown’s evolution brought to life through the songs of beloved icons such as The Temptations, The Four Tops, Diana Ross & The Supremes, Donna Summer, Lionel Richie, Marvin Gaye, Tina Turner, Whitney Houston, Barry White, Lou Rawls, Sam Cooke, Dionne Warwick, Aretha Franklin, Al Green, Martha & The Vandellas, Mary Wells, Stevie Wonder, Michael Jackson, The Driftersand many more.

Each performance is a heartfelt tribute to the voices, rhythms, and melodies that shaped generations. While many of these songs are musically simple, their lyrics speak volumes, about love, hope, unity, and the human spirit. This is music that uplifts, inspires, and brings people together. The show’s underlying message is one of connection: loving one another and working together to make the world a better place. It’s more than a concert, it’s music that touches your soul. Black Gold is a high-energy, two-hour stage spectacular that leaves audiences singing, dancing, and cheering to the the classic Motown hits!

name: Tribute to Bob Seger
bio: New England’s Most Authentic Tribute to Bob Seger

Since 2010, Live Bullet has been thrilling audiences throughout New England with explosive, high-energy performances that capture the sound and excitement of Bob Seger at his live best. More than a traditional tribute band, Live Bullet recreates the feel of a full-scale Seger concert, delivering more than three hours of timeless hits, fan favorites, and deep cuts with the intensity and authenticity these songs deserve.

At the heart of the Live Bullet experience are the legendary live arrangements heard on Bob Seger’s iconic albums Live Bullet and Nine Tonight . These are not simply studio versions played note for note. The band brings to life the powerful concert arrangements, extended grooves, soaring vocals, dynamic instrumentation, and raw energy that made Seger and the Silver Bullet Band one of the greatest live rock acts of all time.

From the opening notes to the final encore, Live Bullet takes audiences on a journey through one of the most celebrated catalogs in American rock and roll. Sing along to classics like “Old Time Rock and Roll,” “Night Moves,” “Hollywood Nights,” “Against the Wind,” “Mainstreet,” “Rock and Roll Never Forgets,” and “We’ve Got Tonight.” Feel the room come alive with favorites like “Her Strut,” “Katmandu,” “Ramblin’ Gamblin’ Man,” and “Beautiful Loser.” Then settle in for the unmistakable emotion of “Turn the Page,” along with deep cuts and longtime fan favorites such as “Heavy Music” that make every Live Bullet show something special.

Bob Seger’s music has always been about more than hit records. His songs tell stories about working hard, growing older, falling in love, looking back, moving forward, and trying to make sense of the road in between. They are honest, unpretentious, uplifting, and unmistakably American. From hard-driving rock and roll to deeply personal ballads, Seger created a body of work that has connected with generations of listeners for more than five decades.

name: Boogie Wonder Band
bio: And the Boogie Wonder Band has been doing it real since 1996. Bringing their world famous show to the four corners of the earth… and everywhere in between! Building huge fan support along the way, with stops in Japan, China, Europe, the Caribbean, South America and all of North America, the Boogie Wonder Band crosses cultural barriers like no other.

Thru their journeys, the band has played with many of those that came before, including Kool & The Gang, Village People, Rick James, War, Chic, KC and the Sunshine Band, Gloria Gaynor and a who’s who of funk and disco.

A fan favorite to all, BWB has entertained celebrities, such as Donald Trump, Celine Dion, Jon Bon Jovi, Earth Wind & Fire, New Year’s Eve at the Breakers in Palm Beach, Florida (featured in an A&E TV special), as well as The Paris Casino Las Vegas Millenium Celebration. Galas, Premieres and also top casinos around the world including Venetian Macau, Sands Macau, Mohegan Sun, Taj Mahal, Caesars, Las Vegas Hilton, Excalibur, Foxwoods, Beau Rivage, Montreal Casino (65 sold out shows), and many more!

The Boogie Wonder Band continues to rev up the crowds at major sporting events around the world, highlights include Formula 1 Grand Prix events in Monaco, Indianapolis and Montreal, PGA events across North America, Montreal’s Bell Center for numerous concerts and National Anthems, Montreal Alouettes Halftime show and the CFL Grey Cup!

The corporate world has embraced BWB, and when companies, such as McDonald’s, IBM, General Electric, Walt Disney, Bombardier, Club Med, Cirque du Soleil, Emirates airlines, etc. want to “Raise the Roof” they know where to turn! From theatres and showrooms (Artsquest, PA, Brooklyn Bowl, NY to name a few) to large outdoor festivals such as Celebrate Erie (75000) , Canada Day in Old Montreal (100000) the often imitated but never duplicated Boogie Wonder Band is keeping it real by continuing to set the standard by which all other bands are judged.

name: Tribute to Buddy Holly
bio: Brian Hanslip has been captivating audiences for years with his tribute performances to the legendary rock and roll pioneer, Buddy Holly. Born and raised in Canada, Brian discovered his passion for music at a young age. His talent for playing the guitar and his unique vocal style soon drew comparisons to Buddy Holly, inspiring him to pay homage to the late musician. Brian’s performances as Buddy Holly are more than just a musical act; they are a journey back in time. With his signature thick-rimmed glasses, a suit reminiscent of the 1950s, and a Fender Stratocaster always in hand, Brian embodies the spirit and energy of Buddy Holly on stage. His renditions of classic hits like “That’ll Be The Day”, “Peggy Sue”, and “Rave On” have been praised for their authenticity and attention to detail. In addition to his musical talents, Brian’s engaging stage presence and charismatic personality have made him a favorite among audiences. His performances are not only a tribute to Buddy Holly’s music but also to his enduring legacy in the world of rock and roll. Brian Hanslip’s dedication to preserving the memory of Buddy Holly through his tribute performances is a testament to his love for music and respect for one of its greatest icons.

name: Canadian Bacon
bio: Born from a shared love of Canada’s greatest rock legends, Canadian Bacon delivers the heart, soul, and spirit of classic Canadian rock to every stage they play. Inspired by iconic acts like The Tragically Hip, Rush, Bryan Adams, April Wine, Triumph, and Loverboy, the band set out to honor the soundtrack of a nation while bringing their own raw energy and passion to each performance. What started as a group of friends jamming to their favorite records quickly grew into one of the most authentic Canadian rock tribute experiences around.

With powerful vocals, rich harmonies, and dynamic guitar-driven sound, Canadian Bacon captures the essence of the songs Canadians grew up with. Every member is a seasoned musician with years of stage experience, and together they recreate the unmistakable tones, rhythms, and emotional punch of the classics, from anthemic stadium hits to nostalgic deep cuts. Their shows are more than just performances, they’re a journey through the golden era of Canadian rock music.

Whether headlining festivals, rocking local venues, or playing private events, Canadian Bacon brings audiences together in celebration of Canada’s musical legacy. Fans of all ages sing along, dance, and relive the songs that defined generations. Passionate, authentic, and proudly Canadian, the band keeps these timeless hits alive and reminds us why Canada’s rock roots run deep.

bio: Experience the electrifying pulse of Nashville right in Canada with the Country Collective Tribute Tour, reigning as the nation’s premier destination for country music aficionados. Immerse yourself in the timeless melodies of iconic artists such as Keith Urban, Toby Keith, and the homegrown legends of Blue Rodeo.

Crafted by a team of seasoned musicians, each meticulously selected by the impersonators themselves, our show boasts decades of collective experience and illustrious careers spanning over 30 years. From the soulful twang of Toby Keith to the heart-pounding anthems of Keith Urban, every performance promises an authentic journey through the heart of country music, complete with dazzling costume changes that transport you straight to the honky-tonks of Music City.

Country Collective is a celebration for the whole family. The vibrant, family-friendly atmosphere ensures that fans of all ages can come together to revel in the magic of country music, creating cherished memories that will last a lifetime. Join us for an unforgettable evening that pays homage to the legends of country and ignites the spirit of Nashville right here in Canada.

name: Tribute to Fleetwood Mac
bio: Canada’s premier tribute to Stevie Nicks and Fleetwood Mac, Fleetwood Nicks delivers an unforgettable live experience built around the songs, harmonies, and atmosphere that made these artists legendary. From the timeless classics of Rumours to the most beloved highlights of Stevie Nicks’ solo career, the show also celebrates her iconic collaborations with Tom Petty, bringing decades of unforgettable music to life with passion, precision, and powerful stage presence.

At the heart of the production is Christina, whose commanding vocals, signature style, and magnetic presence capture the mystery, strength, and unmistakable spirit of Stevie Nicks. Julie Long brings warmth and elegance to the role of Christine McVie, recreating her distinctive voice and effortless musicianship. Together, they revive the rich harmonies and emotional chemistry that helped define the sound of Fleetwood Mac.

Steve David takes on the music of both Lindsey Buckingham and Mike Campbell with exceptional versatility, moving seamlessly between the distinctive tones of the Rick Turner and Rickenbacker guitars. His dynamic playing and attention to detail help recreate not only the sound of Fleetwood Mac, but also the unmistakable guitar-driven energy of Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers. Backed by a seasoned band of professional musicians, Fleetwood Nicks delivers polished arrangements, soaring harmonies, and the kind of musical authenticity that makes every performance feel complete.

Audiences can expect an evening filled with fan favourites such as “Landslide,” “Leather and Lace,” “Stop Draggin’ My Heart Around,” and many more, along with beloved songs from Fleetwood Mac’s celebrated catalogue and Stevie Nicks’ solo career. More than a tribute concert, Fleetwood Nicks is a heartfelt celebration of Stevie Nicks, Fleetwood Mac, Tom Petty, and the enduring legacy of some of rock music’s most iconic performers.

name: Tribute to Marilyn Monroe, Shania Twain, Joan Rivers & Katy Perry

photo.alt: Hollywood Divas Tribute to Marilyn Monroe, Shania Twain, Joan Rivers & Katy Perry

bio: A unique tribute show featuring celebrity tribute artist, Zahava!
Zahava plays a LIVE tribute to Marilyn Monroe, Shania Twain, Joan Rivers & Katy Perry all in one evening & all live vocals!

As a young girl, Zahava loved to sing & fell in love with Marilyn Monroe upon receiving an image of Marilyn & watching the film “Gentleman Prefer Blondes” Zahava wanted to know more about this beautiful soft spoken comedic actress. She always felt a real personal connection to Marilyn, which is why she is able to portray the icon so perfectly. She read many books written about Marilyn, watched all her films and went into acting. She wanted to present Marilyn in the most beautiful & positive light. Zahava always saw Marilyn as a delicate soul & loved her ability to captivate an audience. Zahava’s first impromptu show was in Jamaica on stage at a resort while on vacation at the age of 9. She was elated when she received a standing ovation & quickly realized this was her true calling in life! She sang “It’s a small world after all” Singing made her feel so free, happy and alive. She was singing in high school fashion shows at 17 & for Weddings at the age of 21 with a wedding cover band. Music touches her heart and soul. She can even sing in several languages.
Zahava adores dressing up and looking elegant. Just like her idol Marilyn.
Zahava’s celebrity characters are a perfect combination of class, humour, wit, creativity & talent. Zahava hand picked all these roles because they truly encompass who she is.

Zahava has a fire within her that is rare to see and she is a gifted performer. She shockingly recreates all 4 personas in one evening! Zahava is celebrating over 20 years as a successful tribute artist. Her passion is her driving force! If you’re looking for a real celebrity experience, book Zahava for your next event today!

bio: Welcome to the electrifying world of ‘The Power of Huey: A Tribute to Huey Lewis and the News’, where the timeless tunes of one of America’s most beloved bands come alive with unparalleled energy and authenticity.

Led by the charismatic Dave Statham channeling the spirit of Huey Lewis himself, our tribute band captures the essence and excitement of the iconic group’s music, delivering unforgettable performances that will have you dancing and singing along all night long.

With spot-on renditions of classics like ‘The Power of Love’, ‘Hip to Be Square’, and ‘Heart and Soul’, we pay homage to the signature sound and infectious energy that made Huey Lewis and the News a household name.

Whether you’re a die-hard fan reminiscing about the glory days of ’80s rock or a newcomer eager to experience the magic for the first time, ‘The Power of Huey’ promises a night of pure entertainment and nostalgia that will leave you craving more.
Join us as we celebrate the timeless music of Huey Lewis and the News, and get ready to have the time of your life!

name: Kasmir tribute to Led Zeppelin – USA

photo.alt: Kasmir tribute to Led Zeppelin - USA

bio: KASHMIR featuring Jean Violet is more than just a tribute band; it is an immersive experience that brings the iconic music of Led Zeppelin to life. Founded by vocalist Jean Violet in 2000, the band has evolved from performing on the streets of New York City to becoming one of the premier Led Zeppelin tribute acts, captivating audiences both nationally and internationally.

When you attend a KASHMIR concert, you are not just listening to music; you are experiencing the mythos and magic of Led Zeppelin. The band performs both the legendary hits and deep cuts that have resonated with fans for decades. The show is a visual and auditory feast, offering the dynamic stage presence and musical prowess that one would expect from a true Led Zeppelin performance.

Jean Violet embodies the spirit of a young Robert Plant with his long, golden mane and powerful, seductive vocals. His performance is a testament to Plant’s influence and charisma, capturing the essence of Led Zeppelin’s legendary frontman.

Kevin Slover channels the energy of a young Jimmy Page, donning the iconic black dragon suit and strutting the stage with confidence. His guitar work is a blend of power and finesse, delivering the blistering riffs and solos that defined Page’s style.

Multi-instrumentalist Tommy James takes on the role of “Jonesy” with ease, inspired by the creativity and musicianship of John Paul Jones. Having performed these songs live for many years, James is a natural fit, providing the intricate bass lines and keyboard melodies that are essential to Led Zeppelin’s sound.

David Blampied, the “keeper of the groove,” masterfully recreates the drumming of John Bonham. He is equally adept at delivering subtle, nuanced passages as well as the thunderous beats that drive Led Zeppelin’s powerful rhythm section, ensuring that the music remains as dynamic and engaging as ever.

The members of KASHMIR not only sound like Led Zeppelin but also look the part, bearing a striking resemblance to their legendary counterparts. This visual realism, combined with the intensity of their sound, truly completes the experience. Attending a KASHMIR concert is like being transported back in time to an era when giants walked the Earth.

name: Tribute to Meat Loaf
bio: It’s all about the Dream of Rock & Roll

If you love the music of Meat Loaf, prepare for a show that brings the drama, power, and passion of his legendary catalog roaring back to life. Rock and Roll Dreams is a high-energy tribute performed by an exceptional group of musicians who understand that this music is meant to be experienced on a grand scale.

At the center of the production is vocalist Benny Israel, whose commanding stage presence and remarkable vocal range capture the operatic intensity, emotional depth, and larger-than-life spirit that made Meat Loaf one of rock’s most unforgettable performers. From soaring ballads to thunderous rock anthems, Benny delivers each song with power, precision, and genuine respect for the original recordings.

Backed by a talented band and presented with the theatrical flair fans expect, Rock and Roll Dreams recreates the excitement of a classic Meat Loaf concert while celebrating the unforgettable songs that have thrilled generations. Audiences can expect a night filled with dramatic vocals, explosive musicianship, epic arrangements, and the kind of emotional storytelling that made hits such as “Bat Out of Hell,” “Paradise by the Dashboard Light,” and “I’d Do Anything for Love” enduring rock favourites.

For longtime fans and newcomers alike, Rock and Roll Dreams is more than a tribute show, it is a full-scale rock experience. Don’t miss the opportunity to see this extraordinary group of performers bring the music, spectacle, and spirit of Meat Loaf to the stage.

name: Tribute to Metallica
bio: Sandman – The Only Metallica-Sanctioned Tribute Band !

Since 1994, Sandman has reigned as the ultimate live celebration of Metallica’s legendary catalog, delivering thunderous performances that have left audiences worldwide speechless for over three decades.

In early 2016, after a remarkable chain of events, the members of Metallica personally gave Sandman their official blessing to carry the torch, making Sandman the only Metallica-sanctioned tribute band on the planet. That endorsement was sealed in November 2016 with an unforgettable face-to-face meeting at Toronto’s iconic Opera House.
Together, they don’t just play Metallica’s music; they channel its raw energy, precision, and attitude with a authenticity born from decades on stage and in the studio.

From the blistering riffs of Kill ‘Em All to the orchestral fury of S&M and everything in between, Sandman brings the complete Metallica experience to life: no compromises, no shortcuts, just pure, unadulterated heavy metal mayhem, backed by the band that started it all.
Sandman is the real deal, approved by the kings themselves.

name: Morgan Wallen
bio: The Ultimate Morgan Wallen Tribute Experience

Get ready for an unforgettable night of country music as Whiskey Glasses – A Tribute to Morgan Wallen brings the unmistakable sound, energy, and excitement of one of country music’s biggest stars to the stage!

Fronted by the talented Lee Wiles , Whiskey Glasses is a dynamic five-piece tribute band dedicated to celebrating the music and spirit of Morgan Wallen. Hailing from the Niagara and Greater Toronto regions, this exceptional group of musicians delivers an authentic, high-energy performance that captures the heart and soul of modern country music.

Since bursting onto the scene in March 2024, Whiskey Glasses has been bringing Wallen’s chart-topping hits to life with powerful vocals, impressive musicianship, and an undeniable passion for performing. From heartfelt country ballads to infectious, boot-stomping anthems, the band recreates the signature sound that has made Morgan Wallen a household name.

Audiences can expect an exciting musical journey featuring fan favourites such as Whiskey Glasses, Last Night, Wasted on You, Chasin’ You, You Proof, and Sand in My Boots , along with more of the unforgettable songs that have helped define Wallen’s remarkable career.

At the heart of the show is Lee Wiles, whose commanding stage presence, distinctive vocals, and natural connection with audiences bring an authentic country atmosphere to every performance. Backed by a tight-knit group of accomplished musicians, Lee leads a show that combines the raw emotion of Wallen’s storytelling with the excitement and energy of a live concert.
Bring two of country’s biggest stars to your stage with a double feature featuring Morgan Wallen Tribute – Whiskey Glasses and Lainey Wilson Tribute – Watermelon Moonshine!
The same band members back both shows, with Jamie Lynn joining the Lainey Wilson set, making this an easy, cost-effective upgrade to your Whiskey Glasses booking.
Two tributes, one band, and a night packed with country favorites!

name: Ozzy Osbourne / Randy Rhodes Tribute
bio: On March 19, 1982, the rock and metal world tragically lost a rising star, the incredibly talented guitarist Randy Rhoads. Rhoads left an indelible mark on music history as the primary songwriter and recording artist for Ozzy Osbourne’s debut album, “Blizzard of Ozz,” and its follow-up, the cult classic “Diary of a Madman.” The band, Blizzard of Ozz, pays tribute to this significant period in Ozzy’s solo career.

This dedicated tribute band performs both groundbreaking albums in their entirety, treating fans to a journey through the music that defined an era. In addition to these iconic tracks, they also perform a selection of fan-favorite hits from the guitarists who succeeded Rhoads after his untimely death.

Songs like “Crazy Train,” “Mr. Crowley,” “Flying High Again,” and “I Don’t Know” from the “Blizzard of Ozz” and “Diary of a Madman” albums resonate powerfully in their live performances. They also perform hits like “Shot in the Dark,” “Bark at the Moon,” and “No More Tears,” which were released after Rhoads’ passing.

As a nod to the band that shaped Ozzy’s career before his solo venture, Blizzard of Ozz also includes some Black Sabbath tracks for the ‘Die-hards’ – the die-hard fans who have supported Ozzy through his entire musical journey. Through this, Blizzard of Ozz honors the legacy of one of rock ‘n’ roll’s fallen guitar legends, keeping the spirit of Randy Rhoads alive in every performance.

name: Tribute to Ozzy Osbourne
bio: Crazy Babies stands as the ultimate tribute to Ozzy Osbourne and the legendary Black Sabbath sound. Widely recognized as the most accurate Ozzy Osbourne and Black Sabbath tribute act ever assembled, the band captures the raw energy, theatrical madness, and unmistakable heaviness that defined the Prince of Darkness and the pioneers of metal. From the bone-crushing riffs of “Paranoid” and “Iron Man” to the unhinged vocal delivery of Ozzy’s solo classics, Crazy Babies delivers an experience so authentic that fans often do a double-take.

With roots stretching back decades, Crazy Babies holds the distinction of being the longest-running tribute of its kind in North America. What began as a passionate homage has evolved into an institution, drawing crowds across the continent who crave the real Sabbath and Ozzy experience. Thousands of shows later, the band continues to honor the music with unwavering dedication, earning a reputation for performances that don’t just imitate, they resurrect the spirit of heavy metal’s darkest era.

At the heart of it all is frontman Rod, a lifelong Ozzy devotee who’s been channeling the Madman since 1989. Having performed well over 1,000 shows, Rod’s commitment goes far beyond costume and makeup; his vocal snarls, unpredictable stage antics, and sheer intensity have stunned even the most die-hard Ozzy and Sabbath fans. A true believer in the music that changed his life, Rod treats every note and every scream with the reverence it deserves, making Crazy Babies the closest you’ll ever get to stepping back into the glory days of Ozzy Osbourne and Black Sabbath.

bio: Trouble is an explosive live tribute that captures the spirit, power, and emotion of one of pop-rock’s most fearless icons. Delivering powerhouse vocals, raw energy, and captivating stage presence, this show perfectly recreates the heart and attitude that made Pink a global sensation. From anthemic chart-toppers to soulful ballads, every performance radiates authenticity and passion.

Supported by a full live band and stunning visuals, Trouble takes audiences on an unforgettable musical journey through the superstar’s greatest hits and defining moments. Each song is performed with precision and heart, evoking the empowerment and emotion that have become Pink’s signature.
Whether you’re a lifelong fan or simply love dynamic, high-energy performances, Trouble promises a night of music, emotion, and inspiration that will leave audiences breathless.

name: The Carrie Underwood Tribute Show
bio: Step into the dazzling world of Carrie Underwood with the ultimate tribute show that’s captivating audiences far and wide! This exhilarating production celebrates the iconic career of Carrie Underwood, the small-town Oklahoma girl who skyrocketed to global stardom after winning American Idol in 2005. With an astounding 319 nominations and 187 awards spanning country, pop, and gospel music, Carrie has solidified her place as one of Time magazine’s “100 Most Influential People in the World.” This all-new tribute show brings her unparalleled legacy to life, delivering a high-energy, heartfelt performance that honors her chart-topping hits, magnetic stage presence, and profound impact on music, television, film, and fashion.

From the moment the curtain rises, you’ll be transported through Carrie’s remarkable journey, from her breakout debut to her latest groundbreaking releases. The show masterfully showcases her biggest anthems, including “Before He Cheats,” “Jesus, Take the Wheel,” and “Blown Away,” alongside soul-stirring ballads like “Cry Pretty” and “Something in the Water.” Every performance captures the essence of Carrie’s versatile artistry, blending raw emotion, powerhouse vocals, and the undeniable charisma that has made her a pop culture icon. Whether you’re left “Flat on the Floor” from the infectious energy or wiping away tears during a moving rendition, this tribute promises an unforgettable experience that resonates with fans of all ages.

Led by a stellar cast of vocalists and musicians who embody Carrie’s spirit and authenticity, The Carrie Underwood Tribute Show recreates the magic of her live performances with stunning precision. Expect dazzling costumes inspired by Carrie’s trendsetting fashion, meticulous choreography, and a state-of-the-art production that mirrors the grandeur of her sold-out arena tours. The setlist spans her entire discography, from the raw country roots of Some Hearts to the genre-defying innovation of Denim & Rhinestones , ensuring every era of her career is celebrated. Beyond the music, the show pays homage to Carrie’s trailblazing contributions to entertainment, from her Emmy-winning TV specials to her CALIA fitness brand, highlighting why she remains a beloved figure worldwide.

Since its debut, The Carrie Underwood Tribute Show has been thrilling audiences with its electrifying performances and heartfelt storytelling. Perfect for festivals, theaters, corporate events, or private celebrations, this production is designed to leave you singing, dancing, and inspired by the legacy of one of music’s greatest luminaries. Prepare to be swept away by a night of heart-pounding hits, emotional highs, and the timeless magic of Carrie Underwood. Don’t miss your chance to experience this breathtaking tribute—book now and let the music take you on a journey you’ll never forget!

name: The Cars
bio: LET’S GO! – A Tribute to The Cars
Some bands have a sound. The Cars had an identity.

From the first crack of a snare drum to the unmistakable pulse of a synthesizer, you knew exactly who you were listening to. Their music was a perfect collision of rock ’n’ roll attitude, new wave cool, quirky lyrics and melodies that refused to leave your head.
LET’S GO! brings that sound, style and energy back to the stage.

Fronted by Barry Davis as Ric Ocasek and Martyn Jones as Benjamin Orr, LET’S GO! captures the unique chemistry of the two voices that helped make The Cars one of the most distinctive bands in rock history. Davis delivers Ocasek’s unmistakable vocal style and eccentric stage presence, while Jones brings the smooth, melodic vocals and effortless cool of Benjamin Orr.
But The Cars were always more than just two voices.

Emilio Lamorte takes on Elliot Easton’s brilliantly crafted guitar parts, delivering the sharp riffs and memorable solos woven throughout the band’s biggest hits. Howard Stern recreates the layers of keyboards and synthesizers that gave The Cars their futuristic edge, while Matt O’Rourke anchors it all with the tight, driving rhythms that made their music impossible to sit still to.
Together, the five recreate the magic of a band that somehow managed to sound both ahead of its time and completely timeless.
And then there are the songs.
Just What I Needed, My Best Friend’s Girl, Good Times Roll, Let’s Go, Moving in Stereo, Shake It Up, You Might Think, Magic, Drive
It’s a soundtrack filled with unforgettable hooks, unmistakable riffs and songs that still sound as exciting as the day they first hit the radio.

LET’S GO! is about more than playing the hits. It’s about capturing the little details that made The Cars special: the interplay between guitar and keyboards, the contrast between Ocasek’s quirky delivery and Orr’s smooth vocals, the deceptively simple grooves, and that wonderfully strange balance of rock swagger and new wave sophistication.
No gimmicks. No unnecessary reinvention. Just five musicians bringing the unmistakable music of The Cars to life, with the energy and attention to detail it deserves.

name: Tribute to Andrea Bocelli
bio: The music of Andrea Bocelli – Starring Tenor Charles Di Raimondo

An accomplished and versatile singer, Charles Di Raimondo enjoys a successful career in Canada and USA. He is in demand as a tenor soloist at concerts, recitals, festivals, and major corporate functions. A graduate of both York and Brock Universities, Charles studied with the late Opera voice teacher, Mr. Goffredo Ricci, and has performed in the Operas “Carmen”, “La Traviata”, “Rigoletto” and ”Cavalleria Rusticana”. His concert repertoire includes solo tenor performances of Handel’s “Messiah”, Bach’s “Mass in B minor”, Saint Saen’s “Christmas Oratorio”, and Verdi’s “Requiem”.

Charles has graced many Canadian stages including, Hamilton Place, The Living Arts Centre, The Rose Theatre, The Toronto Centre for the Arts, The Kingswood Theatre, The Sanderson Centre, and the Richmond Hill Centre for the Performing Arts and has worked with the Canadian Opera Company Orchestra, The Rose Orchestra, The Cambridge Symphony, and the Greater Toronto Philharmonic. He has also done concerts with the Mississauga Opera Company, Brampton Lyric Opera, Opera York, and Saskatoon Opera. Recent concerts have taken him to Akron, Ohio and Buffalo, New York, USA.

As a member of the popular singing group “Canada’s Three Tenors”, Charles performed at many concerts and functions all across Canada to the delight of many distinguished guests, including the former Prime Minister of Canada, Stephen Harper.

name: The Yacht Rock Show
bio: Cruise through a nostalgic journey with The Yacht Rock Show as they deliver faithful renditions of the iconic smooth rock sounds of the mid-70s and 80s that defined a generation. They invite you to experience an unforgettable musical voyage at their Yacht Rock party—layered with lush harmonies, smooth grooves, and the melodies of summers past. Their setlist features classic hits from artists who shaped the genre, including Michael McDonald, Christopher Cross, Kenny Loggins, The Doobie Brothers, Boz Scaggs, Steely Dan, Player, Little River Band, Ambrosia, Toto, and Styx.

The band is deeply passionate about their performances, paying authentic tribute to the era in a way that stands apart from the hokey approaches often seen with other Yacht Rock acts. They strive for note-for-note precision and a nostalgic style.

Their focus is on bringing their show to performing arts centers, live music venues, festivals, resorts, and casinos across North America. With the renaissance of this genre—70s to 80s Smooth Rock and the L.A. Studio Sound—this act is poised to sell out any venue when promoted effectively. They are quickly filling dates, so book now to catch them live!

name: The Tom Prettys – The Only All-Female Tom Petty Tribute Band in the World

photo.alt: all female tribute to tom petty

bio: Get ready to rock with The Tom Prettys , the electrifying tribute band that brings the spirit, sound, and swagger of Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers to the stage in true “Pretty” style. Blending faithful musicianship with a bold feminine edge, this powerhouse group delivers high-energy performances that capture the heart of Petty’s legendary catalog while adding their own vibrant twist.

From jangly guitar anthems to heartfelt ballads, The Tom Prettys recreate the songs fans know and love with spot-on precision, rich harmonies, and undeniable stage chemistry. Their shows are not just concerts. They are full-on celebrations of rock and roll, packed with the kind of infectious enthusiasm that gets audiences on their feet singing every word. Whether it is the driving pulse of a crowd favorite or the emotional pull of a timeless classic, the band channels the soul of the originals while making each performance uniquely their own.

Renowned for their engaging stage presence and playful charisma, The Tom Prettys create an atmosphere where nostalgia meets pure live-wire energy. Fans do not just watch. They dance, they sing, and they become part of the show. With a deep love for the music and a fresh, empowering perspective, The Tom Prettys keep the legacy of Tom Petty alive in a way that is both respectful and refreshingly new, making every performance a memorable night of feel-good, sing-at-the-top-of-your-lungs rock.

name: Tribute to Led Zeppelin
bio: ZED: A Tribute to the Legendary Led Zeppelin

Imagine being transported back to the iconic days of 1970s rock, when Led Zeppelin reigned supreme, pushing the boundaries of music and redefining the genre forever. Their mythic presence still resonates deeply, a testament to the band’s timeless influence. Now, picture yourself immersed in the raw energy and unbridled passion of a live Led Zeppelin performance, with the unmistakable sound of Jimmy Page’s guitar, Robert Plant’s soaring vocals, John Paul Jones’s thunderous bass, and John Bonham’s pounding drums.
Enter ZED, the Ultimate Led Zeppelin Tribute Experience

For ZED, it’s not just about paying homage to the legends – it’s about capturing the essence of Led Zeppelin’s studio masterpieces and live performances with unwavering fidelity. With meticulous attention to detail, ZED recreates the iconic sound of Led Zeppelin’s studio albums to an astonishing level of accuracy, transporting audiences back to the golden age of rock.

ZED’s commitment to authenticity extends beyond the music, evoking the mystical aura of a Led Zeppelin live show. From the opening riffs to the final encore, ZED’s performances are a testament to the band’s enduring power to evoke primal passions and leave a lasting impression. Whether you’re a die-hard fan or just discovering the magic of Led Zeppelin, ZED offers an unforgettable journey through the ages, celebrating the music that continues to inspire and influence generations of rock enthusiasts.

For ZED, it’s much more than simply being a tribute. It’s faithfully recreating the sound of Led Zeppelin’s studio albums to an astonishing level of accuracy while also capturing the magical aura of the Led Zeppelin live experience.

name: The Dreamboats

photo.alt: The Dreamboats 50s and 60s tribute band Canada

bio: The Dreamboats are bringing back the golden age of rock ’n’ roll with a show that is as nostalgic as it is electrifying. This charismatic Canadian quartet delivers the timeless sounds of the 1950s and ’60s with fresh energy, tight harmonies, rockin’ guitars, and a stage presence that keeps audiences dancing and singing all night long.

Featuring hits inspired by icons like The Beatles, Buddy Holly, Chuck Berry, Elvis Presley, and more, The Dreamboats take audiences on a musical journey to an era of jukeboxes, soda shops, spinning starlight lamps, and live music made for the dance floor. Their performances combine the charm of classic rock ’n’ roll with the excitement of a modern live show, creating an experience that feels both familiar and brand new.

The band is made up of four Toronto musicians with a true passion for the music, style, and spirit of a bygone era: Chris Hummel, also known as Sir Ritchie Hummins, on vocals and guitar; Bryan Fligg, Fliggers “B.” Lewis, on vocals and bass guitar; Matthew Bestvater-Tennison, “The Prodfather” Matt Best, on lead guitar; and Gianmarco Fiacconi, Johnny “G-Wiz” Fiaccones, on drums and backing vocals.

With matching uniforms, angelic harmonies, infectious rhythms, and their signature retro flair, The Dreamboats bring the magic of original rock ’n’ roll roaring back to life. Whether they are channeling the spirited energy of Chuck Berry, the heartthrob appeal of Elvis, or the irresistible melodies of the British Invasion, The Dreamboats promise an unforgettable night of music, movement, and good old-fashioned fun.
Step into the musical time machine and get ready to fall in love with rock ’n’ roll all over again. Gee Wiz!

name: ABBA Revisited Tribute to ABBA
bio: The concert is a Canadian produced rock musical which takes you back to the disco era of one of the best pop bands in history, ABBA. Features nine incredible musicians and singers which are the main highlights of this musical. Not only do the four performers look exactly like Anni-Frid, Bjorn, Benny and Agnetha, they also sound unbelievably like them. Recently returned from a Malaysian tour, they are currently performing in Canada, the U.S. and internationally.

The Canadian National Exhibition (C.N.E.) in Toronto claims that this was their number one show in 2000. With standing ovations and people in the audience asking “is this really ABBA?” this is a show that everyone, young and old should not miss.

Hear 21 of ABBA’s hits, with all the costume changes, choreography, a live band, back-up singers and big studio sound. For all the ABBA fans, there are two shows you should see this year… Mama Mia a play which features the music of ABBA and this show which recreates ABBA in concert! Both shows are fantastic.
With Special Guests – Members of The LONDON SYMPHONY ORCHESTRA
“Vocally and musically superb” Toronto Sun
“Truly a great show” Globe & Mail
“Unbelievable!” Ottawa Citizen
“The closest thing to ABBA that anyone will ever see” Mamma Mia Cast
“One of the best live shows to come to Winnipeg” Winnipeg Free Press

name: Thuderstruck Tribute to AC/DC

photo.alt: Thuderstruck - North America's #1 Tribute to AC/DC

bio: Since first igniting the stage in January 2001, Thunderstruck has solidified its reputation as one of the most electrifying AC/DC tribute bands in the world. This dynamic ensemble of seasoned musicians, united by an unyielding passion for rock ‘n’ roll, delivers a high-voltage performance that captures the raw power and timeless spirit of AC/DC. With over two decades of performances across North America, Thunderstruck is more than a band—it’s a phenomenon that channels the heart-pounding energy of one of rock’s greatest legends. The band’s attention to detail is unparalleled, from their use of authentic Gibson SGs and Marshall stacks to their faithful reproduction of AC/DC’s signature sound. Thunderstruck doesn’t just play the music—they embody it, channeling the spirit of Angus Young’s frenetic stage presence, Bon Scott’s raw charisma, and Brian Johnson’s unmistakable growl. This commitment to authenticity ensures that every chord, every drumbeat, and every lyric hits with the same intensity as the original.

When Thunderstruck takes the stage, the atmosphere crackles with anticipation. Their live shows are a full-throttle spectacle, complete with the theatrical flair that AC/DC fans crave. From Angus Young-inspired schoolboy outfits to choreographed stage antics, Thunderstruck delivers a visual and auditory assault that transports audiences straight to the heart of an AC/DC concert. Cannons, bells, and explosive lighting effects amplify the experience, creating a multisensory celebration of rock ‘n’ roll.

With a repertoire that spans AC/DC’s early pub-rock roots to their stadium-filling anthems, Thunderstruck’s performances are a masterclass in showmanship. Whether they’re igniting small venues with intimate, sweat-soaked energy or commanding festival stages with larger-than-life presence, the band’s chemistry and dedication ensure that no two shows are ever the same. Fans leave exhilarated, having experienced the closest thing to AC/DC’s legendary live performances.

Thunderstruck is a collective of virtuosic musicians, each bringing years of experience and a deep love for AC/DC’s music to the stage. The band’s lineup is a powerhouse of talent, with members who have honed their craft through countless performances and a shared commitment to honoring AC/DC’s legacy. Their synergy is palpable, creating a tight, cohesive sound that captures the essence of AC/DC’s raw power while adding their own flair to keep the performances fresh and dynamic.

Over the past 24 years, Thunderstruck has built a devoted following, headlining festivals, theaters, and rock clubs across Canada, the United States, and beyond. Their performances have earned accolades from fans and critics alike, who praise their authenticity, energy, and unwavering dedication to the spirit of AC/DC. Whether you’re a lifelong fan of the Australian rock giants or a newcomer discovering their music, Thunderstruck offers an unforgettable experience that celebrates the enduring power of rock ‘n’ roll.

Join Thunderstruck on their relentless mission to keep the AC/DC legacy alive. When the lights dim and the first chords of Thunderstruck ring out, you’ll know you’re in for a night of pure, unadulterated rock. Prepare to be thunderstruck!

name: AC/DC Tribute – USA
bio: Shoot To Thrill includes Kara (vocals), Susan (guitar), Jai (bass), Wendy (guitar) and Kate (drums). Not only are the girls professional musicians with impeccable skills, they are also quite easy on the eyes and full of energy for an entertaining stage show!

The girls decided on AC/DC in particular, because the band’s songs are a marriage of compelling music and creative story-telling. The guitar work is intricate yet not overplayed, while the rhythms are driving and dynamic. The silence is as important as the noise, and the lyrics are relatable and captivating. You just HAVE to sing along….or air-guitar….or BOTH!

The girls decided to do a full tribute rather than a cover band, because a tribute is much more challenging. You play many songs by the same artist and really reach inside that artist copying not only their playing style but also their signature stage moves. It’s really quite an art and very rewarding when you make it all come together.
Shoot To Thrill is based out of Raleigh, NC and tours all along the East Coast. The girls look forward to meeting you and rocking you into an unbelievable frenzy of good times !

They have also been to Puerto Rico, the U.S. Virgin Islands, and other U.S. territories. They have toured to other countries such as England, Canada, South America and Japan just to name a few. With over 2000 performances in over 100 cities, Draw The Line is sure soon to be in a venue near you! If you love Aerosmith, this is the tribute show You Don’t Wanna Miss!

Draw the Line is the only Aerosmith tribute band endorsed by Aerosmith! Hailing from Boston, Mass., the city that boasts the World Championship Red Sox, The New England Patriots, the musical groups Boston, members of Journey, J.Geils, and Peter Wolf, Godsmack, of course Aerosmith. Adding to the subculture of this city is Draw The Line the Aerosmith Tribute Band.

name: Tribute to Alabama
bio: Alabama – The most successful band in the history of country music!!

They have sold over 75 million albums with over 40 #1 hit songs. The four boys from Fort Payne Alabama have created an incomparable success train with their Country and Southern Rock influence. The band had their biggest success in the 1980s, where they had over 27 number one hits, seven multi-platinum albums and received over 200 awards. They have even received a Hollywood Star on the walk of fame.

Mountain Music is an alarmingly accurate tribute to Alabama. The famous harmonies from the cousins of Alabama are true and intact. The blue collar southern rock guitar, the fiddle and all the hits are included in this show.
songs: Tennessee River If You’re Gonna Play In Texas
