name: Tribute to Alan Jackson
bio: In the realm of ’90s country music, Alan Jackson stood shoulder to shoulder with Garth Brooks in terms of popularity. By 2003, he had earned widespread acclaim in the music industry, with many hailing him as one of the greatest artists in country music history. Jackson’s remarkable consistency is reflected in his staggering achievement of 20 number one singles and an additional 20 Top Ten hits, all within the initial 12 years of his career.

Don Thompson has carved his own path in paying homage to Alan Jackson through impersonation. With a career spanning several years, Thompson’s highlights include captivating performances at the esteemed Legends in Concert show in Las Vegas, Nevada. Backed by a talented ensemble of musicians, Thompson’s tribute to Alan Jackson is nothing short of being “Right On The Money.”

name: The Ultimate Alice Cooper Experience
bio: During the bleak winter of 1971, Alice Cooper unchained the gates of hell and released Love It to Death. After more than 40 years, the nightmare continues.

Eyes of Alice is a stunning visual, theatrical and musical recreation of the world’s most infamous and beloved shock rock entertainer. Eyes of Alice recreates the look and feel of Cooper’s music culminating in a visceral experience that has to be seen to be believed.
Boasting a versatile and robust group of musicians and performers, the tribute experience is highlighted by Robby Cooper’s uncanny portrayal of the insidious, dark and witty Alice.

Audiences are left both horrified and amazed as the cast and crew bring the characters of your favorite songs to life… and sometimes death. From the prop filled stage consisting of clowns, nurses, monsters, spiders and executioners to the harmonies and instrumentation – one thing is certain: this group are sure to entertain you…or die trying.

name: Sharon Owens, Barbra Streisand Tribute
bio: Sharon Owens began her career as a Streisand Tribute for the multi-million dollar production show Legends in Concert. She then continued on to Berlin, Germany performing for “Stars in Concert”. Her uncanny resemblance both voice and looks propelled her career to the status of headlining in her own show “Barbra and Frank, The Concert That Never Was”. The 10 year running show still remains on the Las Vegas strip to sell out audiences and standing ovations nightly.

During her time impersonating Streisand, Sharon won a national competition in 2005 on Fox TV called “Performing As…” as well as making it to the finals in 2007 of the ABC hit show “The Next Best Thing”. She has performed for Access Hollywood, Extra, been seen in People magazine and TV guide as one of the best “impersonators” in the world.
Sharon Owens is the quintessential Barbra Streisand. Critics and audiences agree that Sharon not only has the look but has the voice that is unmistakably that of the legendary Barbra.

Coast to Coast, from New York to LA, from London to Israel, Sharon has been captivating audiences with her tribute to Barbra Streisand. From the classic songs of the 60’s to the power ballads of today, Sharon takes the audience on a spectacular journey through the music of Streisand’s greatest hits.

name: Tribute to The Barenaked Ladies
bio: It’s All Been Done is a captivating live experience that showcases the remarkable talents of some of the Niagara Region’s most promising young musicians. This ensemble pays tribute to the iconic Canadian band, Barenaked Ladies, by performing their greatest hits with an unmatched energy and enthusiasm.

The band is a harmonious blend of skilled individuals, each contributing their unique musical insights. Darryl Freel, on guitar, is known for his intricate solos and rhythmic precision. Jordan Phelan’s mastery of the bass guitar provides the solid backbone of the group’s sound, while Gregg Halliday’s drumming is a dynamic force that drives the band’s high-energy performances. Also on guitar, Joel Lewczynski, brings a wealth of melody and harmony to the group’s sound.

Together, these five musicians have spent over eight years collaborating musically, perfecting their craft, and paying homage to the Barenaked Ladies. Their shared passion for this beloved band’s music shines through in every performance, creating an unforgettable evening of music and entertainment that truly captures the spirit of a classic Barenaked Ladies show.

name: Tribute to Bette Midler
bio: Kathy Thompson brings the glamour, powerhouse vocals, and outrageous humor of everyone’s favorite Divine Diva to the stage in her unforgettable tribute to Bette Midler.

With a career portraying Bette Midler that began in 1995 with Legends in Concert in Las Vegas, Kathy quickly earned attention for both her striking resemblance and her remarkable voice. During her audition, John Stuart was overheard saying, “She looks just like her.” Audiences soon discovered that Kathy had more than just the look, she had the sound, the spirit, and the larger-than-life personality to match.

Her show celebrates Bette’s most beloved songs, including Boogie Woogie Bugle Boy, Wind Beneath My Wings, Stuff Like That There, I’m Beautiful, The Rose, You Don’t Own Me, Under the Boardwalk, and more. Blending music, comedy, charisma, and a delightfully bold sense of humor, Kathy captures the sparkle and sass that made Bette Midler a true entertainment icon.

Kathy has performed her tribute across North America and around the world, appearing in Las Vegas, Branson, Cancun, Myrtle Beach, San Francisco, Atlantic City, Japan, Berlin, Cologne, Switzerland, Florida, Toronto, Ottawa, Hartford, on Caribbean cruise ships, and many other stages. From casinos and theatres to dinner shows, cruises, festivals, and special events, Kathy’s tribute to Bette Midler is a dazzling celebration of music, laughter, and pure diva energy.

name: Tribute to Blue Rodeo

photo.alt: Blue Rodeo Tribute band Continental Entertainment

bio: Step into the world of New Rodeo, a heartfelt tribute that brings the iconic sounds of Canadian rock legends Blue Rodeo to life. Founded in 2020, this dedicated ensemble captures the essence of Blue Rodeo’s timeless melodies and poignant lyrics, celebrating the band’s enduring legacy with every performance.

New Rodeo showcases a talented lineup of musicians who share a deep passion for Blue Rodeo’s music. With their dynamic harmonies and skilled instrumentation, they recreate the atmosphere of Blue Rodeo’s unforgettable live shows, inviting audiences to relive the magic of classics like “Try,” “Lost Together”, and “Hasn’t Hit Me Yet.”

Whether performing at intimate venues, festivals, or community events, New Rodeo connects with fans old and new, weaving together tales of love, heartache, and the beauty of the Canadian landscape. Their authentic tribute pays homage to the original band while infusing every song with a fresh energy that resonates across generations.

Join New Rodeo on a musical journey that honors the legacy of Blue Rodeo, and experience the songs that have touched the hearts of millions. From the first note to the final encore, they remind us all why the music of Blue Rodeo remains timeless and cherished in the hearts of fans everywhere.

name: Exodus – Bob Marley Tribute Band
bio: Juno Award Winner Lazo , was born in Castle Bruce on the beautiful island of Dominica in the Caribbean. He began his career at an early age with a band called Black Blood (their very first album charted number two in Dominica and received extensive air play in the Caribbean). Soon after immigrating to Ottawa, Canada, Lazo formed his own band, Unity, to start performing his original compositions.
Lazo has since toured extensively in the United States, Canada, and the Caribbean sharing the stage with artist such as Maxi Priest, Burning Spear, Third World, and the Wailers, to name a few.

Exodus is one of Canada’s premier tributes to the late, great Bob Marley. Fronted by Juno-award winning reggae artist Lazo, Exodus energetically entertains with faithful renditions of all Marley hits and obscurities, that will impress both the casual fan and discernible listener alike.

name: Tribute to Bon Jovi – Canada
bio: Keep the Faith is THE Bon Jovi tribute providing you with the unequivocal live concert performance you come to expect at a Bon Jovi show. Every note, every move, every detail has been carefully crafted and choreographed to deliver to you the ultimate experience.

This show is also for the diehards too so don’t be surprised if you hear a few rare Jovi songs as well as covers that are performed at a Bon Jovi concert like “Hallelujah” and some “Old Time Rock n Roll”!! From their first self titled album to ‘What About Now’, we have all your Bon Jovi eras included into ‘One Wild Night’! So be ready to join frontman JBJ look alike and sound alike Chris Newman and his incredible band for an amazing ride you will be talking about for a long time to come!

name: Tribute to Bon Jovi – USA
bio: Bad Medicine is a premier tribute band devoted to celebrating the legendary music and enduring legacy of Bon Jovi. With a deep passion for the band’s timeless hits, they bring the same electrifying energy, powerful vocals, and arena-rock excitement that defined Bon Jovi’s rise to fame. Every performance is crafted to recreate the look, sound, and larger-than-life feel of an authentic Bon Jovi concert, giving fans a chance to relive the magic of the songs they love.

Formed by lifelong fans, Bad Medicine blends exceptional musicianship with a deep respect for the original band’s legacy. Their shows feature all the classics, from “Livin’ on a Prayer” and “You Give Love a Bad Name” to deeper cuts beloved by true fans, performed with the same intensity and emotion that defined Bon Jovi’s rise to fame. The band’s dedication to detail, from sound to stage presence, ensures an immersive and unforgettable concert experience for audiences of all ages.

Whether playing packed clubs, festivals, or special events, Bad Medicine brings people together through the universal language of rock and roll. Their goal is simple: to keep the music alive, celebrate the legacy of Bon Jovi, and give fans a chance to relive the magic of the songs they love. With every show, Bad Medicine strives not only to entertain, but to share in the joy, nostalgia, and excitement that have made Bon Jovi’s music endure for generations.

name: A Tribute to Bruce Springsteen

photo.alt: Glory Days a tribute to Tribute to Bruce Springsteen

bio: A unique six-piece ensemble, Glory Days is a tribute to an American musical icon, perhaps one of the greatest rock singers/songwriters of our time Bruce Springsteen. This band’s lineup is exclusively composed of experienced concert musicians able to recreate some of the classic songs and performances that were, and still are, Springsteen’s trademark. This is without a doubt one of the best touring acts, one that has a Springsteen look-alike fronting the band. Add phenomenal musicianship and an infectious on-stage enthusiasm and you get the perfect recipe for an unforgettable night of pure passion and energy.

Glory Days is not content to just play the songs, they also manage to recreate an authentic Springsteen “experience” by adding the little details that put Springsteen shows and songs in a category all their own.
Glory Days will give you an arena rock-show experience unlike any other, also hoping that a younger generation will be exposed to the most influential rock music and poetry of our time.

Glory Days is not just a combination of talented musicians, it’s also a combination of Springsteen hardcore fans. It’s a family; six individuals dedicated to recreating what Bruce gave and still gives us; not just his music, but his feelings as well: joy and sadness, tears and laughter – but before all, a sincere honesty.

name: A tribute to Bryan Adams

photo.alt: a tribute to Canadian singer/songwriter and guitarist Bryan Adams

bio: SUMMER OF 69 is Canada’s tribute to BRYAN ADAMS, established in 2004 in Toronto, and has performed at countless outdoor festivals, theatres and events across Canada, USA including the Caribbean’s. They are now one of the most popular tribute acts around.
Its members include five very talented professional musicians, who have toured extensively all over North America.

On stage SUMMER OF 69 faithfully reproduce the look, the sound, the energy and excitement of a real Bryan Adams live performance. This will certainly provide a memorable and entertaining experience to the most discerning Bryan Adams fans and music fans in general. The band passionately plays major hit songs such as ‘Run To You’, ‘Summer Of 69’, ‘Everything I Do I Do It For You’, ‘Heaven’ and ‘Cuts Like A Knife’, as well as many other top 20 hit singles.

Bryan Adams is one of the most successful singer/songwriters of all time and his music is well known and appreciated by millions of people worldwide. Having such an enormous amount of popular #1 hit songs to choose from, SUMMER OF 69 is confident that you will enjoy this unique and entertaining experience that suitable for any type of event or age group.
If you haven’t done so already, check them out for yourself. You’ll surely be singing and dancing along to all your favorite tunes.

name: Tapestry, the Carole King Songbook
bio: TAPESTRY , The Carole King Songbook – The premier musical tribute to Carole King

This show recreates the sound and vibe of a Carole King 1970’s concert experience following her legendary album, Tapestry. You will be transported back to the iconic image of that 25-million selling album of 1971.

Impeccable attention to detail is taken in recreating a respectful and accurate musical presentation of piano and vocals, just as they were. Suzanne’s performance will take you on a journey back to those great recordings. During the 70’s & 80’s, Carol played solo, with acoustic musicians and a full band with horns during this period. This show is performed in any of those formats.

Tapestry, Carole King Songbook, not only presents the record-breaking, Grammy winning album of the same name, but is a retrospective of the iconic song writing team of Gerry Goffin and Carole King, and her hits that continued into the 70’s.

This prolific team wrote chart-topping hits for artists such as Aretha Franklin, Bobby Vee, The Beatles, James Taylor, the Drifters, Donny Osmond…and the list goes on. It just doesn’t get any more real than this.You will feel the Earth Move under your feet with this show.

name: Catherine Pearson as Céline Dion
bio: Singer and performer Catherine Pearson possesses an impressive vocal range, a powerful stage presence, and a deep passion for the music of Céline Dion. Inspired by Céline’s unmistakable voice, artistry, and emotional intensity, Catherine has spent more than three decades perfecting her tribute and developing a performance that captures both the grandeur and sensitivity of one of the world’s most celebrated vocalists.

Over the years, Catherine has refined not only the vocal precision required to interpret Céline Dion’s demanding repertoire, but also the emotion, elegance, and connection with the audience that make these songs so unforgettable. Her performances are more than an interpretation of the music, they are a heartfelt celebration of an extraordinary artist and the timeless songs that have touched millions of people around the world.

Recently, Catherine had the great pleasure and privilege of sharing the stage on numerous occasions with internationally renowned baritone Gino Quilico and acclaimed performer Philippe Berghella. Together, they performed two of Céline Dion’s most beloved duets, “The Prayer” and “Beauty and the Beast,” creating memorable musical moments that showcase Catherine’s versatility and ability to share the stage with accomplished artists.

In Passion Céline , Catherine brings Céline Dion’s greatest hits to life with brilliance, sensitivity, and authenticity. From powerful anthems to intimate ballads, she takes audiences on a musical journey through the songs that defined Céline’s remarkable career.

Every performance reflects Catherine’s admiration and profound respect for Céline Dion. Rather than simply recreating the songs, she strives to preserve their emotion, vocal power, and spirit while bringing her own warmth and personality to the stage.

For longtime Céline Dion fans and audiences discovering these timeless songs anew, Passion Céline is an unforgettable concert experience, a sincere and vibrant tribute to one of the greatest voices of our time.

name: A Tribute to Cher
bio: Sandra Wood makes a stunning appearance in the show as “Cher”. Sandra not only looks like Cher, but her singing and mannerisms are so strikingly like Cher’s, you are certain that you have just seen the superstar on stage.

Sandra has recently written and produced a full blown stage extravaganza show entitled, “Sandra Wood’s Farewell Tour”. No, she’s not quitting the business, she is just saluting her counterpart’s decision to stop performing live (Yeah, right!). Much like Cher’s real show, the “Sandra Wood Farewell Tour” encompasses a live band, dancers, and videos (however, no Cirque du Soleil acrobats…sorry!)

Sandra has been performing as a Cher impersonator for over 10 years. She performs at major corporate events all over the United States and appeared as Cher’s on-screen double in the music video ‘Walking in Memphis’.
Sandra was personally selected by Bette Milder to appear on stage with her as “Cher” for the New Year’s Eve show of the Divine Miss Millennium Tour in Las Vegas at the Mandalay Bay.

Sandra has performed for some of the corporate giants including; IBM, Mobile Oil, AT&T, Allstate Insurance, Dr. Pepper, Hewlett Packard, Canon, Panasonic, Discover Card, MCI, Nissan, Xerox, Soloman Smith Barney, Chevrolet, Lucent Technologies, Chrysler, and 3M.

name: Brass Transit Chicago Tribute Band
bio: Q: What happens when eight in-demand musicians and singers gather together out of a common love for one of the most successful pop/rock groups of all time?
A: Brass Transit – a dynamic, crowd-pleasing, studio-tight powerhouse, and the world’s foremost Chicago tribute show!
Brass Transit was formed in 2008, its accomplished, award- winning roster intent on paying tribute to the decades-long, multiplatinum songbook of Chicago.

Since 2008, Brass Transit has toured North America steadily, dazzling audiences with flawless performances and spectacular attention to detail. Hits like, Saturday In The Park, 25 or 6 To 4, If You Leave Me Now, Feelin’ Stronger Every Day and You’re The Inspiration have left crowds in awe, inspiring multiple standing ovations and comments like: “Spine-Tingling!” “Brought me back to my youth!” and “Perfect in every detail!”

Brass Transit goes far beyond just replicating the songs; they embody the music. They recently produced their first (self-titled) album, taking songs by other top rock artists from the seventies and recording them with horns in the Chicago style. The result is a fresh approach to some of the greatest hits of the era. They also recently scored their show for full symphony orchestra with original arrangements that are truly spellbinding.
Brass Transit will bring you back to the most memorable times of your life. Get ready to sing along!”

name: Tribute to Chris Stapleton
bio: David McNab is a seasoned musician and vocalist whose deep, soulful voice and rugged charisma have made him one of the most sought-after Chris Stapleton tribute artists in the country. Born and raised in northern Ontario, David grew up surrounded by the rich sounds of country, blues, and rock – genres that would later define Stapleton’s signature style. With a guitar in hand and a passion for storytelling through music, David spent years honing his craft in local bars, captivating audiences with his raw talent and uncanny ability to channel Stapleton’s gritty, heartfelt sound.

David’s journey as a tribute artist began after friends and fans repeatedly noted his striking vocal resemblance to Chris Stapleton, particularly in his renditions of hits like “Tennessee Whiskey” and “Broken Halos.” What started as casual performances soon evolved into a full-fledged tribute act, complete with a band of skilled musicians who recreate the soul-stirring energy of Stapleton’s live shows. David’s attention to detail – from the raspy timbre of his voice to his authentic stage presence – has earned him praise from country music lovers and even die-hard Stapleton fans, who appreciate his dedication to honoring the Grammy-winning artist’s legacy without losing his own unique flair.

name: Coldplay The Tribute Show
bio: Coldplay The Tribute Show faithfully recreates the sound, energy, and atmosphere of one of the world’s biggest bands. Celebrating more than two decades of Coldplay’s chart-topping music, the show delivers the closest experience you can get to seeing the real thing. In theatre settings, audiences are treated to a full-scale production featuring stunning 3D visual elements, capturing the immersive and emotional essence of a true Coldplay concert. Coldplay The Tribute Show is fronted by Andrew Sansone, a seasoned professional musician with over 20 years of experience and mastery of multiple instruments. Andrew’s dynamic presence and heartfelt performances echo the spirit of Chris Martin, giving fans of all ages a powerful and moving live music experience. The rest of the lineup features veteran musicians from the Greater Toronto Area who have collectively performed thousands of shows across festivals, theatres, and live venues. Together, they bring to life the sound and spectacle of Coldplay with passion, precision, and authenticity.

name: Tribute to David Bowie
bio: Established in 2004, Toronto, Canada based Life on Mars (LoM) presents the genius of Bowie across the decades. Maintaining the integrity of the music, note for note, LoM presents a two hour retrospect, a musical reinvention of classic Bowie hits; uniquely arranged into a soaring, emotional, musical, concert experience of astonishing nuance and power.

Life on Mars is not an imitation of Bowie but an emulation of his music and a celebration of his spirit. Singer Kevin Connelly fuses the essence of Bowie’s vision and charisma with his own electrifying talent and captures with mesmerizing accuracy, the mystery, the moves and the magic of Bowie himself; backed by the incomparable Heroes band this is a performance unsurpassed by any other of it’s kind.

name: Tribute to Def Leppard

photo.alt: Just Leppard tribute to Def Leppard

bio: Def Leppard are a legendary British rock band whom have had an incredible career spanning over three decades and still going strong. Having just recently been inducted into Rock and Roll Hall of Fame, they have sold millions of albums, and have had constant strong success touring all over the world. With the success of the Pyromania and Hysteria albums, they have become global rock n roll legends. This band has been through so many different tragedies but yet seem to stick together and work through their challenges as a band. They have inspired us of all never to give up.

Just Leppard is the ultimate tribute to “Def Leppard”. Ever since they were young musicians Def Leppard has inspired them to be rock stars. With such an amazing catalog of music, they have become legends at cultivating some of the best arena rock the world has to offer. Cheers to Def Leppard! In the 80’s their band Sweet Steeler won the battle of the bands and the prize was to meet Def Leppard on the Hysteria tour. That event made such an impression on the band it made them want to continue their rock and roll dreams and tour across the US and Canada. In the 90’s Def Leppard was on tour and coming to their home town of Sudbury, Ontario. As they bought tickets to the show, Just Leppard found out through the local radio station who was called by Def Leppard’s promotion company that their opening act was not going to make it for the show. The promoter asked the radio station, “who could fill the opening acts spot last minute in Sudbury, Ontario.” The radio suggested, “Terra Cain”, Just Leppard’s band at the time and they opened for their rock and roll idols in their hometown! What a night!

bio: Step into the world of rhinestones, big hair, and timeless country melodies as Daphne Moens transforms into the legendary Dolly Parton. Whether it’s in “Blue Suede and Rhinestones: Dolly Meets Elvis”, “Backwoods Barbie: The Ultimate Tribute to Dolly Parton” or “Queens of Country”, Daphne embodies the spirit of Dolly with her heartfelt vocals and charismatic stage presence. Backed by the top Tribute Band in Canada, The Casino Brothers Band, these musical extravaganzas are a celebration of Dolly’s iconic career and enduring influence on the world of country music.

All three shows are a captivating journey through the heart and soul of Dolly Parton’s extensive catalog, featuring all the hits that have made her a beloved figure in the industry. From the poignant storytelling of “Jolene” to the uplifting anthem of “9 to 5,”

​The Casino Brothers Band bring their exceptional musical talent to the stage, recreating the signature sound that has made Dolly Parton a global icon. With authentic arrangements and a genuine passion for the music, the band ensures that every note resonates with the soulful twang that defines classic country.

​”Daphne as Dolly” is a heartwarming, foot-stomping tribute that will leave fans of Dolly Parton and country music enthusiasts alike singing along and tapping their toes. Join Daphne Moens and The Casino Brothers Band for an unforgettable evening of classic tunes and southern charm, celebrating the enduring legacy of a country music icon.

name: Tribute to Dolly Parton
bio: Newfoundland born vocalist “Laurie Lynn” began performing Country music at the age of 9, first performing in the Corner Brook Arts and Culture Center.
Coming from a family that listened to Country music from dusk till dawn and beyond, Laurie Lynn felt totally connected to Dolly Parton as an individual and to her lyrics as relatable to her life.
Over the course of her childhood and adolescent years, she performed on countless stages in Western Newfoundland before moving out of the province.
After raising her children she returned to performing once again, only this time, tributing to her childhood idol, “Dolly Parton.”

“It didn’t matter which song I would sing, it could have been Willie Nelson, people always said, you sound like Dolly”. Its been brought to Laurie Lynns attention many times, that her authentic vibrato voice, was remarkably similar to that of Dolly, and that her petite frame, witty sense of humor and one liners portrayed her naturally.
“I am a dreamer, so being able to perform on stage and tribute to whom I feel is the greatest female legend in country music, is truly a dream come true, it keeps my heart beating.”
Laurie Lynn is now an International Dolly Parton tribute artist, performing across Canada, USA and Mexico.

If you are looking for a high energy, fun loving performance, that captures the essence of “Dolly” Laurie Lynn as Dolly, Smoky Mountain Songbird will give you an nostalgic moment and leave you thoroughly entertained.

name: Tribute to Electric Light Orchestra
bio: Step into the magic of the ’70s with STRANGE MAGIC, your ticket to the authentic re-creation of the legendary Electric Light Orchestra (ELO). This immersive, multi-media show doesn’t just bring you the music; it transports you with captivating background imagery and film, recreating the full ELO experience.

Comprising a talented ensemble of nine multi-instrumentalists, STRANGE MAGIC meticulously reproduces every sound heard in a genuine ELO performance. Vintage keyboards, live cellos, and intricate vocal arrangements come together to deliver the true essence of ELO’s musical genius.

Prepare for a journey through the iconic hits of ELO as STRANGE MAGIC takes the stage. From the rhythmic pulse of “Don’t Bring Me Down” to the ethereal enchantment of “Strange Magic,” and the timeless allure of “Living Thing,” this nine-piece ensemble delivers the full spectrum of ELO classics. With precision and passion, they revive the magic of the ’70s, ensuring an unparalleled time-travel experience for every audience member.

Join us for a musical odyssey that brings back the golden age of classic rock. STRANGE MAGIC doesn’t just get close; it encapsulates the spirit of ELO, leaving you with an unforgettable taste of the era that defined an entire generation. Get ready to be spellbound by the sonic enchantment of STRANGE MAGIC!

name: Tribute to Elton John – USA

photo.alt: greggie and the jets tribute to elton john

bio: Greggie and the Jets, a premier Elton John tribute band hailing from Florida, brings the magic of Sir Elton’s classic era to life with unparalleled authenticity and energy. Led by the charismatic Greg Vadimsky, a classically trained pianist with a deep connection to Elton’s music, the band delivers note-for-note recreations of both chart-topping hits and cherished deep cuts. Their performances capture the flamboyant spirit, intricate arrangements, and emotional depth of Elton John’s iconic catalog, transporting audiences to the vibrant 1970s and beyond. From intimate venues to major festivals, Greggie and the Jets have earned a reputation for sold-out shows and electrifying crowds across the United States.

The band’s lineup is a powerhouse of seasoned musicians, each with an impressive resume that elevates their tribute to extraordinary heights. Drummer Brian Arnold, a veteran of Ball State University’s jazz program, has shared stages with legends like Pat Benatar and Bad Company, bringing dynamic rhythms and soaring vocals. Keyboardist Patrick Green, trained at Florida State University’s School of Music, adds lush layers with credits including Disney Cruise Lines and the band Heatwave. Guitarist Jeff Bazemore, a University of Miami alum, infuses the group with versatility from his experience in Rush and Led Zeppelin tributes, while bassist Steve Caroppoli, a stalwart of the Florida music scene, anchors the sound with credits alongside Cheap Trick and Snow Patrol. Together, they recreate the sonic brilliance of Elton John’s recordings with meticulous attention to detail.

Greggie and the Jets don’t just perform—they immerse audiences in a full Elton John experience, blending music with storytelling that honors the legacy of Elton and lyricist Bernie Taupin. Their shows weave beloved anthems like “Your Song” and “Rocket Man” with lesser-known gems, ensuring something for casual fans and die-hard devotees alike. Vadimsky’s personal passion for Elton’s music, sparked in childhood and honed through years of professional musicianship, shines through in every performance, making each concert feel like a journey back to the height of rock ‘n’ roll glamour. With a commitment to authenticity and a flair for engaging crowds, Greggie and the Jets continue to dazzle, leaving audiences singing, dancing, and reliving the timeless brilliance of Elton John’s music.

All the hit songs that powered the 70’s radio waves as well as deep album stand-out tracks. The sights and sounds of Elton John…from the end of the world to your town.

bio: Matt Cage is a renowned tribute artist who has captured the essence of Elvis Presley in his performances. With his uncanny resemblance to the King of Rock and Roll and his natural charisma, Cage has dazzled audiences around the world with his electrifying performances.

As a tribute artist, Cage doesn’t just mimic Elvis’ look; he embodies his spirit and energy, delivering authentic renditions of Elvis’ greatest hits while capturing the nuances of his stage presence and mannerisms. Whether performing classic ballads like “Can’t Help Falling in Love” or getting the crowd moving with rockers like “Jailhouse Rock,” Cage’s performances are a thrilling tribute to the music and legacy of Elvis Presley.
Cage’s dedication to his craft has earned him widespread recognition and praise from Elvis fans and industry professionals alike. He has won numerous awards and accolades.

For those who never had the chance to see Elvis perform live, Matt Cage’s performances are the next best thing. With his spot-on vocals, dynamic stage presence, and undeniable talent, Cage channels the spirit of the King of Rock and Roll in every performance, ensuring that Elvis’ music and legacy will continue to live on for generations to come.

name: Tribute to Faith Hill
bio: Annika Neilson – Having grown up in a musical family, performing with her brother regularly on the ferries between Sweden and Denmark, Annika Nielsen eventually enrolled in Los Angeles’ popular Musicians Institute for formal vocal instruction. Annika has developed her live performance and charismatic stage presence by playing locations in Florida, Bahamas, Nevada, Thailand and Singapore and has played on many stages in Las Vegas such as “Legends in Concert” at the Imperial Palace, and many more.

Annika Nielsen and Peter Phillips are perfectly matched to perform duets such as “Let’s Make Love,” and “It’s Your Love,” songs made popular by Hill and McGraw. Recreating the spontaneous combustion and Soul2soul tour with Vegas flair is filled with sexuality, charisma and class!

name: Tribute to Foreigner

photo.alt: Jukebox Heroes international tribute to Foreigner and Lou Gramm

bio: Jukebox Heroes: international tribute to Foreigner and Lou Gramm perform all the hits from American/British supergroup, Foreigner. They also perform hits from Foreigner’s original lead singer, Lou Gramm, from when he decided to leave the band to pursue a solo career.

At any given Jukebox Heroes show, you will experience monster songs that were hits worldwide, such as “Hot Blooded”, “Cold As Ice”, “Waiting For A Girl Like You”, “Urgent”, “Juke Box Hero”, and, of course, one of the most popular love ballads of all time, “I Want To Know What Love Is”.

The music of Foreigner has long been a staple on North American rock radio stations; most notably in Canada. Having many fans in Canada’s largest city and the capital of Ontario, it is no surprise Jukebox Hero: the musical made its North American premier in Toronto.

Ever since its debut on February 20th, 2019, there has been much interest in Jukebox Heroes: international tribute to Foreigner + Lou Gramm. Based in Toronto, this tribute show has performed on stages all across North America.

From New York to Chicago, Detroit to Ottawa, Akron to New Orleans, thousands of fans have experienced the magnificent power and presence Jukebox Heroes: international tribute to Foreigner + Lou Gramm brings to the stage! Whether it’s involved in a group sing-along or clapping to the beat, the band gets the audience participating so that they become part of the show itself!

Jukebox Heroes: international tribute to Foreigner + Lou Gramm looks and sounds like Foreigner and Lou Gramm the way they were in their heyday in the 70s and 80s! Every show is a live music experience fans will never forget and keep coming back for more!

name: A Tribute to Frank Sinatra
bio: Rick Stephenson – His Sinatra is a dynamic authentic tribute to Old Blue Eyes by Rick Stephenson, a genuine Sinatra fan and accomplished musician. It is musical journey through the decades highlighting the hits of Frank Sinatra and his vast musical legacy! Rick has the voice, styling and phrasing reminiscent of Sinatra that delights fans of all ages.

With over 200+ songs in his repertoire you will hear all your favourites and more! Nominated by the 2023 Josie Music Awards for “Tribute Artist of the Year”. Rick’s musical journey began young leading his first Big Band at the age of 15. He completed his musical training at Toronto’s Humber College as a trombonist mentored by Ron Collier. As a professional musician Rick toured with his own 17 piece big band for 20 years, as the leader, singer and trombonist. A deep love and respect for Sinatra and his music led Rick to a career tributing The Chairman of the Board. Releasing multiple albums like “From One Blue Eyes to Another” and his 1998 release of “ His Way – Commemoration of the Art of Sinatra” to honour the Man and his Music. Rick has recently released his newest tribute album “Reflections In The Wee Small Hours” paying homage to Sinatra’s “In The Wee Small Hours of the Morning”. Performances have included opening the Jerry Lewis Telethon, Bravo Music Video, TV appearances, radio, concerts, dinner theatre, clubs, festivals, private/corporate events and more!

Rick Stephenson – His Sinatra is a solitary performance by Rick Stephenson accompanied by a combination of original musicians recordings along with his own orchestra recordings in personally remastered tracks. Full music charts available for Rick to swing Sinatra with a live band from a trio to big band or a full symphony orchestra.
Rick Stephenson is an sensational entertainer who has the voice and swagger to deliver an electrifying Sinatra experience!

Fresh Horses please crowds of all ages with their music and entertaining show. All music lovers can enjoy the songs of Garth Brooks as the music crosses all barriers. name: Tribute to Genesis and Peter Gabriel

photo.alt: Tribute to Genesis and Peter Gabriel

bio: G2R is not just a tribute band; they’re a portal to the golden eras of Peter Gabriel and Phil Collins within the Genesis legacy. With an unmatched blend of technical prowess and heartfelt passion, they breathe life into the timeless classics that once reverberated through theaters, arenas, and stadiums worldwide.

Their commitment to authenticity is unparalleled. Every note, every rhythm, every nuance is meticulously crafted to recreate the awe-inspiring live experience that defined Genesis. From the ethereal melodies of Peter Gabriel’s tenure to the pop-rock anthems of the Phil Collins era, G2R’s attention to detail is second to none.

The name “G2R” itself is a tribute and a promise. It stands for “Genesis to Revelation,” paying homage to the band’s inaugural album. But more than that, it symbolizes G2R’s unwavering dedication to traverse the entire Genesis catalogue, from its humble beginnings to its soaring heights. With G2R, audiences are not just treated to a concert; they embark on a journey through the evolution of one of the greatest bands in rock history.

bio: Dedicated to honoring the timeless music of the legendary George Strait, Dallas-born Howard Decker tours nationwide delivering the iconic look, the sound, the essence and spirit of George Strait’s chart-topping music, making every performance an unforgettable experience.

With Decker’s lifelong passion and admiration for George Strait’s legacy, the Strait Country Tribute strives to recreate the magic of King George’s world-famous performances. From classics like “Amarillo By Morning” to heartfelt ballads like “Check Yes or No,” Howard Decker brings the authenticity and charm that George Strait fans crave to see and hear.
Welcome to Strait Country Tribute, your ultimate destination for the nation’s top fan-favorite tribute to George Strait!

name: Tribute to George Strait
bio: Bentley Young, a gifted artist from Cornwall, Ontario, has taken the country music scene by storm with his heartfelt tribute to the legendary George Strait. His renditions of George Strait’s timeless hits, brought to life with an authenticity that captures the soul of each song, have earned him a reputation for excellence across Canada.

Bentley’s journey as an entertainer has been marked by a series of successful performances from coast to coast, each leaving a trail of mesmerized audiences. His ability to channel the very spirit of George Strait, combined with his uncanny similarities to the country music legend, has set Ben apart in the industry.

Bentley’s voice resonates with the same rich timbre that defines George Strait’s sound, and his style pays homage to the effortless charm that has made Mr. Strait a true icon. Audiences and critics alike have lauded hiss performances, attesting that his portrayal of George Strait is unparalleled.

This tribute is more than a performance; it’s a must-see spectacle that transcends time and connects audiences to the heart of George Strait’s musical legacy. From his hometown in Cornwall to the farthest reaches of Canada, Bentley has created an experience that honors the enduring influence of one of country music’s greatest legends.

Prepare to be transported to the heart of Nashville as Ben Young takes you on a musical journey celebrating the unmatched talent and timeless appeal of George Strait. Witnessing Bentley Young’s tribute is an opportunity not to be missed, a show that pays homage to a country music icon and leaves audiences with a deep appreciation for the enduring legacy of George Strait.

name: Tribute to George Thorogood

photo.alt: Bad to the Bone tribute to George Thorogood

bio: Based out of Oshawa, Ontario, Canada, Bad to the Bone was established in January 1994. The show, created by and featuring Gator James, has dazzled audiences all over North America. Having played numerous festivals, arenas, clubs and special events, Bad to the Bone is billed as the only authentic tribute to George Thorogood in North America.

Bad to the Bone has shared stages with many acts including Kim Mitchell and Killer Dwarfs. Bad to the Bone, the official B.A.D. Ride Band, has headlined the Annual B.A.D. Ride events held at the Canadian National Exhibition grounds since the year 2000.

Last year Bad to the Bone was flown to Regina, Saskatchewan to headline the first Show and Shine event for the Easy Riders of Saskatchewan. The event attracted a huge audience from all over Western Canada as well as parts of the US and was a great success.

name: Tribute to Gordon Lightfoot
bio: LEGENDARY LIGHTFOOT is a captivating musical tribute celebrating the timeless artistry of Canadian folk legend Gordon Lightfoot. This unforgettable live performance brings to life iconic songs like The Wreck of the Edmund Fitzgerald , Early Morning Rain , Sundown , If You Could Read My Mind , Carefree Highway , and many more, evoking the heartfelt emotions and storytelling that made Lightfoot a global treasure.

Led by award-winning artist Chris Scott and backed by the exceptionally talented WhoZat Band, LEGENDARY LIGHTFOOT delivers these classic hits with stunning authenticity and musical precision. Each performance captures the soulful essence of Lightfoot’s work, blending intricate guitar melodies, rich vocals, and evocative lyrics to create an immersive experience that resonates with audiences of all ages. From poignant ballads to uplifting anthems, these songs have stood the test of time, connecting generations through their universal themes of love, loss, and adventure.

With a deep commitment to honoring Gordon Lightfoot’s legacy, Chris Scott and The WhoZat Band perform with the passion and excellence that fans have come to expect from a world-class tribute. Their dynamic stage presence and meticulous attention to detail recreate the magic of a live Lightfoot concert, inviting audiences to relive cherished memories or discover his music anew.
songs: If You Could Read My Mind

name: Green Daze
bio: Green Daze is a high-octane riot that captures the raw power, snotty attitude, and stadium-sized hooks of punk rock’s most legendary trio. Based in Toronto and refined by over a decade of international touring, Green Daze has cemented its status as North America’s premier Green Day experience.

For over ten years, the members of Green Daze have obsessed over the details that matter. This is more than just playing the hits, it’s a meticulously crafted recreation. From the iconic blue guitar and the signature thumping bass tones down to the red ties, eyeliner, and frantic onstage charisma, the band delivers a performance that feels less like a cover set and more like a time machine.

While they call Ontario home, Green Daze is a global act. Their reputation for explosive performances has taken them across borders and oceans, earning them a dedicated following and a reputation for “dead-on” authenticity. Whether they are headlining a massive outdoor festival, packing out a legendary theatre, or bringing the sweat and energy of a dive bar to a corporate event, the mission remains the same: total crowd immersion. Green Daze masters every era of the Rock and Roll Hall of Famers’ catalog. Their sets are a relentless journey through three decades of hits.

With ten years of tight-knit chemistry and a relentless touring schedule, this is a “stadium-level” show compressed into any venue size. They bring the pyro-ready energy, the crowd-participation antics of Billie Joe Armstrong, and a professional production that makes every night feel like a sold-out tour stop.
songs: Wake Me Up When September Ends

name: Tribute to Hank Williams Sr.
bio: David’s Memories of Hank Williams go back into his early childhood, listening to limited recordings on an old phonograph, and a local radio station. Family members playing and singing songs from the legend, captivated his interest. This intensified and increased his love for Hank’s music! Through the years as he developed his own style, whether it be bluegrass or the traditional style country that he is noted for, Hank Williams music continues to have a profound impact on David’s vocal style and his writing techniques.

David spent 10 years in bluegrass with the group he created “OPEN HIGHWAY”, where he produced 4 albums and gained regional popularity performing throughout the Midwest where he met his partner, singer/songwriter, Terri Lisa. They decided to investigate the country scene and recorded a duo album in Nashville, produced by prominent producer/publicist Dick Mcvey. The album titled “Custom Made” was released early 2001. Custom Made was met with great success upon release to the world market. Many songs on the album have received airplay all over the world. The song “You’ve Got The Key” written by Joe Collins, climbed to #1 in The Netherlands, #6 in Germany, #6 in Italy. In addition the song received an overall rating of #11 for most airplay in a 6 month period. Early in 2002, David and wife Terri Lisa went to perform with a promotional tour, “Western hearts Promotions” and performed all over Europe ,in over 35 venues in prominent cities in Germany, Denmark, The Netherlands, and Belgium. They were featured on numerous radio shows.

Church has also gained popularity among Hank Williams fans. Hank Williams, as with many traditional style country artists, was David’s mentor and idol. As church developed his music he paid close attention to the late legend and studied both the writing techniques and vocals. Many people that have attended his performances have stated that David’s voice is so close to that of Hank Sr. that it is almost as if Hank were alive and well in Ohio. He was asked and performed at the 50th Anniversary Memorial to Hank Williams in Montgomery, Al. He led members of the original ” Drifting Cowboys” at the grave site in the song “I saw The Light by Hank Williams Sr.” Clips from the memorial appeared on National News on both CBS network, and several regional newspapers posted the picture of Church leading the crowd on the front page. His tribute show, called “Images Of A Country Drifter”, includes historical narration and 20 songs performed by Church. Included in the band, backing Church for the prestigious event was the legendary Don Helms, who gave up a spot on the Opry to be at the memorial and performed with David. Also present in the audience were additional members of the ” Drifting Cowboys”, including: Jimmy Porter, Clent Holmes, Lum York, and Braxton Shuffert.

name: Tribute to Heart
bio: Just Heart is an extraordinary tribute band that flawlessly captures the essence, power, and timeless appeal of the iconic rock band, Heart. With unparalleled talent and an unwavering dedication to authenticity, Just Heart delivers an unforgettable live experience.

Comprising a group of exceptionally skilled musicians and vocalists, Just Heart meticulously recreates the mesmerizing sound and captivating energy that made Heart a global sensation. From the soulful vocals to the masterful guitar solos and the pulsating rhythms, every aspect of Heart’s legendary sound is expertly brought to life on stage.

Just Heart embodies the spirit and charisma of the Wilson sisters, Ann and Nancy. Their remarkable vocal range, stage presence, and sheer passion for Heart’s music leave audiences spellbound, paying homage to the original band while adding their unique touch.

Just Heart takes you on an exhilarating musical journey, performing Heart’s greatest hits with precision and an unwavering commitment to authenticity. Whether it’s the electrifying power ballads like “Alone” and “What About Love,” or the hard-hitting rock anthems such as “Barracuda” and “Crazy on You,” Just Heart delivers a show-stopping performance that captivates fans of all generations.

name: Krista Blondin tribute to Janis Joplin

photo.alt: Krista Blondin tribute to Janis Joplin

bio: Audiences of all ages jump to their feet and scream in sheer delight when they hear the sounds of “Cry baaaaby” and for the next 90 minutes people are convinced that Janis Joplin is alive! Krista Blondin not only sings, looks and moves like Janis, she takes on her whole persona, even when she speaks. You could hear a pin drop by the way Krista captivates her audience between songs, sharing life stories and inspirational messages as though she were Janis in concert.

Krista puts so much of her heart and soul into this performance that it isn’t uncommon to see people in the crowd moved to tears. Within months of launching the show at the 2003 Port Credit Southside Shuffle, Krista was billed as a headliner for The Canadian National Exhibition’s Midway Stage and Niagara Falls Blues in The Park Concert Series.

When hired with her band titled “Piece Of My Heart”, the instrumentation consists of a seven piece band with a three piece horn section. Scaled down instrumentation can be provided for smaller budgets, however the full sound with horns really makes the show sound like the real thing! Krista’s backing musicians are all top notch seasoned players, some of which are recognized for working with BJ Thomas, Downchild Blues Band, Buddy Rich, Mirvish Productions and The Grand Ole’ Opry. The band is dressed accordingly for the show in 1960’s hippie wear for the full flashback experience!

name: Tribute to Jerry Lee Lewis
bio: B.B. Secrist delivers one of the most authentic and electrifying tributes to Jerry Lee Lewis. A self-taught pianist who began playing at just eight years old, B.B. has spent a lifetime mastering the pounding boogie-woogie rhythms, blazing piano runs, and fearless showmanship that made “The Killer” a rock ’n’ roll legend.

With explosive energy, commanding stage presence, and a deep respect for the music, B.B. brings the spirit of Jerry Lee Lewis to life in every performance. His high-octane shows have thrilled audiences across the United States, Canada, and several other countries, earning him a reputation as a true crowd-pleaser.
From the first note to the final encore, B.B. Secrist takes audiences on a wild ride through the golden age of rock ’n’ roll and leaves them breathless.

name: Tribute to Jimi Hendrix

photo.alt: Tony Springer Wild T Jimi Hendrix Tribute

bio: See Tony ‘Wild T’ Springer in FIRE the ultimate Jimi Hendrix Tribute. With his resemblance & mannerisms you’ll swear it’s Hendrix himself.
Tony’s exciting show includes full wardrobe as well as playing with his teeth, behind his back & head, and BURNING GUITARS!

Tony ” Wild T” has hung with the best of them. David Bowie, Jeff Healey, Bon Jovi, Deep Purple, Jay Leno, David Letterman and Arsenio Hall are just some of the musical acts and personalities that have been blown away by Wild T’s guitar playing.
Wild T is originally from Tunapuna, Trinidad. Though one may find similarities to Jimi Hendrix, ironically it was T’s first exposure to Steve Howe and classic Yes that inspired him to take up guitar.

Moving to Toronto, Canada, T quickly gained a reputation on the local club circuit. Since then he has recorded two albums (Love Crazy and Givin’ Blood 1995) with his own group, Wild T and the Spirit for Warner Brothers. He has also recorded an album (Black Tie, White Noise) with David Bowie and has appeared with Bowie on The Tonight Show with Jay Leno, Late Night with David Letterman and the Arsenio Hall Show.

He has toured with Bon Jovi and Deep Purple throughout North America and has performed thousands of club shows. Recently he was asked to portray Jimi Hendrix in the Monkee Movie for TMN because of his resemblance and showmanship.

name: Tribute to Jimmy Buffett
bio: Let down your hair, kick off your shoes and dance to the sprit of the keys
A Tribute To Jimmy Buffet & The Spirit Of The Islands

This seven piece band has a repertoire that caters to the music of Jimmy Buffett with a large dose of colourful Caribbean stylings including Reggae, Calypso, Soca and Latin… Enough to grab another Margarita … and that lost shaker of salt. Margaritaville’s blend of music is special. If you are going, or have ever been on a cruise through the Caribbean, had a romantic experience under the Florida sun, or just have an affinity for this kind of music, Margaritaville captures the spirit fully.

This band’s line-up includes experienced club and concert musicians featuring three lead vocalists, a percussionist and an incredible array of musical colourings within the seven members. This band has been selling out shows at venues all over North America and has earned the billing as one of the hottest showbands. The stage is reminiscent of a beachfront club in Jamaica or any of the other islands, with the colourfully dressed band doing their thing under the palm trees. So bring your sunblock, dress in your parrotthead finery and be prepared to be swept away on this Caribbean breeze. Margaritaville’s high energy and exciting show will suit any party or special event needs.

name: A Tribute to CCR and John Fogerty

photo.alt: A Tribute to CCR and John Fogerty

bio: Get ready to take a journey down the legendary musical highways of Creedence Clearwater Revival and the iconic John Fogerty as you’ve never experienced before. Meet Mystic Highway, the ultimate tribute band that pays homage to the timeless classics of CCR and the distinctive sound of John Fogerty. Leading the way is the incomparable Gil Giadola, channeling the spirit and talent of John Fogerty himself.

Hailing from Hamilton, Ontario, Gil Giadola brings an uncanny resemblance to John Fogerty both in looks and, more importantly, in that unmistakable voice that has echoed through generations. As the frontman of Mystic Highway, Gil’s powerful vocals, commanding stage presence, and masterful guitar skills capture the essence of one of rock ‘n’ roll’s greatest legends.

Mystic Highway takes audiences on a musical odyssey, reviving the raw and soulful sounds that made Creedence Clearwater Revival an enduring force in the world of rock. With an unwavering dedication to authenticity, the band recreates the magic of CCR’s timeless hits such as “Bad Moon Rising,” “Fortunate Son,” “Proud Mary,” and many more. Each note, each chord, and every lyric will transport you back in time to the golden era of rock ‘n’ roll.

When Mystic Highway hits the stage, you can expect a live experience like no other. The band’s commitment to excellence extends beyond the music. With their vintage instruments, authentic attire, and a mesmerizing stage production, they create an atmosphere that immerses the audience in the sights and sounds of the 1960s and ’70s.

Mystic Highway is more than a tribute band; it’s a labor of love by lifelong fans of CCR and John Fogerty. They share the passion and respect for the music that has defined generations. Whether you’re a die-hard Creedence Clearwater Revival enthusiast or discovering this timeless music for the first time, Mystic Highway promises an unforgettable, toe-tapping, hand-clapping, and sing-along experience that will keep you rocking all night long.

So, fasten your seatbelts, roll down the windows, and prepare to embark on a musical adventure like no other. Join Mystic Highway and Gil Giadola as they take you on a journey down the mystic highway of rock ‘n’ roll, celebrating the enduring legacy of Creedence Clearwater Revival and the indelible John Fogerty.

name: Tribute to John Mellencamp
bio: John Mellencamp – “formerly John Cougar Mellencamp, formerly-formerly John Cougar, is an American original. His emotionally authentic, straightforward rock n’ roll reflects his upbringing in the Heartland, combining pop, country, and folk to create poetic grooves that you can also jam out to on a bar’s jukebox. Remarkably successful, Mellencamp has sold more than 27 million albums, and the Rock and Roll Hall of Famer’s many hits like Jack and Diane, Hurts So Good, Cherry Bomb, Small Town, Pink Houses, and Authority Song are perpetually-played staples of classic rock radio.

Similar to the way that anyone can connect to Bruce Springsteen or Bob Dylan, seemingly everybody can enjoy or even relate to the people and themes in Mellencamp’s music. That’s because Mellencamp is a real guy who’s lived a few lifetimes’ worth of drama and struggle.” Brian Boone – Grunge.com

Scarecrow continues to recreate the energy and authentic sounds of John Mellencamp and his bands from the 80’s and 90’s. While Mellencamp artistically and masterfully adapts his music as only he can. Scarecrow performances are a “Déjà vu” to many Mellencamp fans and a “Wow” experience for all. Scarecrow has performed throughout North America from the Yukon to the Gulf of Mexico and from the Rockies to the Atlantic Coast.

Why a John ‘Cougar’ Mellencamp Tribute band? Compare the Hits that made it to the top 10 on the charts. Journey -25, Springsteen -26, Tom Petty -26, Eagles -21, John Mellencamp -29. Not many artists can have a full set of #1 songs (10).

Why Scarecrow? “You have all the moves and it sounds just like John Mellencamp when I saw him when I was younger”….is the most common comment. “It’s not John Mellencamp, but it’s almost John Mellencamp Live!”

name: Tribute to Johnny Cash

photo.alt: terry lee goffee johnny cash tribute

bio: In the spring of 1955 Johnny Cash walked into the legendary Sun Recording Studios in Memphis, Tennessee. The music world was never the same. In June 2003, we took the “Train of Love” tribute to Nashville for a couple of performances. Cash’s brother and sister, attended the show and came away impressed.
Tommy Cash stated, “My Brother would be proud”
Yates commented, “It’s a wonderful show, I would recommend it to anyone” and “you don’t impersonate my brother, you pay tribute to him with honor”

That was the greatest endorsement we could get … his brother and sister enjoying the show. That was a great boost to our confidence. We came away from Nashville saying, we must have gotten something right.

“Train of Love” sprang from my appreciation and love, not only for the music of Johnny Cash, but for the man himself. A champion of the underdog, a voice for those who often have none, an “outlaw” before it became fashionable.
If you come away from this presentation with a better understanding of who Johnny Cash is, I will have succeeded in my vision for this endeavor.
Enjoy the Ride Terry Lee Goffee

name: Only Journey

photo.alt: Tribute to Journey, Tribute to Steve Perry

bio: Only Journey is a dynamic tribute band devoted to honoring the timeless legacy of the legendary rock band Journey, bringing their iconic sound and electrifying energy to stages everywhere. With meticulous attention to detail, the band recreates the magic of Journey’s music, delivering powerful performances that resonate with fans of all ages. From the anthemic “Don’t Stop Believin’” to the heartfelt “Open Arms” and the high-energy “Separate Ways (Worlds Apart),” Only Journey’s setlist is a carefully curated journey through Journey’s chart-topping hits, evoking the spirit of the ‘70s and ‘80s arena rock era.

Comprising seasoned musicians with years of experience and a shared passion for Journey’s music, Only Journey captures the essence of the original band’s sound with soaring lead vocals, intricate guitar solos, thunderous rhythms, and lush keyboard melodies. Each member brings their own flair while staying true to the authentic arrangements and emotional depth that made Journey a household name. Their concerts are more than just a tribute—they’re a celebration of the music that defined a generation, delivered with heart, precision, and an infectious enthusiasm that keeps audiences singing along all night long. Whether performing at festivals, theaters, or local venues, Only Journey guarantees an unforgettable experience that pays homage to one of rock’s greatest bands while creating new memories for fans.

name: Tribute to Judy Garland
bio: “Judy Garland A Night In The Life…”

Celebrating the legacy of one of the greatest performers of all time, Julie Sheppard’s tribute to Judy Garland brings her timeless music and emotional depth to life with stunning authenticity. With a voice that mirrors Garland’s rich tone and expressive delivery, this performer captures every nuance, from the soaring vibrato to the heartfelt phrasing that defined Garland’s mature years. Audiences are transported to the golden age of Hollywood and the concert halls where Garland captivated the world.

Praised for her uncanny vocal likeness and emotional sensitivity, she doesn’t simply imitate, she embodies Garland’s spirit, vulnerability, and resilience. Each performance honors the legend with elegance and reverence, blending iconic hits, storytelling, and the raw sincerity that made Judy Garland unforgettable. Whether on stage with a full orchestra or in an intimate cabaret setting, this tribute is a heartfelt journey through the life and music of a true icon.
“It works from beginning to end, owing not only to Julie Sheppard’s uncanny vocal similarity to Garland…she captures all of the vocal nuances of the mature Garland.” ~Variety
“According to people in the audience, (Sid) Luft wept as Julie recreated some of Judy’s songs…” PAGE SIX NY Post Richard Johnson
“Garland has never been honored quite so eloquently as in Julie Sheppard’s cabaret.” New York Post
“Julie Sheppard doesn’t impersonate Garland; she inhabits her and brings the legend back to life.” Drama-Logue
“She represents a sort of perfection of Garland…she magically becomes her.” Steve Allen
“A musical variety spectacular, at The Renberg Theatre.” Frontiers Newsmagazine
“Julie Sheppard’s tribute to Judy Garland is so moving that it has many critics using superlatives they haven’t used since Garland was alive.” Parlee Entertainment Magazine
“You will truly believe you are in Garland’s presence!” Another Voice

name: Tribute to Katy Perry
bio: Bringing the color, confidence, and larger-than-life energy of Katy Perry to the stage, this dynamic tribute artist delivers a dazzling celebration of one of pop music’s most recognizable stars. With a powerful voice, playful personality, and commanding stage presence, she captures the spirit of Katy’s live performances while giving every audience an exciting, feel-good show of its own.

Her set features fan favorites such as “Firework,” “Roar,” “Teenage Dream,” “California Gurls,” “Hot N Cold,” and “Last Friday Night.” From soaring anthems to upbeat dance hits, each performance is packed with vibrant choreography, audience interaction, and the bold theatrical style that has made Katy Perry a global pop icon.

Eye-catching costumes, colorful visuals, and carefully recreated performance details help turn every appearance into a full pop spectacle. Whether performing with backing tracks, dancers, or a live band, she can adapt the show for theaters, festivals, corporate events, private parties, and special celebrations.

More than a lookalike performance, this tribute is designed to make audiences sing, dance, and feel inspired. Fun, glamorous, and full of positive energy, the show offers Katy Perry fans of all ages a memorable night of chart-topping music and unforgettable entertainment.

bio: Ultimate Urban isn’t just a tribute band; they’re an electrifying embodiment of Keith Urban’s iconic style and unparalleled energy. Hailed as an international sensation, they bring the rock-star swagger and fiery charisma that ignite crowds at festivals, fairs, and clubs across North America.

Their performances are a masterclass in homage, meticulously covering every facet of Keith Urban’s illustrious career. From the chart-topping anthems like “Somebody Like You” and “Long Hot Summer” to the soul-stirring ballads like “You Look Good In My Shirt,” Ultimate Urban delivers an unforgettable experience that pays homage to one of country music’s most revered talents.

With a stage presence that commands attention and musicianship that rivals the legend himself, Ultimate Urban doesn’t just replicate Keith Urban’s music; they embody his spirit, his passion, and his unwavering commitment to delivering the ultimate live performance. Prepare to be swept away on a journey through the heart and soul of country music with Ultimate Urban.

name: Tribute to Kenny Rogers
bio: Experience the music of GRAMMY® Award-winning superstar Kenny Rogers. A musical experience that spans over six decades of hit after hit song! His music is loved throughout the world and connects with generation after generation. Kenny’s command of the stage, heartfelt performances, gift for storytelling and distinctive voice are all on full display in this honoring recreation of his LIVE performances.

Join us as, award winning country recording artist Alan Turner, recreates the magic of a night with Kenny in the Ultimate Kenny Rogers Tribute Show, The Gambler Returns. Audiences leave the performance wanting more.
Chose from three shows: Gambler Returns: Ultimate Kenny Rogers Tribute, Christmas and the Hits, or Real Love: Kenny Rogers and Dolly Parton Tribute with Laurie Lynn as Dolly.

name: Tribute to Kiss
bio: Hey there KISS Army! Do you remember what it was like many years ago when you first set your eyes on the album cover of Kiss Alive? How about Kiss Alive 2? Do you remember spending many days and nights just staring at the covers while the records played in the background? You could just imagine the Demon spitting blood and breathing fire, the Starchild prancing around, Space Ace ripping out guitar solos that made his guitar smoke and of course the Catman pounding his drum kit. Well, people it’s time to relive all those memories with the newest and best Kiss tribute to come out of Toronto in a LONG time… KISSOLOGY! That’s right KISSOLOGY!

Playing with the power and passion that Kiss fans have become accustomed to for over 35 years! All the hits, all the sweat all the glory, you get a total recreation of what made Kiss one of the most influential bands ever in Rock and Roll history.

So, people get ready not only to shout it out Loud but to Rock and Roll all Night and party everyday! Watch out for KISSOLOGY in a city or town near you. Come and experience what everyone will be talking about.
KISSOLOGY the ONLY REAL tribute to KISS!

name: Tribute to Lady Gaga
bio: In an era where pop stars often emerge from reality TV shows or celebrity lineages, it’s refreshing to witness an artist who has earned her stripes through sheer determination and raw talent. This rising pop sensation didn’t rely on a model’s look or a famous surname to pave her path to stardom. Instead, she honed her craft the traditional way – through gritty club gigs and relentless self-promotion.

“I did it the hard way. I performed in every dive bar in New York City, faced rejection, and then triumphed. It was in those moments of struggle that I truly discovered myself as an artist. I learned resilience, authenticity, and the value of failure. Through it all, I never stopped working hard.”

Now, step into the world of this extraordinary tribute to Lady Gaga and experience the magic of her music firsthand. From chart-topping hits to soul-stirring ballads, this tribute artist captures the essence of Gaga’s unparalleled talent and charisma. Get ready to be dazzled by an unforgettable homage to one of pop music’s most iconic figures.

His performances capture the heart and soul of Combs’ music, from the energetic anthems to the heartfelt ballads, offering audiences a chance to relive the magic of Luke Combs’ live shows. With Dave’s powerful vocals, engaging stage presence, and genuine love for country music, each performance feels like a front-row seat to a Luke Combs concert.

Dave’s tribute to Luke Combs goes beyond just mimicking the superstar’s voice. He brings the full experience of a Luke Combs concert, from his distinctive look to his dynamic stage presence. Dave’s attention to detail ensures that every song, from hits like “Hurricane” and “When It Rains It Pours” to the more recent chart-toppers, is performed with precision and authenticity. Fans of Luke Combs will be amazed at how well Dave captures the energy and emotion of the original performances, leaving them with memories of a night that feels truly unforgettable.

Whether it’s a private party, corporate event, or a large public gathering, Dave McNab’s tribute show is perfect for any occasion. With years of experience in live performances, Dave knows how to engage his audience and create an unforgettable night of entertainment. His dedication to his craft and his ability to connect with fans makes every show a memorable event. If you’re a Luke Combs fan, booking Dave for your event will be the highlight of the evening!

name: Tribute to Lynyrd Skynyrd
bio: Street Survivors, hailing from the picturesque Niagara region, is a passionate tribute band dedicated to honoring the legendary Lynyrd Skynyrd. With their soulful renditions and electrifying performances, they pay homage to the iconic Southern rock band that left an indelible mark on music history.
Frontman Don. E. Toy’s powerful voice captures the essence of Ronnie Van Zant, delivering Skynyrd’s anthems with raw emotion and authenticity.

Together, Street Survivors brings Lynyrd Skynyrd’s timeless hits to life, from “Sweet Home Alabama” to “Free Bird.” Whether you’re a die-hard Skynyrd fan or a newcomer to their music, Street Survivors will transport you back to the golden era of Southern rock. Catch them live and experience the magic of Lynyrd Skynyrd all over again!

name: Tribute to Madonna
bio: Madonna. She touched us for the very first time in 1984 and has left us wanting more ever since. Its because of her that we strike a pose, express ourselves, get in the groove and remember that music makes the people come together!

Now add to that the fact that she’s cited as the most successful female recording artist of all time, has a loyal international following to which she’s sold well over 200 million records, and that she is, without a doubt, the original diva – with so much to pay tribute to, its no wonder Madgesty gets up and does their thing.

The immaculate concept of five die-hard fans and performers, Madgesty is more than just a Madonna tribute band and dance troupe based in Toronto they’re an embodiment of Madonna’s never-ending reinvention of herself. Starring the sensational Stephanie Spada as Madonna and a talented roster of backup dancers and musicians, the group infuses classic choreography and detailed costume reproduction with a new twist of their favourite tracks, giving them fresh, club-friendly dance arrangements, from 80s hits like Vogue to Confessions on a Dance Floor and Future Lovers.

name: Tribute to Michael Jackson
bio: A sensational performer who captivates audiences around the world with his electrifying performances and incredible resemblance to the King of Pop himself – the one and only Michael Jackson Tribute Artist!

With his uncanny resemblance and meticulous attention to detail, our tribute artist brings Michael Jackson back to life on stage. From the signature moonwalk to the mesmerizing spins and dynamic stage presence, he effortlessly channels the energy and charisma that made the King of Pop a global sensation.

Whether it’s the infectious beats of “Billie Jean,” the emotional depth of “Man in the Mirror,” or the sheer excitement of “Thriller,” he flawlessly captures the essence of Michael Jackson’s music.

name: Tribute to Neil Diamond
bio: Solitary Man is a spectacular musical celebration of Neil Diamond, bringing the sound, style, and spirit of one of the world’s most beloved entertainers to audiences across North America and beyond.

At the heart of the show is Will Chalmers, whose rich, powerful vocals, authentic stage presence, and remarkably accurate mannerisms capture the unmistakable essence of Neil Diamond. From the moment he steps into the spotlight, audiences are transported back to the golden era of the 1970s, when Diamond’s timeless songs dominated the charts and filled arenas around the world.

Backed by an outstanding all-Canadian cast of nine accomplished musicians, Solitary Man delivers a full-scale concert experience packed with energy, emotion, and unforgettable music. The show features hit after hit, including “Love on the Rocks,” “Cracklin’ Rosie,” “Forever in Blue Jeans,” “September Morn,” “Song Sung Blue,” “America,” “I Am… I Said,” and, of course, the audience favorite “Sweet Caroline.”

Every performance is carefully crafted to honor the sound and excitement of a classic Neil Diamond concert. From heartfelt ballads to soaring anthems and irresistible sing-along moments, the production captures the warmth, passion, and showmanship that have made these songs beloved for generations.

Whether you are a lifelong Neil Diamond fan or discovering his music for the first time, Solitary Man offers an evening of outstanding musicianship, powerful vocals, and timeless entertainment. This is more than a tribute show—it is a thrilling journey through one of the greatest songbooks in popular music, performed with authenticity, energy, and heart.

name: Tribute to Neil Young

photo.alt: Tribute to Neil Young Continental Entertainment

bio: Neil Young is one of the most recognizable and enduring figures in modern music history.

The combination of his totally unique voice, his deeply personal lyrics along with the wide range of instrumentation that he employs in creating his music makes for one of the most distinctive and compelling sounds in the world of popular music.

With a focus on Neil’s younger days, ‘After The Gold Rush’ brings the closest sonic and visual performance to the real experience available. It’s all there…the voice, the sound, the songs and the sights.

In theatre settings, an ‘After The Gold Rush’ show includes awesome 3D visual elements bringing to life the psychedelia of the early 1970’s west coast epoch. A virtual musical walk through of a very important time in popular music that should not be missed!

‘After The Gold Rush’ is fronted by Andrew Sansone performing as “The Loner”. With over 20 years as a professional musician and playing multiple instruments Andrew provides audiences of all ages the dynamic and emotional musical experience that you would expect from Neil Young himself.
The backing band members are all professional seasoned musicians from the Greater Toronto area and have played literally 1000’s of shows at various festivals, theatres and night clubs.

name: Tribute to Nirvana
bio: It’s not a trick question when people ask who the biggest rock band of the 1990’s was. The obvious answer is NIRVANA. The year was 1991. At the time pop was dominating the charts with bands such as New Kids On The Block to Tiffany dominating the charts. Rock was clearly dying out due to the over exposure of hair rock bands. People were very eager for something new and different to hit the market. It seemed out of nowhere the album NEVERMIND was released. Most thought it to be just another rock album that would soon be forgotten however history would prove people dead wrong.

The biggest album at the time which was number 1 on billboard was Michael Jackson’s Dangerous. This remained for several weeks till the unthinkable happened. The popularity of NEVERMIND just blew up like a bolt of lightning to eventually on January 25. 1992, knock Dangerous out of the #1 position on Billboard. Rock and roll had finally made a massive comeback in mainstream music.

NIRVANA had successfully changed the face of rock and roll forever. Since their time on the scene they had influenced a wide variety of bands to follow in their sound. They made history with their music and spoke for an entire generation of people.

On April 12, 1994 Kurt Cobain was found dead, he apparently had committed suicide. This event had been named the top 5 most shocking moments in rock and roll. With this tragic event ending the NIRVANA live show it has left many die-hard fans with never receiving the opportunity to have seen NIRVANA live. Due to this Singer/guitarist Eddy Culjak formed the band NEVERMIND.

NEVERMIND is a complete authentic remake of NIRVANA. They have a great live show with the same energy offered by NIRVANA as well as the occasional smashing of instruments. Material covered by NEVERMIND is taken from all of the albums as well as unreleased songs. It is always a great treat for NIRVANA fans to see NEVERMIND in concert. NEVERMIND has performed all over Canada as well as the United States . Keep your eye out for this great recreation of one of the biggest rock and roll bands in the history of music.

name: Tribute to Oasis

photo.alt: Tribute to Oasis Canada Continental Entertainment

bio: Formed in 2009, Supersonic quickly emerged as one of the most electrifying Oasis tribute bands on the scene. Comprising a group of passionate musicians deeply influenced by the iconic Britpop legends, Supersonic set out to recreate the raw energy, infectious melodies, and timeless anthems that made Oasis a phenomenon.

Hailing from diverse musical backgrounds, each member of Supersonic brings their unique flair and dedication to the stage, faithfully channeling the spirit of Liam and Noel Gallagher and their legendary bandmates. From the swaggering bravado of “Wonderwall” to the rebellious spirit of “Rock ‘n’ Roll Star,” Supersonic delivers an authentic Oasis experience that leaves audiences exhilarated and nostalgic for the heyday of ’90s Britpop.

With meticulous attention to detail in both sound and presentation, Supersonic captures the essence of Oasis, transporting audiences back to the era when songs like “Live Forever” and “Champagne Supernova” ruled the airwaves. Whether performing in intimate venues or commanding festival stages, Supersonic never fails to ignite the crowd with their infectious enthusiasm and uncanny ability to recreate the magic of Oasis’s live performances.

In their decade-long journey, Supersonic has garnered a loyal following of fans who share their passion for the music of Oasis. From die-hard aficionados who experienced the ’90s Britpop explosion firsthand to a new generation discovering the timeless appeal of classics like “Don’t Look Back in Anger,” Supersonic continues to celebrate the legacy of one of the greatest bands in rock history.

With their dedication to authenticity and their electrifying live shows, Supersonic pays homage to Oasis with reverence and excitement, ensuring that the spirit of Manchester’s favorite sons lives on for audiences old and new.
