name: Tribute to Pat Benatar
bio: Pat Benatar is one of rock’s most iconic voices: a four-time Grammy Award winner, a classically trained mezzo-soprano, and a trailblazing artist who helped define the sound and style of the MTV generation.

Throughout the 1980s, Benatar dominated the charts with two RIAA-certified multi-platinum albums, five platinum albums, three gold albums, and 19 Top 40 singles. Her unforgettable hits include “Hit Me With Your Best Shot,” “Love Is a Battlefield,” “We Belong,” and “Invincible.” With her powerhouse vocals, fearless stage presence, and unmistakable attitude, Pat Benatar paved the way for generations of female rock artists.

Invincible brings that energy back to the stage with a dynamic tribute performed by seasoned professional musicians, including members of the classic Canadian rock band MOXY. Fronted by the incredible Kristine Bishop, whose powerful vocals capture the fire, range, and spirit of Benatar herself, Invincible delivers a thrilling live show packed with the songs fans know and love.
Don’t miss one of the most exciting and talked-about Pat Benatar tributes to hit the stage in years.

name: Tribute to Paul McCartney

photo.alt: All McCartney tribute to Paul McCartney and Wings, The Beatles

bio: Stars International touring musician IAN B. GARCIA of the Broadway show, “RAIN: A Tribute to The Beatles” as well as England’s West End spectacular, “LET IT BE: A Celebration of the music of The Beatles”.

Garcia was there in 2012 at The Prince Of Wales Theatre when LET IT BE began its successful run of The West End. In 2015 Garcia and cast where at Liverpool’s Royal Court Theatre for 5 weeks before heading off to Japan.

In 2016 Garcia toured the UK with LET IT BE before returning back home to begin his new show. This exciting new live concert continues the musical legacy of Sir Paul McCartney after his incredible career in the Beatles.

McCartney’s hits and classic favourites from his solo album catalog as well as his band “Wings” and of course, The Beatles are all performed live onstage with an incredible supporting cast of 4 musicians.

ALL McCartney Live captures Sir Paul in the present using modern sound, technology, lights and video support that will take the audience on an emotional and nostalgic journey through 1963 to present day!
Ian B. Garcia is endorsed by Hofner Guitars of Germany!

bio: This Phil Collins tribute is a truly one-of-a-kind celebration of the legendary artist’s life and career. At the heart of this incredible show is lead singer Ron Belgard, who bears an uncanny resemblance to Phil Collins both physically and vocally. This remarkable likeness is just the beginning, as Ron’s deep respect for Phil’s work shines through in every aspect of the performance.

As a skilled drummer, Ron brings the full scope of Phil Collins’ talents to the stage, recreating the iconic sound and energy that has captivated audiences for decades. With a meticulous attention to detail, Ron’s tribute show is a loving homage to Phil’s enduring legacy, featuring a carefully curated selection of hits and fan favorites.

Whether you’re a die-hard Phil Collins fan or simply looking for a unique and unforgettable entertainment experience, this tribute show is sure to delight and inspire. So come and relive the magic of Phil Collins with Ron Belgard and his incredible tribute band.

name: Tribute to Pink Floyd

photo.alt: Floyd Factor Tribute to Pink Floyd

bio: Since 2006, FLOYD FACTOR have been meticulously recreating the legendary sounds of PINK FLOYD and thrilling audiences of up to 10,000 in Canada and the US. During this time, FLOYD FACTOR has established itself as the platinum standard for tributes and has shared the stage with some of rock’s legends.

What really sets FLOYD FACTOR apart from the others is the incredible likeness of the lead vocals to the original members of PINK FLOYD combined with the intensely accurate note-for-note instrumental work. These are the band’s hallmarks and the foundation on which their reputation has been built.

FLOYD FACTOR features two brilliant veteran guitarists (Andre Filippetti and Sam Boutzouvis), ensuring that all of David Gilmour’s recorded parts are present and accounted for in note-for-note detail, as well as an award winning, JUNO-nominated keyboardist, Dylan Bell. The band is rounded out by a veteran rhythm section, and six gifted vocalists, including the show-stopping vocals of Ms. Chloe Watkinson, whose rendition of Great Gig in The Sky is a highlight in every show. PINK FLOYD’S soaring saxophone lines are beautifully rendered by (Chloe’s father) Terry Watkinson, a former member of Canadian prog-rock stewards MAX WEBSTER and celebrated artist.

name: A Tribute to Queen

photo.alt: Simply Queen - a tribute to Queen

bio: Introducing “Simply Queen: A Canadian Queen Tribute”! Hailing from the vibrant city of Windsor, Ontario, Simply Queen pays homage to the legendary rock band Queen with an electrifying live tribute experience.

Led by the incomparable Freddie Mercury impersonator extraordinaire, Rick Rock, Simply Queen brings the iconic songs of Queen to life with unparalleled energy and charisma. Rick Rock is not only a dynamic entertainer but also a virtuoso vocalist, guitarist, and pianist, channeling the spirit of Freddie Mercury himself on stage. Backing Rick Rock are seasoned musicians Wayne Brauer on guitar and keyboards, Mitch Taylor on bass, and Phil Charrette on drums. Together, they form a powerhouse ensemble that faithfully recreates the grand scope of Queen’s live shows, both musically and visually.

With performances in festivals, theaters, and arenas across North America and beyond, Simply Queen guarantees to deliver an unforgettable experience that will “Blow Your Mind!” Get ready to be transported to the heyday of Queen and witness the magic of their timeless music brought to life by Simply Queen. Long live the Queen!

name: Tribute to Rascal Flatts
bio: A Rascal Flatts Experience delivers an authentic and heartfelt celebration of one of country music’s most beloved bands. With spot-on harmonies, soulful vocals, and exceptional musicianship, the show captures the signature sound that made Rascal Flatts a household name. From emotional ballads to high-energy anthems, every performance is crafted to reflect the passion and sincerity of the original group.

Bringing fans back to the golden era of early 2000s country pop, this tribute recreates the spirit of Rascal Flatts’ live performances with attention to detail and genuine love for the music. Audiences are treated to lush harmonies, heartfelt storytelling, and a concert-style experience that feels both nostalgic and exciting.
Perfect for country fans of all ages, this show honors the legacy of Rascal Flatts by celebrating the songs, style, and soul of the trio’s unforgettable career.

bio: An uncanny Regis Philbin impersonator who captures the wit, charm, and undeniable charisma of the beloved TV personality. With his striking resemblance and remarkable ability to channel Regis’ larger-than-life presence, he’ll bring an authentic Regis Philbin experience to any event or occasion.

With his impeccably tailored suits, trademark grin, and a warm, engaging personality, he flawlessly recreates Regis’ legendary hosting style. Whether he’s engaging in playful banter with audience members or interviewing special guests, he’ll capture the essence of Regis’ unparalleled ability to connect with people and make every moment memorable.

If you’re seeking to add a touch of nostalgia, laughter, and undeniable charm to your event, look no further than this Regis Philbin impersonator who effortlessly transports you back to the golden age of television and leaves you feeling like you just spent an evening with the one and only Regis Philbin himself.

name: A Tribute to Roy Orbison
bio: Elton Lammie has made quite a career for himself as a country music singer and tribute artist to Roy Orbison. As a vocalist, Elton has won dozens of talent competitions in Canada and the USA. He has extensive Radio and TV credits as a performer. If that wasn’t enough, Elton struck out as a legit Opera Tenor by winning a televised reality show looking for Canada’s next Opera Star. This operatic training has also paved the way for a successful venture as a Roy Orbison impersonator. Orbison had one of the most unique, powerful and cherished voices in recorded music history and Elton is one of very few Roy tribute artists in the world that sings the songs in the original keys. As Roy himself would’ve exclaimed… MERCY!

name: Tribute to Sammy Hagar

photo.alt: three lock box tribute to sammy hagar

bio: Three Lock Box: The Ultimate Sammy Hagar Tribute is the premier live salute to the Red Rocker, delivering a high-octane celebration of more than five decades of unforgettable rock ’n’ roll.

The show takes audiences back to Sammy Hagar’s explosive early days with Montrose, featuring classics such as “Rock Candy” and “Bad Motor Scooter.” From there, the band powers through the gold- and platinum-selling solo hits that made Sammy one of rock’s most recognizable voices, including “There’s Only One Way to Rock,” “I Can’t Drive 55,” “Your Love Is Driving Me Crazy,” “I’ll Fall in Love Again,” “Mas Tequila,” and many more.

Three Lock Box also celebrates Sammy’s legendary 11-year run as the frontman of Van Halen. With four multi-platinum studio albums that all reached No. 1 on the U.S. charts, that era produced some of the biggest arena-rock anthems of the late ’80s and early ’90s. Fans can expect powerful performances of “Right Now,” “Love Walks In,” “Why Can’t This Be Love,” “Best of Both Worlds,” and other Van Hagar favorites.

With authentic musicianship, soaring vocals, relentless energy, and the party atmosphere Sammy Hagar fans know and love, Three Lock Box brings the full Red Rocker experience to the stage. It is more than a tribute—it is a loud, fast, feel-good rock show built for theaters, festivals, casinos, clubs, and special events.

name: Tribute to Santana
bio: Persuasion is a song from Santana’s first smash album released back in 1969. Persuasion is also the name of the best and only consistently performing Santana tribute band in Canada.
Formed in 2010 and based in Montreal, the band has established itself as the ultimate in Santana tributes, paying homage to one of the world’s best guitarists, Carlos Santana.
With singing guitar riffs, infectious rhythms and explosive percussion, Persuasion faithfully recreates most of Santana’s first three albums and many of his later hits as well.

The band is comprised of 7 musicians, all seasoned pros that have united to perform the music and the spirit of Carlos Santana and the Santana Band. Their sound features his melodic, blues-based guitar lines set against Latin and African rhythms. Once you feel and hear the power of Persuasion you won’t be able to sit still!
Persuasion has performed at many of the great clubs and events in and around Québec and Eastern Ontario.

name: Shania Twain
bio: Donna Huber, known professionally as Shania Twin, has captivated audiences worldwide with her remarkable tribute to Shania Twain. Born and raised in Ontario, Canada, Donna’s journey into the world of tribute performances began when strangers frequently remarked on her uncanny resemblance to the country music superstar. Embracing these comments, Donna dedicated herself to perfecting her act, meticulously studying Shania Twain’s performances, vocal techniques, and stage presence.

Donna’s dedication paid off when she met Shania Twain and her family. Shania herself was astounded by Donna’s likeness, famously stating, “I thought that was me! Donna is the best Shania Twain Tribute out there.” This high praise from the icon she emulates has been a cornerstone of Donna’s career, further solidified by Shania mentioning Donna in her biography. Such recognition has propelled Donna to the forefront of tribute artists, earning her a reputation as the premier Shania Twain tribute performer.

Since 1996, Donna has been touring extensively across North America and Europe, bringing the magic of Shania Twain’s music to fans everywhere. Her performances have been a highlight at major events, including the Calgary Stampede, and she has had the honor of entertaining Canadian troops in Bosnia, Croatia, and Dubai. Donna’s ability to connect with audiences and deliver an authentic Shania Twain experience has made her a sought-after act for conventions, corporate events, and special occasions.

Donna’s success as Shania Twin is not just about her physical resemblance to Shania Twain but also her ability to capture the essence of Shania’s music and persona. She has spent countless hours perfecting her craft, ensuring that every performance is a true homage to the beloved artist. Her dedication to authenticity and her passion for music shine through in every show, leaving audiences in awe and earning her a loyal fan base.

Today, Donna Huber continues to perform as Shania Twin, bringing joy and nostalgia to Shania Twain fans around the world. Her journey from a small-town girl to an internationally acclaimed tribute artist is a testament to her talent, hard work, and the enduring appeal of Shania Twain’s music. Donna’s story is one of inspiration, proving that with dedication and passion, dreams can indeed come true.
This is what people are saying about Donna Huber…
“I thought that was me for a moment … she’s the best one” Shania Twain upon seeing a photo of Donna – TNN Prime time. March 1998
“I’m flattered that she is doing a tribute to me and I’m hearing great things about her” Shania Twain – Timmins, Ontario
“You look and sound just like my granddaughter” Grandma Twain
“Donna was the biggest hit on stage at the Calgary Stampede” Country Music News August 1998
“A first class act” Bluff’s Run Casino – Council Bluffs, Iowa
“People attending the show thought Donna was the real Shania” C.N.E. – Toronto, Ontario
“As far as I’m concerned I had the real Shania Twain on stage” Trudeau Park – Tweed, Ontario
“A definite highlight of the tour” Bosnian Armed Forces Tour
“An outstanding performance” Wisconsin State Fair – Milwaukee, WI

name: Gaucho tribute to Steely Dan
bio: Authenticity and dedication to the creators of Steely Dan music is what drives the band Gaucho. Long time musical collaborators John Tersigni and Peter Morrison teamed with blues and rock vocalist JD Maass to represent the vocal stylings of Donald Fagen. Jazz and funk bassist Colin Flint completed the rhythm section with his crafty and pure Chuck Rainey styled tones on bass. Rounding out the sounds created by Walter Becker on guitar, are Brian G and Craig Brandys. John Pagnotta completes the picture with his impressive horn playing on saxophones.

Despite its undeniable impact and resonance, Steely Dan’s music often goes underappreciated in Canada. However, Gaucho seeks to change that narrative, with each performance earning praise from audiences of all generations. Their shows consistently elicit feedback affirming the timelessness and classic nature of Steely Dan’s repertoire.

Gaucho’s mission is clear: to showcase the best of Steely Dan’s music to eager listeners of classic jazz rock. As a local band, Gaucho has garnered a reputation for delivering electrifying live performances that captivate audiences and celebrate the enduring legacy of Steely Dan

name: Tribute to Stevie Wonder
bio: Timeless Wonder is a remarkable tribute that celebrates the career of one of America’s musical icons, Stevie Wonder The Timeless Wonder show is guaranteed to delight audiences of all ages and cultures. Steven Baldwin’s portrayal of Stevie Wonder is nothing short of remarkable Born in San Lorenzo, Ca.

In 1969 into a musically inclined family, Steven Baldwin had no idea that his life would so closely parallel the life of Stevie Wonder At the age of 12 years old, Steven Baldwin was diagnosed with a rare eye disorder, Retinitis Pigmentosa. At this time, Steven was informed the he would be blind by his mid-twenties. Although the physician’s diagnosis came true, just as Stevie Wonder, Steven Baldwin would not allow this to hold him back. The vocal ability that was nurtured by his family since the age of 9 years old, brought itself to the forefront. Tapping into this talent and his other senses, Steven Baldwin soon become an accomplished vocalist and musician in his own right.

Graduating from Cal Berkeley in 1992 Steven Baldwin set out to pursue his musical career It is amazing to witness Steven Baldwin as Stevie Wonder for you will surely get lost in the resemblance. Will the real Stevie Wonder please stand up. TIMELESS WONDER a Tribute to Stevie Wonder, definitely a show to Experience!!!
The TIMELESS WONDER repertoire includes over 265 songs!
songs: I Just Called To Say I Love You
I Was Made To Love Her
You Are The Sunshine Of My Life

name: Tribute to Sting and The Police

photo.alt: Tribute to Sting and The Police

bio: Born of a lifelong love affair with the music of Gordon Sumner, AKA “Sting”, Sound of Sting draws from the best of the best of his catalogue. And no era of his music is off limits. From the soaring Reggae infused Rock & Roll of the Police, to the driving contemporary R&B infused Jazz of his solo career, Sound of Sting covers it all.

Sting has consistently enlisted the skills of some of the greatest instrumentalists of our time to conceive of not only beautifully technical music but also songs and stories that continue to resonate with people around the world. He also continually evolves his songs with new and more daring arrangements, breathing new life into them and exploring the depth of their complexity. Under the direct influence of all of your favourite Police & Sting albums, this band is dedicated to reproducing the original recordings of those timeless songs. Sound of Sting promises to take you back to the moment you first heard and fell in love with your Sting & Police favourites.

name: Tribute to Styx
bio: Ultimate Styx celebrates the powerful sound, soaring harmonies, and theatrical energy of one of classic rock’s most distinctive bands. While many tribute acts take on familiar rock catalogues, there are surprisingly few dedicated to the music of Styx — and for good reason. Styx was built around five exceptional musicians, each bringing a high level of technical skill, strong vocals, and a unique musical personality to the stage.

The music of Styx is anything but simple. Their songs blend hard rock, progressive rock, pop, opera, and musical theatre into a sound that is instantly recognizable and incredibly demanding to perform. From intricate keyboard parts and blazing guitar lines to driving rhythms and legendary high-pitched vocal harmonies, Styx created a catalogue that requires more than just musicianship, it requires precision, range, and a deep respect for the original arrangements.

Ultimate Styx brings together five experienced, professional musicians with the rare ability to capture that classic Styx sound as it was heard during the band’s peak years in the 1970s and 1980s. Recreating the era when Styx was at the height of their fame, Ultimate Styx delivers faithful, note-for-note renditions of the songs fans know and love, while bringing the excitement and energy of a live rock concert to every performance.

Audiences can expect to hear the signature harmonies, powerful vocals, and dynamic musicianship that made Styx a staple of arena rock. From anthems and progressive epics to unforgettable power ballads, Ultimate Styx honours the spirit, sound, and showmanship of the original band.
For lifelong Styx fans and classic rock lovers alike, Ultimate Styx offers an authentic tribute experience that brings the magic of this legendary music back to the stage.

name: Tribute to Supertramp
bio: Dreamer – The World’s most authentic tribute to Supertramp!
Dreamer brings the legendary music of Supertramp to life in a spectacular live theatre experience, recreating the sound, atmosphere and unmistakable character of one of rock’s most iconic bands.

Featuring remarkable vocal performances that closely capture the distinctive voices of Roger Hodgson and Rick Davies, Dreamer delivers Supertramp’s timeless catalogue with extraordinary accuracy, energy and musicianship. The eight-piece band features live clarinet, saxophone, flute and trombone, alongside vintage keyboards, including the classic Wurlitzer sound that became such an essential part of Supertramp’s identity.

More than a tribute concert, Dreamer is a fully produced stage show. Costume changes, theatrical lighting and carefully curated film projections combine to create an immersive journey through the music and imagery of Supertramp’s greatest era.

At the heart of the performance is a complete live rendition of the landmark album Crime of the Century , performed in its entirety. The show also features a collection of the band’s biggest and best-loved hits, including favourites from across Supertramp’s extraordinary career.

Praised by audiences, promoters and venues alike, Dreamer has received outstanding reviews and enthusiastic standing ovations at theatre performances to date. For lifelong Supertramp fans and anyone who appreciates exceptional live music, Dreamer offers an unforgettable celebration of the songs, sounds and spirit of this legendary band.

Show Reviews… “That was seriously one of the best concerts I’ve seen in ages. Incredible talent and passion from all. What a collaboration of artists. Please pass on the praise. I think you do Supertramp better than they could pull it off.” – Brian James, FM 105.5 Muskoka

“The band not only delivered a carbon copy musical replica of the record (CRIME OF THE CENTURY), but they floored us with their vocal mimicry of Davies and Hodgson.” “The musical voyage the band took us on was of the highest order and they go down as one of the best tribute bands we have ever seen.” “A surreal Supertramp experience that is a triumphant delight to rock fans of all generations.” – Terry Makedon, T-Mak World: Toronto’s Site for Music, Movies and Culture

bio: Step into the enchanting world of Taylor Swift with a tribute experience that captures the heart, storytelling, and sparkle of one of modern music’s most influential artists. This tribute brings Taylor’s evolution to life, from her country roots and heartfelt ballads to her pop anthems and stadium-worthy performances. With crystal-clear vocals, magnetic stage presence, and authentic charisma, every moment feels like a true celebration of Taylor’s music.

Backed by a live band, stunning costumes, and emotionally charged performances, audiences are taken on a musical journey through Taylor’s eras. Whether it’s the raw honesty of early hits or the cinematic drama of her newer sound, this tribute artist honors the emotion, passion, and connection Taylor Swift inspires in fans around the world. Perfect for festivals, theaters, private events, and die-hard Swifties, this show is crafted to make every audience sing, dance, and feel every lyric.

photo.alt: The Beatle Band Tribute to The Beatles

bio: The Beatle Band (formerly known as The FabFour Canada ) is one of North America’s most engaging and authentic musical tributes to the legendary Beatles. With a passion for precision and a love for the music that defined a generation, The Beatle Band brings to life the spirit, energy, and unforgettable sound of the world’s most influential pop-rock group.

Specializing in faithfully recreating The Beatles’ iconic Touring Years (1963–1966), The Beatle Band delivers a high-energy performance packed with the early hits that launched Beatlemania across the globe. From the raw power of Twist and Shout to the infectious melodies of She Loves You and I Want to Hold Your Hand , the band captures the youthful exuberance and charm that made The Beatles a worldwide phenomenon.

But the show doesn’t stop there. The Beatle Band also brings audiences to the rooftop of Apple Corps in 1969, recreating the Beatles’ final, unannounced live performance with all the grit, soul, and spontaneity that made the original moment legendary.

The Beatle Band is committed to authenticity. Every note is performed live, absolutely no backing tracks are used. From vintage instruments and period-correct costumes to meticulously crafted vocal harmonies and song arrangements, every detail is carefully considered to transport audiences back in time.

Whether you’re a lifelong fan or discovering the magic of The Beatles for the first time, The Beatle Band’s Touring Years Show is a must-see celebration of timeless music and cultural history. Energetic, nostalgic, and fun for all ages, to quote the lads themselves: “A splendid time is guaranteed for all!”

name: Stayin Alive Tribute to The Bee Gees

photo.alt: Stayin Alive Canada, Bee Gees Tribute band

bio: For over 40 years, a time span more than any other group in pop history, The Bee Gees have been outwitting the international music scene with their incredible tenacity to remain current through all time spans of contemporary music.
The close high harmonies of brothers Barry, Robin and Maurice Gibb have made The Bee Gees one of the most impossible attractions in music to launch a tribute to… Until “Stayin’ Alive”.
The vocal match of Mitch Seekins, Todd Sharman and Tony Mattini, create an eerie sense of seeing the brothers Gibb alive in concert… an event virtually impossible to see today.

By 1979, The Bee Gees had made five platinum albums including 35 hit singles, 9 of them reaching #1 on the Billboard charts. The album “Saturday Night Fever” alone sold over 30 million copies and the hits keep coming. The Canadian production “Stayin’ Alive” is a unique recreation of one of the top acts in music history. Backed by a live band, this production is an obvious hit for audiences of all ages.

name: Tribute to The Black Crowes
bio: Amoricans, a Boston-based 8-piece tribute band, brings to life the music of The Black Crowes, known for their unique blend of rock, blues, and soul. With hits like “Hard to Handle,” “She Talks to Angels,” and “Jealous Again,” Amoricans delivers an authentic sound that resonates with both hardcore fans and newcomers.

The band’s commitment to excellence is evident in their precise renditions of The Black Crowes’ classics. From the raw energy of “Twice as Hard” to the soulful ballad “Wiser Time,” Amoricans faithfully recreates the band’s signature sound.

Amoricans is not just about recreating the music; they also embody the spirit of The Black Crowes. Their stage presence, passion, and energy mirror the original band, making each performance a true tribute to The Black Crowes’ legacy.

Whether you’re a longtime fan of “Remedy” or discovering The Black Crowes’ music through Amoricans, their immersive and authentic performances are a must-see. Their dedication to their craft and their love for The Black Crowes’ music shines through in every show.

name: The Chicks Experience
bio: Howdy! Welcome to The Chicks Experience – a high-energy show celebrating the music, attitude, and legacy of the iconic country trio, The Chicks .

The Chicks Experience has it all: powerhouse lead vocals, lush three-part harmonies, and all the fiddlin’ and pickin’ you could ever want. From tender ballads to fiery anthems, this show delivers the sound and excitement fans know and love, performed with passion and authenticity.

So grab your favourite boots, dust off that trusty cowboy hat, and mosey on over as The Chicks Experience performs chart-topping hits like “Not Ready to Make Nice,” “Wide Open Spaces,” and everyone’s favourite female-empowerment anthem, “Goodbye Earl.” Every song is delivered with the heart, energy, and musicianship that made these classics unforgettable.

The Chicks Experience captures the spirit, the sound, and the showmanship that propelled The Chicks to the top of the pop and country charts. Is this the best tribute to our favourite country “Chicks”? Darn tootin’ it is!
This show is perfect for theatres, concert halls, and festivals.

name: The Eagles Tribute

photo.alt: The Eagles Tribute Continental Entertainment Canada

bio: EPIC EAGLES – The Definitive Eagles Tribute Epic Eagles has solidified its reputation as North America’s premier tribute to the iconic Eagles and Don Henley, delivering a masterful performance that captures the heart and soul of one of rock music’s most legendary catalogs. Renowned as the finest Eagles tribute show in production today, Epic Eagles combines unparalleled musical precision, stunning vocal harmonies, and a high-energy stage presence to transport audiences back to the golden era of country rock and classic rock anthems. With a career spanning multiple continents and countless sold-out performances, the band has earned a devoted following and critical acclaim for their authentic recreation of the Eagles’ timeless sound.

Formed by a collective of seasoned musicians with a deep passion for the Eagles’ genre-defining music, Epic Eagles meticulously recreates the intricate instrumentation and lush vocal arrangements that made hits like Hotel California , Take It Easy , Desperado , and Life in the Fast Lane cultural touchstones. The band also pays homage to Don Henley’s solo work, seamlessly weaving in fan favorites such as Dirty Laundry and The Boys of Summer . Their performances strike a perfect balance between the Eagles’ signature country rock roots and their harder-edged rock anthems, offering something for every fan, from casual listeners to die-hard devotees. What sets Epic Eagles apart is their remarkable vocal similarity to the original artists, particularly in replicating the soaring harmonies and emotive lead vocals that defined the Eagles’ sound. Each member of the band is a virtuoso in their own right, bringing technical excellence and infectious enthusiasm to every note. From the haunting guitar riffs of Hotel California to the laid-back groove of New Kid in Town and the heartfelt balladry of Best of My Love , Epic Eagles delivers each song with authenticity and reverence, while infusing their performances with a vibrant energy that captivates audiences of all ages.

The band’s setlist is a journey through the Eagles’ expansive discography, showcasing chart-topping classics alongside carefully selected deep cuts that resonate with longtime fans. Songs like One of These Nights , Lyin’ Eyes , Peaceful Easy Feeling , and I Can’t Tell You Why are performed with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring every chord, harmony, and lyric rings true to the original recordings. For Henley enthusiasts, tracks like All She Wants to Do Is Dance and Sunset Grill add a dynamic layer to the show, highlighting the breadth of his solo career. With a growing international presence and a reputation for sold-out shows, Epic Eagles remains a must-see act for music lovers seeking an authentic and exhilarating celebration of one of rock’s greatest bands. Whether you’re a lifelong Eagles fan or discovering their music for the first time, Epic Eagles promises a night of unforgettable melodies, soaring harmonies, and the timeless spirit of rock ‘n’ roll. “You can check out anytime you like but you can never leave…”

name: A Tribute to The Foo Fighters

photo.alt: A Tribute to The Foo Fighters

bio: Award-winning Foo Fighters tribute band FOOZ FIGHTERS have taken the stage by storm since their debut on Jimmy Fallon’s hit E! Network series Clash of the Cover Bands, where they won over both audiences and judges alike. Hailing from Los Angeles, they are widely recognized as the nation’s top Foo Fighters tribute, transforming every show into a high-energy celebration of one of rock’s most iconic bands and recent Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductees.

Formed in 2015 by veteran musicians with a passion for 90s rock, FOOZ FIGHTERS have grown into one of the most in-demand tribute acts in the country. Performing more than 50 shows annually across the U.S. and abroad, the band captures the power, precision, and raw energy that have made Dave Grohl and the Foo Fighters legendary. Along the way, they’ve shared stages with major artists including Billy Ray Cyrus, Collective Soul, and Scott Stapp of Creed.
Their authenticity has earned praise from music legends. Queen frontman and American Idol star Adam Lambert, who judged their winning performance on Clash of the Cover Bands, declared:
“Fooz Fighters are a legitimate rock band that does justice to the Foo Fighters as fans, and I love that.”

But FOOZ FIGHTERS know a true tribute is more than just the music—it’s about connection. Whether leading massive sing-alongs to hits like My Hero and Best of You, or inviting kids and adults alike to join them onstage for unforgettable moments, they channel the spirit, heart, and communal energy of a real Foo Fighters concert. name: Tribute to the J. Geils Band

photo.alt: Tribute to The J. Geils Band

bio: Whammer Jammer, Boston’s very own tribute to the legendary J. Geils Band is more than just a performance; it’s an immersive experience that captivates audiences near and far.

This dedicated group of six professional musicians from the Boston area is driven by a singular mission: to keep the music and electrifying live performances of one of rock’s most iconic bands alive in the hearts of both longtime and new fans.

Their shows, brimming with energy and loyalty to the original band’s sound, are a testament to the enduring appeal of The J. Geils Band. They meticulously recreate the sound and stage energy that The J. Geils Band was renowned for, ensuring that each performance is a faithful tribute to the original. Their setlists are filled with the band’s greatest hits and fan favorites, from “Centerfold” to “Freeze-Frame,” and everything in between.

name: Here Comes The Rain – Tribute to The Mavericks

photo.alt: Here Comes The Rain – Tribute to The Mavericks

bio: Get ready to dance the night away with Here Comes The Rain, the ultimate Mavericks tribute band! This talented group celebrates the timeless music of The Mavericks, bringing their signature blend of country, rock, Tex-Mex, and Latin rhythms to life on stage.

Every performance captures the heart and soul of hits like Dance the Night Away , All You Ever Do Is Bring Me Down , and Here Comes My Baby . The band’s powerful vocals, rich harmonies, and energetic grooves create an authentic Mavericks concert experience that fans can’t resist.

Based in southern Ontario, Here Comes The Rain has thrilled audiences across festivals, theatres, and live music venues. Each show is packed with great songs, dazzling musicianship, and a contagious spirit that gets everyone on their feet.
Whether you’re a lifelong Mavericks fan or discovering their sound for the first time, this tribute band will make you smile, sing, and sway to the beat.

name: Tribute to the Police

photo.alt: message in a bottle tribute to the police

bio: The Police remain one of the greatest rock bands of all time, with a fan base that’s varied from young to old. Message in a Bottle recreates the magic and original flavour of Sting, Andy Summers and Stewart Copeland of yesteryear, while producing an energetic and fresh live show of today leaving the audience wanting more whenever they hit the stage.

This four piece plays all of The Police’s greatest hits which are some of the most popular songs ever created including “Roxanne,” “Every Breath You Take” and “Message in a Bottle”. They continue to play many high profile shows such as Vail Hot Summer Nights, Orchard Summer Concerts, Southlands Mall Concert Series, Elway’s Backyard Summer Concerts and countless private events. If you’re a Police fan, this band is a must see, and if you’re not, you will be after the show.

name: Tribute to The Rolling Stones
bio: Step into the Voodoo Lounge, where the legacy of The Rolling Stones is kept alive through the electrifying performances of a band that not only plays the music but embodies the soul of the original rock legends.

Fronted by the charismatic Chris Newman as Mick Jagger, Voodoo Lounge delivers an authentic Stones experience. Chris’s uncanny resemblance in voice and mannerism to Jagger leaves audiences spellbound, as he struts and sings through the Stones’ extensive catalogue of hits.

Named after the Stones’ critically acclaimed 1994 album, Voodoo Lounge pays homage to the band’s rich history while bringing a fresh energy to timeless tracks like “Start Me Up,” “Brown Sugar,” and “Wild Horses.”

Voodoo Lounge isn’t just about the music; it’s about the experience. From the iconic riffs to the legendary lyrics, Chris Newman and his bandmates ensure every show is more than a concert—it’s a celebration of the enduring power of rock ‘n’ roll.
So, whether you’re a lifelong fan or a newcomer to the Stones’ music, Voodoo Lounge invites you to join the party. It’s only rock ‘n’ roll, but you’ll like it!

name: Tribute to The Supremes
bio: Embark on a journey back to the golden era of Motown as we recreate the timeless magic of The Supremes. Our story begins in the bustling city of Detroit, where three young talents – Ross, Wilson, and Ballard banded together in 1959 under the name “The Primettes.” With their soulful harmonies and undeniable charm, they quickly caught the attention of Motown Records, signing on in 1961 and rebranding themselves as the iconic Supremes.

We proudly present Karen Durrant and her talented ensemble, faithfully capturing the essence and energy of the original Supremes. With meticulous attention to detail, Karen channels the spirit of Diana Ross, bringing her charisma and powerhouse vocals to the stage. Alongside her are two sensational backup singers, completing the trio and paying homage to the legendary lineup.

From the dazzling costumes to the iconic hairstyles, every aspect of their show is crafted to transport you back in time to the glory days of Motown. Get ready to groove to all the chart-topping hits that made The Supremes a household name. Whether you’re a longtime fan or discovering the magic for the first time, this performance promises an unforgettable experience.

For many years, they’ve captivated audiences across the globe, bringing the authentic sound of Motown to stages far and wide. From intimate venues to grand theaters, this show has garnered rave reviews, earning acclaim for its authenticity and electrifying energy.

Join them as they celebrate the legacy of The Supremes and pay tribute to the trailblazing artists who shaped the landscape of music history. Experience the class, excitement, and timeless allure of The Supremes like never before with this ultimate Supremes Tribute Show.

name: Tribute to The Tragically Hip
bio: Frontman Dean aka ” Gordie”, has made the Tragically Hip material possible. He not only resembles the Hip’s Gord Downie, he has a voice almost identical, along with all the crazy antics and stories for which Downie is known.

Practically Hip has played various clubs throughout Ontario and the U.S., including The Docks in Toronto; along with Universities and Colleges. They have also played numerous festivals with Colin James, Jeff Healy, Gowan, Sass Jordan, Honeymoon Suite and Big Wreck, and last, but not least, numerous charity events, opening for Tom Wilson, as well as being his back up band for the evening.

The band covers Tragically Hip material past and present: Highway Girl, Little Bones, Twist My Arm, Courage, Blow At High Dough, New Orleans Is Sinking, Wheat Kings, Nautical Disaster, Gift Shop, Ahead By A Century,Springtime In Vienna, Poets, Bobcaygeon, Music @ Work, It’s A Good Life If You Don’t Weaken and Silver Jet… to name a few.

name: A Tribute to The Traveling Wilburys
bio: George Harrison, Tom Petty, Roy Orbison, Jeff Lynne and Bob Dylan, aka The Traveling Wilburys. There’s never been a group, let alone super-group in rock history quite like it. They created two mega albums and launched a slew of hits in the late 80s and early 90s, capped with a Grammy win in 1989. But one thing they didn’t do, much to the chagrin of their world-wide fan base, is tour. That is… until now…

The Traveling Milburys capture the sheer talent, excitement and magic of The Traveling Wilburys for all to see and experience. Live. On stage. And in your town. From the opening chords to the final encores of this energy-packed and hit-filled evening, this is without a doubt the world’s greatest tribute to The Traveling Wilburys.
“Close your eyes and it’s like you’re listening to a Wilburys album. But then you open your eyes, and it’s like they’re really there – playing right in front of you…”
John Terrid, Toronto Star
“A roaring, eerily authentic tribute to The Traveling Wilburys, right down to the Rickenbacker, Gretsch and Gibson guitars.”
Chris Day, Ottawa Citizen

name: Tribute to Toby Keith
bio: Toby Keith is one of Americas’ most decorated country music artist achieving multiple Entertainer of the Year, Album of the Year, and Video of the Year awards. The country superstar has hit gold 21 times with #1 country singles and was recently inducted into the Songwriter Hall Of Fame.

David Russ is an established singer-songwriter with over 30 years of international stage experience. His performance as Toby Keith in the “Lets Have A Party” tribute is amazingly spirited! He flawlessly brings to life the sights & sounds of Toby Keith while capturing his unmistakable and much loved charm & charisma. Dave is a dominant country force who owns the stage and thrills audiences from coast to coast.

Number one hits such as “How Do You Like Me Now”, “I love This Bar”, and “A Little Less Talk & A Lot More Action” make for an unforgettable tribute to one of America’s greatest and most influential country artist.
The Toby Keith Tribute “Let’s Have A Party” tribute is available to perform at Festivals, Theaters and Clubs throughout North America.

name: Lou Nelson as Tom Jones
bio: Lou Nelson is widely regarded as one of the world’s finest Tom Jones tribute performers, delivering a dynamic celebration of the legendary Welsh entertainer that has thrilled audiences around the globe.

From the moment Lou steps onto the stage, the resemblance is unmistakable. He is constantly mistaken for Tom Jones, but his performance goes far beyond appearance alone. Lou has studied every detail of the superstar’s stage presence, from the unmistakable hip swivels and confident mannerisms to the Welsh accent, playful audience interaction, and larger-than-life showmanship.

Most importantly, Lou captures the power, richness, and dramatic style of the voice that made Tom Jones an international icon. His commanding vocals, charismatic personality, and attention to detail create an experience that feels authentic, exciting, and instantly familiar.

The show features a crowd-pleasing collection of Tom Jones’ greatest hits, including favorites such as “It’s Not Unusual,” “Delilah,” “What’s New Pussycat?,” “She’s a Lady,” and many more. Each performance is filled with energy, humor, romance, and the timeless music that has entertained generations.

Whether performing in a theater, casino, festival, corporate event, or private celebration, Lou Nelson brings audiences to their feet with a polished tribute that captures the sound, style, and spirit of Tom Jones. More than a look-alike, Lou is a complete entertainer whose powerful voice and magnetic stage presence make this show an unforgettable night of classic hits and pure entertainment.
songs: You Can Leave Your Hat On

name: Elevation – A Tribute to U2
bio: U2 has dazzled us for over 20 years with groundbreaking sounds and heart stopping live performances. Now Canada pays tribute to the best band in the world. Formed in January 2002, Elevation has quickly established itself as a world class U2 tribute show. Elevation has performed shows in Las Vegas, San Francisco, Cleveland and New York as well as many major cities across Canada. In addition to regular club performances in front of packed houses, Elevation has headlined at major music festivals and staged special shows for a wide range of corporate clients which include government, hi-tech companies and one of the largest radio stations in the world. People have traveled from far and wide to see Elevation perform and are always amazed at the incredible authenticity and emotional energy that the band brings to their shows. In a single night.

Elevation will recapture some of the most magical moments of U2’s illustrious history. Their performance will take you from Red Rocks via Live Aid to The Joshua Tree through to ZooTV, Popmart, Elevation and beyond. With one of the most extensive repertoires offered by any tribute band, Elevation will entertain the casual fan with classic hits like “Beautiful Day” and “With Or Without You” while die-hard fans are treated to rarities such as “The Electric Co.” and “Ultraviolet (Light My Way)”. A must-see for any music fan, this is one tribute band that will truly ELEVATE your soul.

Hold Me, Thrill Me, Kiss Me, Kill Me

name: The Ultimate Van Halen Tribute
bio: The Van Halen Invasion show is about having fun. The music of Van Halen is the perfect fit for festivals, theatres, fundraisers, and corporate functions wanting high-energy entertainment. The rock-solid band delivers all the greatest hits from the Dave and Sammy eras with unsurpassed skill. The response to The Van Halen Invasion show has been outstanding. From the first power chord to the last encore, your audience will “Jump” out of their seats to “Dance the Night Away” and sing along to every song.

The Van Halen Invasion show is unmatched. No other Van Halen tribute band brings the entire package together like this; two dynamic frontmen portraying the rival lead singers in voice, costume and attitude while backed by a band of veteran musicians known for their professional attitude and showmanship. Plus, a stage set reminiscent of Van Halen’s glory days of arena rock. From the multitude of guitar cabinets, the enormous drum kit, all the iconic Edward Van Halen guitars and many Michael Anthony replica bass guitars. The production value is unsurpassed.

name: Tribute to Whitney Houston
bio: In 2013, Geri Defoe embarked on a journey to honor her greatest musical inspiration, the incomparable Whitney Houston. What began as a sincere tribute has since evolved into a world-class touring production, mesmerizing audiences across Canada, the United States, Mexico, and the United Kingdom.

Geri doesn’t just perform the hits; she inhabits the spirit of “The Voice.” Her portrayal is a masterclass in vocal prowess and emotional authenticity, capturing the delicate balance of power and grace that defined Whitney’s career. From the soaring, cinematic heights of “I Will Always Love You” to the infectious energy of Whitney’s dance-pop anthems, Geri delivers a performance that transcends simple imitation. Her ability to command the stage and connect with an audience has resulted in a string of sellout shows and nightly standing ovations, leaving fans spellbound by the sheer resonance of her soulful delivery.

name: Tribute to Willie Nelson
bio: Experience the legendary soundscape of country music with Terry Johnson as Shotgun Willie Live, the ultimate tribute act honoring the iconic Willie Nelson. With a profound respect for Nelson’s musical legacy, Terry Johnson encapsulates the essence and spirit of the outlaw country legend in every performance.

Born and raised amidst the rolling hills of the American heartland, Terry Johnson developed an unwavering passion for country music from a young age. Inspired by the raw authenticity and soul-stirring melodies of Willie Nelson, Johnson dedicated himself to mastering Nelson’s distinctive vocal inflections, guitar virtuosity, and storytelling prowess.

With meticulous attention to detail, Terry Johnson meticulously recreates the electrifying atmosphere of a Willie Nelson concert, captivating audiences with flawless renditions of classics such as “On the Road Again,” “Whiskey River,” and “Always on My Mind.” From the heartfelt ballads to the foot-stomping anthems, Johnson’s dynamic performances transport audiences to the heart of Texas, evoking the spirit of honky-tonk bars and open highways.

As Shotgun Willie Live, Terry Johnson not only pays homage to Willie Nelson’s musical genius but also celebrates the enduring impact of his cultural legacy. Whether performing in intimate venues or commanding grand stages, Johnson’s electrifying presence and undeniable talent ensure an unforgettable experience for audiences of all ages.
So, join Terry Johnson as he channels the spirit of a true American icon, inviting audiences to revel in the timeless magic of Willie Nelson’s music with Shotgun Willie Live.

name: A Tribute to Zac Brown

photo.alt: Tribute to Zac Brown Continental Entertainment

bio: Prepare to be transported to the heart of Atlanta, Georgia, as Chicken Fried delivers an authentic tribute to one of country music’s most beloved acts, Zac Brown Band. With genuine vocals, genuine music, and a genuine passion for the music they recreate, Chicken Fried captures the essence of ZBB with uncanny precision, earning accolades from die-hard fans and newcomers alike.

Zac Brown Band has become a household name, captivating audiences with their soulful blend of country, rock, and folk. With four studio albums, two live albums, and a string of chart-topping singles, ZBB has left an indelible mark on the music industry. Their live performances are legendary, drawing in sold-out crowds tour after tour and earning them a reputation as a “must-see” act.

Lead singer Elton Lammie, an award-winning vocalist in his own right, embodies the spirit of Zac Brown with his striking resemblance and impeccable vocal delivery. Fans of Elton often remarked on his uncanny likeness to Zac Brown, eagerly awaiting moments in his live performances when he would treat them to ZBB classics. Thus, Chicken Fried was born out of a desire to bring the magic of Zac Brown Band to audiences who may not have the opportunity to experience them live.

In their tribute show, Chicken Fried faithfully recreates all the hits and fan favorites of Zac Brown Band, from the anthemic “Chicken Fried” to the heartfelt “Colder Weather.” But they don’t stop there; just like ZBB’s live concerts, Chicken Fried surprises audiences with unexpected gems ranging from Metallica to Ray Lamontagne, showcasing the diversity and eclecticism that defines the Zac Brown Band experience.

For fans who crave the energy and emotion of a Zac Brown Band concert but may not have the means to attend, Chicken Fried offers a compelling alternative. With their commitment to authenticity and their infectious enthusiasm for the music of ZBB, Chicken Fried brings the magic of Atlanta’s favorite sons to stages across the country, ensuring that the spirit of Zac Brown Band lives on for audiences everywhere.
